title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to post content.

If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Creative Strategist Ads - Italia
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

We are a fast-growing international consumer goods brand focused on developing innovative and sustainable cleaning products. Our ambition is to make sustainable cleaning more accessible to consumers through convenient, effective and environmentally conscious alternatives to traditional household products.

We operate across several European markets, combining a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business model with a data-driven and highly performance-oriented approach. Our growth is driven by creative production, paid acquisition, e-commerce and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first** team, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Italy**, a strategic market for our business.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a **highly creative, performance-driven and consumer-oriented person** to become the creative engine behind our growth in the Italian market.

**Creativity is at the heart of this role.** We are looking for someone who can deeply understand the Italian consumer, identify compelling communication angles and turn insights into **advertising concepts, hooks and creatives that capture attention and drive sales**.

Your main responsibility will be to develop, test and continuously improve advertising creatives, identifying new ways to communicate our value proposition and stand out in the market. You will combine creative thinking with performance analysis, using data to understand what works, generate new ideas and improve the effectiveness of our campaigns.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an e-commerce business or analyze marketing data. **We are looking for a creative thinker who knows how to turn ideas into advertising that sells.**

Experience in areas such as e-commerce, CRO, CRM or broader Growth is a plus, but **your creative mindset, ability to generate strong advertising concepts and understanding of performance-driven creative strategy are what matter most**.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Develop creative concepts and advertising angles tailored to the **Italian market and consumer**.
* Identify new ways to communicate the company's value proposition, product benefits and competitive advantages.
* Generate compelling **hooks, messages, storytelling concepts and creative formats** that capture attention and drive conversions.
* Research Italian consumer behaviour, cultural insights, social media trends, competitors and successful advertising approaches to inspire new creatives.
* Develop creative hypotheses and translate them into actionable concepts for paid advertising.
* Create clear and effective **creative briefs** for internal teams, content creators, UGC creators and external partners.
* Explore different creative approaches, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, problem-solution concepts, educational content and other performance-driven formats.
* Collaborate with the Creative and Paid Media teams to produce, launch and test new advertising creatives.
* Analyze creative performance to understand which hooks, angles, messages and formats work best, using these insights to generate new ideas and improve existing concepts.
* Continuously iterate on successful creatives, finding new variations and opportunities to scale their performance.
* Build a **repeatable and scalable creative testing system** that consistently generates fresh ideas and advertising assets for the Italian market.
* Ensure that advertising feels authentic and relevant to Italian consumers, rather than simply translating campaigns from other countries.

### **Creative Performance & Growth**

* Monitor creative and campaign performance to understand which concepts generate the strongest results.
* Use relevant KPIs such as **CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS and CVR** to evaluate creative effectiveness and inform new hypotheses.
* Identify the relationship between creative messaging, audience response and conversion performance.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to understand campaign results and turn performance insights into new creative opportunities.
* Prioritize creative initiatives based on their potential impact on acquisition and business growth.
* Test, learn, iterate and continuously improve the creative strategy based on results.

### **E-commerce, CRO & CRM**

Although creativity is the main focus of the role, experience in other areas of digital growth would be a valuable advantage.

* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate across the Italian e-commerce experience.
* Contribute ideas to optimize product pages, landing pages, promotions, bundles and value propositions.
* Understand how creative messaging connects with the website experience and influences conversion.
* Contribute to CRO initiatives and A/B testing by identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey.
* Support the alignment of advertising creatives with CRM campaigns and customer communications.
* Experience with **Shopify, Klaviyo, CRO, UX or retention marketing** is a plus.

### **Italian Market Insights**

* Develop a strong understanding of the **Italian consumer**, including their needs, motivations, objections, purchasing habits and perceptions of sustainable household products.
* Identify local insights, cultural nuances and consumer pain points that can inspire effective advertising concepts.
* Research Italian competitors, DTC brands, social media trends and relevant creative approaches.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the brand and strengthen its positioning in the Italian market.
* Bring new ideas and creative perspectives to the wider team, helping adapt the company's communication to local consumer expectations.

**About You**
-------------

* **Native Italian speaker** with professional English proficiency.
* A strong creative mindset and the ability to generate original, compelling and commercially relevant ideas.
* A genuine interest in advertising, consumer psychology, storytelling and understanding what makes people pay attention and buy.
* Ability to turn consumer insights into **creative angles, hooks, concepts and advertising messages**.
* Understanding of social media content and digital advertising formats, particularly Meta Ads.
* Ability to think beyond standard advertising approaches and propose fresh ways to communicate a product's value.
* Understanding of performance-driven creative principles, including testing different concepts, analyzing results and iterating based on learnings.
* Ability to combine creativity with analytical thinking and use data to improve creative decisions.
* A proactive, hands-on and autonomous approach to work.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment.
* **Experience in Creative Strategy, content creation, digital advertising, performance marketing or a related creative role is desirable.** We are open to different professional backgrounds as long as you can demonstrate strong creative thinking and potential.

Experience with Shopify, e-commerce management, CRO, CRM or Klaviyo is a plus.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**
--------------------------------

* A genuine **obsession with creative ideas that sell**.
* A strong portfolio of advertising concepts, social media campaigns, UGC ads or other performance-driven creative work.
* Experience developing creative testing frameworks or iterating on ads based on performance data.
* The ability to move quickly from **insight idea concept creative test learning iteration**.
* A strong understanding of consumer psychology, hooks, storytelling and effective product communication.
* Experience working with DTC brands, e-commerce businesses, startups or high-growth companies.
* The ability to identify creative opportunities that competitors are overlooking.
* A deep understanding of the Italian consumer, culture and market dynamics.
* Experience creating advertising that feels native to the Italian market, rather than simply translating campaigns from another country.
* Experience with Shopify, CRO, CRM or broader Growth initiatives is an additional advantage.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Full remote work** with a flexible working environment and the autonomy to organize your work.
* **A central creative role:** your ideas will directly influence how the brand communicates with and acquires customers in Italy.
* **High ownership and impact**, with the opportunity to shape the creative strategy of a growing international brand.
* A key role in a high-growth company with an ambitious international expansion plan.
* A young, international and collaborative team working across different markets.
* A fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where ideas are encouraged, tested and developed quickly.
* Real responsibility from day one, with the freedom to propose and implement new creative initiatives.
* Close collaboration with the central team and colleagues across Creative, Paid Media, Growth and E-commerce.
* A culture focused on experimentation, learning and continuous improvement.
* Competitive compensation, aligned with experience and responsibilities.
* The opportunity to grow professionally alongside an expanding international consumer goods brand.

**Join our mission! We're waiting for you!**

title: E-Commerce Paid Media Creative Strategist
description:
En Natulim buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist – Paid Ads** que nos ayude a llevar nuestras creatividades publicitarias al siguiente nivel.

Buscamos una persona que combine **creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**: alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que **piense la creatividad de principio a fin**, desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

### **Qué harás**

* Desarrollar **conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación** para campañas de paid ads.
* Crear y testar diferentes **hooks, narrativas, claims y estructuras de vídeo** para mejorar el rendimiento de los anuncios.
* Escribir **guiones y briefs creativos** claros para producción y edición.
* Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.
* Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: **hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.**
* Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de **Performance, Content y Editing** para producir y escalar las mejores creatividades.
* Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.
* Participar en la creación de contenido tanto **short-form como long-form**, siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.
* Mantener un sistema continuo de **testing e iteración creativa**.

### **Qué buscamos**

* **2+ años de experiencia** creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.
* Experiencia real desarrollando **anuncios en vídeo para plataformas como Meta, Instagram, TikTok o YouTube**.
* Experiencia escribiendo **guiones, hooks y conceptos creativos**.
* Haber editado vídeo o tener suficiente conocimiento de edición para entender cómo llevar una idea a ejecución.
* Entender las estructuras que hacen que un vídeo funcione: **hooks, retención, ritmo, storytelling y CTA**.
* Experiencia trabajando con marcas de **e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo**.
* Capacidad para interpretar métricas de performance y convertir datos en aprendizajes creativos.
* Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.
* Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.
* **Permiso de trabajo en España.**

### **¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades (seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería).
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.  
    
  Te esperamos!

title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
Senior Creative Strategist (Creative Milkshake)
description:
**About us**
------------

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a **Senior Creative Strategist** to bring sharp thinking, bold ideas, and strategic mentorship to our team. You’ll partner with junior strategists on big projects, help steer creative in the right direction, and be the first layer of quality before ideas move forward to the Lead CS and Creative Director. You’re the kind of person who always has a pulse on what's next in ads, culture, and strategy.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Here’s how we see your time being spent:

* 60% Creating CSPs/Creative Audits, Storyboards, leading client calls
* 20% Mentorship and collaboration with Junior Creative Strategists
* 20% Creative innovation: researching trends, platform updates, and developing new strategic frameworks

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Creative Strategy & Execution (60%)**

* Lead storyboarding and copywriting for mid-to-large projects.
* Lead and support on client and internal calls, bringing the right line of questioning to uncover insights.
* Review and refine briefs, references, and creative angles to ensure they align with brand goals and best practices.
* Turn performance data and brand insights into strong, clear concepts that convert.
* Collaborate with Account Managers, Production, and Design to keep ideas moving smoothly from concept to execution.

**Mentorship & Feedback (20%)**

* Schedule mentorship calls with Junior CSs or learning calls with the creative strategy team to level-up their work and creative thinking.
* Be the go-to partner for Junior CSs — guiding concepts, providing feedback, and helping shape ideas.
* Help create a space where Junior CSs can ask questions, experiment, and grow.
* You are the first layer of quality before the Lead Creative Strategist & Creative Director does their final approval checks.

**Creative Innovation (20%)**

* Be a key voice in spotting problems early and suggesting solutions before they escalate.
* Stay plugged into creative trends, platform changes, and new formats across social and digital.
* Share trend reports and insights that can inspire the team and shape new ad directions.
* Test and bring forward new frameworks, hooks, or structures to elevate our work.
* Make sure these are created into resources and properly documented for the team to learn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 3-5 years experience in creative strategy, copywriting, or paid social (agency or brand side).
* Confident communicator who knows how to ask the right questions.
* Strategic thinker with a love for performance-driven creative.
* Strong eye for quality — across copy, references, and creative structure.
* Proactive, solutions-oriented, and ready to own your projects.
* Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.
* Always curious about what's next in advertising, storytelling, and social platforms.
* CET, GMT or +/- 1 timezone required.

**Skills**
----------

* Copywriting & storytelling for ads
* Social-first creative strategy (esp. direct response)
* Trendspotting & strategic innovation
* Collaborative leadership
* Problem solving & ownership mindset
* Comfortable in Google Drive, Slack, ClickUp, Foreplay, Motion

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare & internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO + 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Fuel the Growth Engine**

* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

### **5. Go global, and keep the soul**

* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to post content.

If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Creative Strategist E-commerce - Rumania
description:
### **About Natulim**

Natulim is a fast-growing European brand of eco-friendly cleaning products. Our ambition is to become **the leading eco-cleaning brand in Europe**, building a strong, innovative and consumer-centric DTC brand.

Our flagship product, **biodegradable laundry detergent sheets**, offers a simpler and more sustainable alternative to traditional laundry detergents.

We currently operate across several European markets, and our growth is driven by a **DTC, data-driven and highly performance-oriented approach**, combining Shopify, acquisition, content, CRM and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first** team, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Romania**, a strategic market for Natulim.

### **The Role**

We are looking for a **highly creative, performance-driven and business-oriented** person to lead Natulim's growth in the Romanian market.

The main growth engine for the market will be **creating, testing and optimizing our advertising creatives**. We are therefore looking for someone who can turn consumer insights into **creative angles, advertising concepts and content that drives sales**.

You will combine **creativity and data analysis**: understanding what works, identifying why it works, developing new hypotheses and continuously evolving our creative system.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an ecommerce business. We are looking for someone who can **deeply understand the Romanian consumer, identify new communication angles and turn creativity into business growth.**

### **Your Responsibilities**

**Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Regularly analyze campaign and creative performance to identify the **angles, hooks, formats and messages** that drive results.
* Identify new creative opportunities based on **data, consumer insights, trends, competitors and Romanian culture**.
* Develop new creative hypotheses and propose new advertising concepts adapted to the Romanian market.
* Create **creative briefs** and collaborate with internal teams, creators and partners to produce new ads.
* Develop and test different **angles, hooks, formats, messages and value propositions**.
* Identify the elements that make a creative successful and turn learnings into new iterations.
* Gradually build a **scalable creative system** capable of continuously generating new ideas and creatives for the Romanian market.
* Stay up to date with **Romanian DTC brands, social media trends and new creative approaches**.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to turn creative insights into **profitable growth and acquisition**.

**Growth & Performance**

* Track key acquisition and performance KPIs: **CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV**, etc.
* Understand the relationship between creative performance, acquisition and ecommerce conversion.
* Identify funnel friction points and propose actions to improve overall performance.
* Prioritize initiatives based on their **potential business impact**.
* Analyze the performance of the Romanian market and turn data into concrete recommendations.
* Test, learn, iterate and scale the initiatives that work.

**E-commerce & CRO**

* Own and optimize the **Shopify customer experience** for the Romanian market.
* Identify opportunities to improve **conversion rate, AOV and revenue**.
* Manage and optimize products, collections, promotions, bundles, product pages and landing pages.
* Propose and coordinate experiments and A/B tests.
* Identify friction throughout the customer journey and work with the relevant teams to solve it.
* Ensure an excellent user experience, particularly on mobile.
* Continuously adapt the ecommerce experience to **Romanian consumer expectations, purchasing habits and market dynamics**.

**CRM & Retention**

* Coordinate CRM campaigns and automations in **Klaviyo**.
* Ensure consistency between acquisition campaigns and the customer journey.
* Identify opportunities to improve **retention, reactivation and LTV**.
* Collaborate with the relevant teams to maximize the value generated by each customer.
* Adapt CRM messaging and customer journeys to the **Romanian market and consumer behaviour**.

**Romanian Market Development**

* Develop a deep understanding of the **Romanian consumer**, including their needs, motivations, objections and purchasing habits.
* Adapt messaging, creatives and value propositions to the Romanian market.
* Identify new growth opportunities and help establish Natulim as a leading eco-cleaning brand in Romania.
* Develop a strong understanding of **local competitors, DTC brands, market trends and cultural specificities**.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate Natulim within the Romanian cleaning and sustainability market.
* Work autonomously while collaborating closely with the central team based in Spain.

### **About You**

* Experience in **DTC ecommerce, Growth, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing or a similar environment**.
* Strong creative mindset and the ability to **generate ideas, angles and advertising concepts**.
* Experience creating, testing or optimizing **digital advertising creatives**.
* Strong understanding of **Meta Ads and the main Performance Marketing channels**.
* Ability to analyze performance and turn data into **creative and business insights**.
* Strong understanding of key KPIs such as **CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, AOV and LTV**.
* Hands-on experience with **Shopify or another ecommerce platform**, ideally in a DTC environment.
* Strong interest in **CRO, UX and funnel optimization**.
* Experience with CRM and ideally **Klaviyo**.
* Ability to work in a **hands-on, autonomous and highly ownership-driven** environment.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a **fast-paced and constantly evolving environment**.
* **Native Romanian speaker and professional English.**
* Spanish is a plus, but **not required**.

### **What Will Make You Stand Out**

* A genuine **obsession with creativity and ideas that sell**.
* Experience in **DTC, startups or high-growth brands**.
* Experience creating **UGC content, social media ads or running creative testing frameworks**.
* Ability to move quickly from **idea concept test learning iteration**.
* Strong analytical thinking without losing your creative mindset.

Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

**Primary Focus:**

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
* Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
* Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
* Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
* Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
* Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
* Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
* Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
* Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
* Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
* Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
* Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
* Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
* Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

**How This Role Connects Across the Team:**

* Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
* Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
* Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
* Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
* Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
* Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that's optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
* Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
* Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
* Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.
* Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.
* Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

title: Senior Director Creative Strategy
description:
Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care and body care. COTY is the global leader in fragrance and number three in color cosmetics. COTY’s products are sold in over 150 countries around the world. COTY and its brands are committed to range of social causes as well as seeking to minimize its impact on the environment. For additional information about Coty Inc., please visit www.coty.com.
  
  
**MISSION**
Reporting to the SVP Brand & Equity, the role of Creative Strategy Snr Director, Consumer Beauty will be fully responsible for leading creative strategy across the iconic brands within the CB portfolio: across Color cosmetics and Mass scenting.
  
  
This pivotal role will partner with the creative teams and brand teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – writing innovative creative strategy, cultural levers and conceptual ideas borne of consumer insight.
  
  
This is a hybrid role, half strategist half creative. The Creative Strategy Snr Director – Consumer Beauty might need to write a headline one day, write a compelling pithy presentation the next, a script the next, and think through what the cultural springboard is for a brand or a campaign. Or take the SVP’s place in a creative review to ensure the work is clear, effective and impactful, and refined until delivery. All while taking pressure off the SVP to free up focus for higher-level priorities.
  
  
Coty is a challenger brand; work is intense and entrepreneurial. It is agile and fast. Immediacy and hands on attitude is critical. Autonomy is pivotal.
  
  
Please note that whilst this position will be based in our Wimbledon Office, we do offer a flexible Omni-working policy which means that up to 50% of your hours will be based from the office and the remaining 50% of your hours can be remote.
  
  
**THE ROLE**

* Leading Creative strategy across the iconic brands within the Consumer Beauty portfolio.
* A unicorn with the ability to write disruptive creative strategy, borne of consumer insight, and concept ideas with the creatives.
* Critical ability to write in a pithy and provocative way, with fearless clarity.
* Partner with the creative teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – helping generate vital creative thought starters which can be further developed.
* Pivotal ability to help teams (creative and brand) ‘see’ the idea amongst the clutter of creative development; articulating, expanding, and presenting story telling in a way that becomes unmissable and strategically flawless.
* Develop product claims and (both traditional and contemporary) to create something innovative that the world cannot miss!
* Responsible for creative strategy across color cosmetics, personal care, nail and mass scenting/fragrance.
* Social first thinker - with the ability to brand build in the new Meta led landscape our brands now live in.
* Connected to global culture, knowledgeable.
* GLOBAL - this is global business. Must be well versed in US beauty, as well as European beauty.
* A realist - not precious – if it doesn’t work or is too highbrow, move on!
* Hand-On. Not a floater waiting for other to action.

**What You’ll Bring**
Knowledge and Experience:
  
  

* 15+ years experience in an agency/in-house brand creative strategist.
* Global in outlook
* TikTok and socially savvy.
* Consumer first thinker.
* Ability to co-create with the SVP Brand & Equity, the creative teams, third parties and the brand teams within a highly collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of hierarchy with both multifunctional partners and with external stakeholders.
* A ‘roll the sleeves up do-er’ not a floater. We are an entrepreneurial set of people that think and do, and we do it fast.
* Ability to work autonomously under pressure.
* Agile and adaptable as the business and brand environment changes daily.
* Experienced in the new beauty world - not the old traditional world.
* A good beauty aesthete - this person needs judgment and an eye. They will take responsibility for the work being on brand, on strategy and effective (passing IPSOS tests, and driving in market growth)

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* Ability to think creatively, highly-driven and self-motivated.
* Digitally literate and culturally plugged in.
* Well versed in UK/EU/Global mass consumer beauty universes (color cosmetics and fragrance)
* Ability to work in an international business context.

**CONCLUDING**
You’ll get to work in a diverse and environment with a team who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way. Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

Creative Director

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*

Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Compensation:**

Where you land within it depends on your experience, skills, and location. If your expectations fall outside the range, please apply anyway. We'd love to talk.
