title: Fitness Program Director
description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is assigned to the Non-Appropriated Fund (NAF) Fitness, Sports, and Deployed Forces Support Branch; Fleet Readiness; Commander, Navy Installations Command (CNIC); Naval Station Rota, Spain. Incumbent has oversight of the Fitness, Sports, and Aquatics programs at the installation. Additional programs (e.g. Deployed Forces Support) may be included based on need and installation size.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

### **Family of overseas employees**

Family members of a federal employee or uniformed service member who is or was, working overseas.

### **Clarification from the agency**

United States Citizens Worldwide, including local U.S. Citizens that are 1) Current permanent NAF/APF employees; or 2) Spouses of active duty military members; or 3) Family members of active duty military member; or 4) Family members of DoD civilians.

  

**Duties**
----------

**Program Management (includes but not limited to):**

* Plans, organizes, develops, implements, and manages a diverse and comprehensive fitness, sports, and aquatics program, within the scope of objectives and guidelines established at higher organizational levels, to include related facilities (e.g., group exercise classes; self-directed fitness sports, and aquatics programs; aquatics programs; incentive programs; special events; intramural, extramural and varsity sports; instructional programs; and awareness and education programs).

* Coordinates with city, state, other military bases, and pertinent organizations in establishing a well-rounded fitness and sports program and to effectively promote all aspects of health/wellness to the community.

* Coordinates with base organizations to ensure fitness advisory members are assigned and the bylaws and philosophy of fitness programs are thoroughly understood.

* Conducts meetings and hosts collaborated events/educational seminars/information fairs, etc.

* Maintains records of command participation and determines the winner of individual and base awards and makes arrangements for presentations.

* Interprets considerable data relating to program trends, costs, problems, and needs; refines ormodifies program methods and techniques based on findings.

* Prepares appropriated fund (APF) and NAF budgets, which include the expenditures required to conduct the fitness, sports and aquatics programs (categories A and B).

* Monitors contract services and properly performs quality assessment and evaluation (QAE) responsibilities.

* Completes local needs assessments and/or local surveys annually to determine customer needs and incorporates these finding into the annual program plan.

* Coordinates with marketing staff to plan and develop promotional advertising, commercial sponsorship, and publicity strategies.

* Assists local Command Fitness Leaders (CFL) in conducting and administering safe and proper Physical Readiness Tests.

* Solicits, interviews, selects, and directs volunteers and contract instructors for activities and specialty programs.

* Maintains appropriate records and submits deserving volunteers for recognition through the base volunteer recognition program.

* Reviews research publications and health journals to ensure currency in methodology and philosophy in the area of health and fitness (e.g., exercise physiology, life-style management, nutrition, and physical conditioning).

* Ensures the program meets or exceeds industry standards as established by governmental and private organizations such as the Cooper Institute, Presidents Council on Physical Fitness, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Department of Defense (DoD), American College of Sports Medicine, etc

  
**Facility Management (includes but not limited to):**

* Coordinates the use and maintenance of indoor and outdoor facilities, which may include but is not limited to, gymnasium(s), fitness center(s), tennis court(s), swimming pool(s), softball field(s), jogging track(s), football field(s) and soccer field(s) to accommodate the comprehensive installation fitness, aquatics, and sports programs.

* Coordinates with and assists engineers on requirements related to construction of all new indoor and outdoor fitness and athletic facilities.

* Coordinates with Naval Facilities Engineering Command, and other base agencies (e.g., Safety Office) regarding requirements for maintenance and repair of fitness, sports and aquatic facilities and purchase and installation of new equipment.

* Develops a five-year facility improvement program to maintain a state of the art program, prepares construction plans for renovations/additions or expansion and submits work orders for all minor construction projects from inception to completion.

* Ensures inventory control of all property, equipment and supplies to protect government assets and determines replacement requirements levels.

* Takes timely and appropriate action to comply with safety, fire and environmental directions and ensures safe, healthy, contemporary, comfortable, and adequate facilities.

  
**Supervisory duties comprise 25% of incumbent's time and include but are not limited to:**

* Directs work to be accomplished by a staff that includes Fitness Coordinator, Sports Coordinator Aquatics Coordinator, Fitness Facility Coordinator, Outdoor Maintenance Supervisor and other subordinate staff.

* Assigns work based on priorities, difficulty and requirements of assignments, and staff capabilities.

* Conducts annual performance reviews of staff.

* Participates in MWR Fitness staffing decisions.

* Ensures staff receives proper training to fulfill requirements of their positions.

* Addresses potential disciplinary and/or performance issues timely and takes appropriate, corrective action(s) as necessary.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Occasional travel of less than 10% may be required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a valid state driver’s license.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and First Aid certification.
* Must have ability to maintain fitness/health certification from a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) or Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC).

### **Qualifications**

**KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION**
  
  
Knowledge of a wide range of principles, concepts and techniques that govern physical fitness programs which includes knowledge of exercise science, strength conditioning, nutrition, weight loss/control, cardiovascular endurance, exercise requirements and projected results.
  
  
Knowledge of bio-mechanics, fitness testing and exercise prescription supplemented with a knowledge of proper procedures in the use of strength training equipment, nutrition, exercise, physical fitness programming and testing equipment.
  
  
Skill in planning and executing a comprehensive fitness, aquatics, and/or sports program that includes a variety of fitness and aquatics activities and individual and team sports.
  
  
Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and kinesiology as related to exercise and physical fitness.
  
  
Knowledge of military physical fitness standards and testing procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of the physical and psychological factors that impact training, performance and recovery of individuals and team sports.
  
  
Knowledge of CNIC's EEO policy and procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of NAF and/or APF budgeting processes including ability to prepare budgets.
  
  
Skill in the use of Microsoft Office Programs (e.g., Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook).
  
  
Knowledge of safety, fire and environmental regulations and procedures.
  
  
Ability to develop and effectively deliver presentations and/or training.
  
  
Skill in developing and adapting new methods, approaches and procedures for the most effective
  
management of a fitness program.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing

### **Education**

Per DoD MWR Fitness Standards (issued 21 July 2016) this is a supervisory position responsible for total facility oversight including operation, programming and staffing. While elements (a) through (c) are preferred, a combination of two of these elements may sufficiently qualify an individual to perform their duties as program director:
  
  
a) professional certification from a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) or Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC) accredited health/fitness organization.
  
  
b) competency in business and the design and delivery of exercise programs; and
  
  
c) at least three years of experience in the fitness industry/field for civilian personnel.

About the role
  
  
As Associate Director, Cloud Data Platform Architecture, you will define the technology strategy and architecture for cloud data platforms supporting the Novartis Drug Development portfolio. You will guide the delivery of secure, compliant, scalable and reusable platform capabilities supporting a wide range of data and AI use cases.
  
  
A key focus will be evolving an established, multi-tenant cloud data mesh platform already operating in production. You will lead the architecture of new AI capabilities and enhancements to existing capabilities, improving the platform's self-service experience while maintaining robust data governance, GxP compliance and protection of highly sensitive data.

title: Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe
description:
**About the Role**

Teach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships. As a Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe, you will steward Teach For All's engagement with a group of partner organizations in the Europe region, working to build and deepen relationships and collaboration in pursuing educational equity in Europe. In this role you will act as a strategic advisor to partner organizations, diagnosing needs and opportunities, consulting on strategic challenges, and mobilizing network resources to drive collective impact.

In this position, you will also play a critical role in strengthening partner organizations' public sector partnerships through targeted support around institutional relations strategy development and execution in key countries in Europe. You will work closely with global team members to build more active partner connections and collaboration with their governments (Ministries of Education at national, regional or local levels; regional and local authorities; universities and research institutions), by developing specific partner support initiatives, contributing to Erasmus+ projects, and designing learning experiences and ad-hoc resources when needed. The ideal candidate for this position will have a proven ability to work effectively across diverse contexts and cultures, navigating ambiguity with ease, and will have experience making sound strategic decisions that drive impact in complex and changing environments.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for an individual with superior leadership, strategic, interpersonal, and programmatic skills to increase the impact of our mission and shape the education landscape in the region. The strongest candidates will have a proven ability to set a clear vision, build culture and relationships, influence outcomes through others, and make strategic decisions that drive meaningful impact. A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

**Outcomes**

* Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All's vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
* Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.

* There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:
  + Our network is expanding in the region.
  + Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
  + Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
  + Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
  + Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
* Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities:**

Partner Support (40%)

* As a "portfolio lead," serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes
* Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director's portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All
* Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All's shared global vision and priorities

Public Sector Support (50 %)

* Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
* Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region
* Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
* Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values
* Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes
* Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally
* Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

* Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
* Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
* Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
* Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
* Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
* Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
* Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

**Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences**

* Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
* Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
* Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
* Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
* Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

**What Teach For All Offers:**

* Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization's progress
* Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
* Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
* Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
* And much more!

**Application Instructions**

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Work authorization**

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

**Compensation**

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

**Travel and Hours**

Most work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

**About Teach For All**

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations' under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All's global organization works to increase the network's impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing Deployment Strategist team that helps n8n's enterprise customers turn automation opportunities into measurable business impact. You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

### **Build & Lead the Deployment Strategist Team**

* Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.
* Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.
* Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.

### **Own & Scale the Deployment Methodology**

* Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.
* Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.
* Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.

### **Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes**

* Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.
* Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.
* Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.

### **Scale Delivery Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration**

title: Process Automation Engineer
location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, CN, Spain
description:
##### ***-******Las Palmas De Gran Canaria******-***

**Alien Technology Transfer** empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport.

We’re looking for a versatile **Process Automation Engineer** to join Alien Technology Transfer at **our office in Las Palmas**. Working closely with and reporting directly to our CEO, you will play a central role in a company-wide review of how each of our departments operates. Your job is to understand how work actually gets done, identify where time, quality and effort are being lost, and then design, build and maintain the tools that fix it. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that combines process analysis with full-stack engineering. You will spend time with department heads and their teams to map workflows and pinpoint inefficiencies. You will turn your findings into standardised processes and reliable software that is easily adopted. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer, nor for someone who only writes code to a specification. We need a strong generalist who can diagnose a business problem, decide what should be standardised, automated or eliminated, and then deliver a working solution end-to-end.

To join our team, you must possess a genuine interest in technology and business, be fluent in English, and take a highly analytical, articulate, and well-organised approach to your work. We are seeking a self-motivated team player with a strong startup attitude and the stamina to thrive within an ambitious, goal-driven environment. The ideal candidate is eager to take on high levels of responsibility, possesses sharp problem-solving skills, and is proactive about staying up to date on the latest tools — AI or otherwise — to ensure top performance. You are energised by wearing multiple hats—effectively managing priorities and diverse deliverables autonomously without needing a detailed playbook. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in this dynamic role, we would be excited to hear from you.

* **Contract Type:** Permanent.
* **Hybrid Work Modality:** Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Process Diagnosis & Standardisation

* Work with each department to map current workflows and understand how work is actually done.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, error-prone manual steps and activities that add little value, and quantify their impact where possible.
* Define standardised processes, templates and quality checks that reduce variability and prevent quality issues before they reach clients.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CEO and department heads, and prioritise improvements by impact and effort.

Tool Development & Platform Engineering

* Design, build and maintain internal tools and applications that enhance the performance of each department, from data layer through to API and user interface.
* Integrate tools with the systems our teams already use, such as Google Workspace, Odoo, and other AI-powered tools, so that solutions fit naturally into existing workflows usable by department personnel.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and keep internal tools documented and easy to hand over.

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
* Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

* Support teams in adopting new tools and processes through clear documentation, training and hands-on support.
* Define and track metrics that show whether each change is improving department performance, and iterate based on results and user feedback.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for standardisation and automation as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
* Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM or other AI/ML-based solutions.
* Proven ability to analyse business processes and translate them into practical software or automation solutions.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear UI/UX requirements (user flows, screens, states, edge cases) and to evaluate and refine interfaces until they are intuitive for non-technical users.
* Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with non-technical colleagues, understand their needs, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem from diagnosis through to a deployed, maintained solution.
* Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience building AI tools that work with documents, such as searching, summarising, extracting or checking text (e.g. RAG, vector databases, NLP).
* Experience with Google Workspace APIs and workflow-automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make).
* Knowledge of process-improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or business process mapping.
* Experience in consultancy or professional-services environments, particularly in document-heavy work such as proposal or report writing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Relocation & Bureaucracy Support: Dedicated guidance and administrative assistance for obtaining your Spanish NIE, social security, and local residency registration in Las Palmas.
* Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model (4 days onsite / 1 day WFH) + 20 extra remote working days per year to use at your convenience.
* Health & Wellbeing: Private health insurance coverage.
* Time Off: 30 days of paid annual leave.
* Company Culture: Regular team-building events, social activities, and a vibrant work environment in a co-working space just 50 meters from the beach in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.

Please note: Due to the high volume of candidates, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback on the outcome of every application.

title: Fabrications - Mechanical Engineering
description:
The Mechanical Engineering role is part of the Fabrications team within the Wind Machine Head Engineering Subsection. This position involves ownership of mechanical components with significant human interaction, such as working surfaces, railings, ladders, trays, machinery protections, and brackets. Responsibilities include New Product/Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis. The role requires design and development of mechanical components under the technical guidance and mentorship of senior engineers.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technical Contribution:** Support the design of fabricated wind turbine components and help resolve mechanical engineering challenges under the guidance of senior engineers.
* **Project Execution:** Support New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, technology integration, and field issue resolution by completing assigned engineering tasks, with a primary focus on safety, quality, and reliability.
* **Product Safety and EHS:** Support the identification and mitigation of risks for safety-critical components, helping ensure designs meet tolerable risk levels. Assist in the resolution of SAFER cases by completing assigned action items in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* **Systems Thinking & Integration:** Develop a "Systems Thinking" mindset to understand how components integrate into the overall turbine design. With support from senior engineers, learn to assess tradeoffs and communicate the implications of component changes on the wider machine.
* **Compliance & Standards:** Apply relevant design practices, industry regulations, and standards to the design of mechanical components. Build and maintain knowledge of the engineering requirements affecting wind turbine systems.
* **Tools & Process:** Apply standardized engineering tools, analysis, and calculation methodologies to ensure a rigorous engineering approach. Share observations and lessons learned to support continuous improvement of our designs.
* **Risk Management:** Participate in risk identification and mitigation activities, including DFMEA sessions, helping to ensure that potential failure modes are identified, addressed, and validated against quality and reliability standards.
* **Prototyping & Validation:** Assist in the prototyping and physical testing of mechanical systems. Help investigate and resolve technical issues or defects identified during the validation and testing phases.
  

  
  

**Critical Soft Skills**
------------------------

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of the quality and integrity of assigned design tasks, working to meet Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) expectations and seeking guidance when needed.
* **Innovation:** Shows curiosity and proposes practical improvements to existing designs or processes within a fast-paced engineering environment. Learns to balance creative thinking with engineering rigor.
* **Proactiveness & Energy:** Demonstrate a positive, collaborative energy and a strong willingness to learn across the organization, contributing to an environment focused on continuous learning and technical excellence.
* **Effective Communication:** Ability to communicate technical problems, progress, and open questions in clear, factual, and simple terms to team members and stakeholders.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* **Experience:** Relevant product design and development experience, ideally in the wind industry.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Working knowledge of mechanical design (static, fatigue), FEM (Finite Element Method), and manufacturing processes (Sheet metal, machining, welding).
* **Software Tools:** Knowledge of CAD (Unigraphics NX 3D-CAD preferred), CAE tools (Ansys, Hypermesh), and PLM tools.
* **Travel:** Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**
---------------------------

* Knowledge of structured problem-solving (RCA) and Lean design principles
* Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in international, multi-disciplinary project teams (Electrical, Structural, and Systems).
* Familiarity with wind turbine structural components and internal mechanical systems, or with similar mechanical products in other industries.

==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Group Product Manager (Core)
description:

* People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.

* Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
* Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision

### **Our Work Style:**

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

title: KAM Senior
description:
Somos una de las marcas de mayor crecimiento en España en el cuidado del hogar.

Buscamos un/a **Key Account Manager (KAM) Senior** para liderar nuestra expansión en el canal moderno en España. Una oportunidad para construir, con mucha autonomía, el siguiente capítulo de una marca que está cambiando las reglas de la categoría.

Fabricamos en España, tenemos presencia en varios países europeos y ya trabajamos con cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados. Ahora toca ir a por más: nuevos lineales, más referencias y más cuota de lineal en las cuentas actuales.

**Por qué este puesto es especial**
-----------------------------------

* **Impacto real y visible:** tu trabajo se traduce directamente en crecimiento de la marca, desde el primer trimestre.
* **Marca con producto diferencial:** vendes un producto innovador, con una historia potente y diferente a todo lo que hay en el lineal.
* **Autonomía y confianza:** equipo pequeño, decisiones rápidas y acceso directo a la dirección. Nada de burocracia.
* **Visión completa:** trabajarás codo con codo con el Director Comercial en la estrategia de trade marketing, y con datos de mercado para argumentar cada negociación.
* **Crecimiento:** una marca en expansión europea que necesita a alguien que crezca con ella.

**Tus responsabilidades**
-------------------------

* Gestionar y desarrollar la cartera de cuentas clave del canal moderno (supermercados, hipermercados y cadenas regionales), con revisiones comerciales periódicas para supervisar el rendimiento y la ejecución.
* Negociar y cerrar acuerdos comerciales y contratos, y hacer seguimiento de la facturación.
* Abrir nuevas cuentas y conseguir la entrada en nuevos lineales, así como ampliar referencias y cuota de lineal en las cuentas existentes.
* Preparar presentaciones para compradores apoyadas en datos de mercado para demostrar potencial de ventas y distribución.
* Analizar de forma continua la posición competitiva y del cliente, y definir junto al Director Comercial la estrategia y acciones de trade marketing a corto y largo plazo.
* Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de los distintos canales de distribución.
* Coordinarte con finanzas, operaciones y administración para asegurar un servicio excelente al cliente.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

**Requisitos**

* Mínimo **4 años de experiencia como KAM** (o rol equivalente) en **productos de droguería / limpieza del hogar en canal moderno**.
* Conocimiento del sector y relación con compradores de cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados en España.
* Experiencia demostrable en negociación comercial y cierre de acuerdos con retail.
* Capacidad analítica para trabajar con datos de ventas y construir argumentos comerciales.
* Residencia en **Barcelona o Madrid**.

**Competencias**

* Dominio de técnicas de venta y negociación.
* Gran capacidad para gestionar el tiempo y priorizar; automotivación.
* Capaz de asumir responsabilidad y resolver retos de forma creativa.

**Cómo trabajamos**
-------------------

Somos un equipo joven, ambicioso y con ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Tenemos base en Barcelona y trabajamos con un modelo remote-first: buscamos a la persona en **Barcelona o Madrid**, con encuentros presenciales con el equipo que acordaremos juntos.

Aquí cada persona es una pieza clave en su función. Si quieres jugar en la liga grande de una marca que está creciendo rápido, ¡queremos conocerte!

* Experiencia en la definición de estrategias de comunicación y relaciones públicas para clientes de moda para la posición de moda y de gran consumo para la de gran consumo&lifestyle.
* Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinares.
* Experiencia en la gestión económica de clientes.

* Inglés fluido. ( valorable, catalán)

title: (PMI) Specialist – Área Laboral
description:
DESCRIPCIóN

Desde ISPROX, buscamos un/a **Especialista en Integraciones Laborales.**

Formarás parte del Core Team de integraciones de un importante grupo de servicios profesionales consolidado con más de 60 años de trayectoria que, respaldado por un fondo americano, se encuentra en un momento clave de expansión.

Con un plan de crecimiento de unas 10-15 adquisiciones de despachos al año, tu misión será gestionar la transición, homogeneización y migración operativa del área laboral de las compañías adquiridas hacia la estructura central del grupo.

  

No es un rol de gestión de nóminas del día a día; es un puesto estratégico-operativo de consultoría interna enfocado en proyectos de absorción y despliegue tecnológico.

**Tus principales retos y funciones:**

* Mapeo y Migración de Datos: Coordinar y ejecutar el traspaso masivo de históricos, fichas de trabajadores, conceptos salariales y variables desde los sistemas de los despachos adquiridos hacia el entorno centralizado del grupo.
* Estandarización Tecnológica: Asegurar la correcta implantación y configuración del ecosistema A3 en las nuevas delegaciones, optimizando los flujos de trabajo e integrando herramientas de control horario o portales del empleado.
* Auditoría Laboral (Due Diligence Operativa): Analizar el estado de las plantillas absorbidas, convenios colectivos de origen, pactos de empresa y contingencias para asegurar el cumplimiento del Art. 44 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores (Subrogación).
* Soporte Operativo Crítico: Dar apoyo directo en la confección y validación de nóminas, seguros sociales (Sistema RED) y declaraciones durante los meses críticos de transición para garantizar impacto cero en los trabajadores.
* Gestión de Proyectos (PMO): Asegurar el cumplimiento de los deadlines de cada integración, reportando hitos y riesgos al Director de Integraciones.

**¿Qué pueden ofrecerte?**

* Incorporación a un grupo empresarial con más de 60 años en activo, en un momento clave de crecimiento, expansión y automatización.
* Contrato indefinido a jornada completa de 9h a 18h y viernes hasta las 15h con 1 día de teletrabajo a la semana.
* Retribución hasta 40.000€ brutos anuales, según perfil

REQUISITOS

**¿Qué buscamos en ti?**

* Experiencia: Mínimo 3-5 años en departamentos de Laboral Outsourcing, BPO Laboral en Big4/Tier 2 o asesorías de gran volumen, gestionando migraciones o integraciones de carteras.
* Dominio experto del ecosistema A3 (A3innuva / A3asesor). Valorable conocimiento en otras plataformas del mercado.
* Conocimientos técnicos: Sólida base en legislación laboral (subrogaciones, homogeneización de condiciones, cálculo de nóminas y finiquitos) y gestión de plataformas públicas (Sistema RED, Contrat@, Delta).
* Metodología: Familiaridad con gestión de proyectos y herramientas de seguimiento. Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas de cruce de datos masivos). Muy valorable conocimientos de PMP y Agile.
* Soft Skills: Orientación a hitos y resultados, alta capacidad de adaptación al cambio, interlocución fluida y resiliencia.

title: Vice Principal of Performing and Creative Arts - August 2027 start
description:
Location:

Cadiz, ES

Date: 13 Nov 2026

Application closing date: N/A

Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

Sotogrande International School, part of the Inspired Education Group, is seeking to appoint an outstanding Vice Principal of Performing & Creative Arts to join our Senior Leadership Team from August 2027. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Drama specialist, senior educational leader and practising artist to lead the development of Performing and Creative Arts across the whole school, while launching and directing our new Elite Pathway in Performing Arts & Film for students aged 16–18.

  

Based at our new SIS Global Arts Centre, featuring a 400-seat professional theatre, dance and drama studios, music facilities and film editing suites, the successful candidate will play a key role in establishing Sotogrande International School as a leading destination for aspiring performers, artists and filmmakers.

  

In addition to this position, you may also be interested in our in-person Inspired Careers Event in London on Saturday 23rd January 2027. This school and over 30 other UK and international Inspired schools will be attending to connect with teachers seeking new roles starting from August 2027. For more information and to register, please click here: https://jobs.inspirededu.com/job-invite/10814/

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
-------------------------

* Provide strategic leadership for Drama, Music, Dance, Film & Media and Visual Arts across the whole school.
* Lead the development and implementation of a coherent arts curriculum across the IB and UK pathways.
* Design, launch and lead the new Elite Pathway in Performing Arts & Film for 2027/28, including specialist training, external qualifications and industry partnerships.
* Oversee teaching standards, curriculum development, assessment and student outcomes across the arts departments.
* Personally teach Drama on a reduced timetable, modelling outstanding teaching and professional artistic practice.
* Lead an ambitious programme of productions, performances, concerts, exhibitions, screenings and creative events.
* Build partnerships with drama schools, conservatoires, universities, theatres and creative industry organisations.
* Recruit, lead and develop teaching staff, specialist tutors, visiting practitioners and technical teams.
* Manage departmental budgets and oversee the strategic use of the SIS Global Arts Centre.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:**
----------------------------------

* A degree in Drama, Theatre, Performing Arts or a closely related subject.
* A recognised teaching qualification and QTS or equivalent.
* Extensive experience teaching Drama within the IB and UK curriculum, ideally MYP, DP Theatre and A Level.
* Proven senior leadership experience in Performing Arts or Drama.
* A strong track record of academic results, directing productions and preparing students for LAMDA, Trinity and drama school auditions.
* Professional experience in theatre, film, television or the wider performing arts, with established industry contacts.
* A practising artist with recent experience as a performer, director, writer or creative practitioner.
* Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to inspire students and colleagues.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken. Previous international school experience and Spanish language skills would be an advantage.
* Visa sponsorship can be arranged for the right candidate.

**SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT:**
---------------------------

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

Visit our careers site for more information; https://jobs.inspirededu.com

title: Conversion Oriented Copywriter
description:
En Natulim buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist – Paid Ads** que nos ayude a llevar nuestras creatividades publicitarias al siguiente nivel.

Buscamos una persona que combine **creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**: alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que **piense la creatividad de principio a fin**, desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

### **Qué harás**

* Desarrollar **conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación** para campañas de paid ads.
* Crear y testar diferentes **hooks, narrativas, claims y estructuras de vídeo** para mejorar el rendimiento de los anuncios.
* Escribir **guiones y briefs creativos** claros para producción y edición.
* Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.
* Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: **hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.**
* Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de **Performance, Content y Editing** para producir y escalar las mejores creatividades.
* Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.
* Participar en la creación de contenido tanto **short-form como long-form**, siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.
* Mantener un sistema continuo de **testing e iteración creativa**.

### **Qué buscamos**

* **2+ años de experiencia** creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.
* Experiencia real desarrollando **anuncios en vídeo para plataformas como Meta, Instagram, TikTok o YouTube**.
* Experiencia escribiendo **guiones, hooks y conceptos creativos**.
* Haber editado vídeo o tener suficiente conocimiento de edición para entender cómo llevar una idea a ejecución.
* Entender las estructuras que hacen que un vídeo funcione: **hooks, retención, ritmo, storytelling y CTA**.
* Experiencia trabajando con marcas de **e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo**.
* Capacidad para interpretar métricas de performance y convertir datos en aprendizajes creativos.
* Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.
* Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.
* **Permiso de trabajo en España.**

### **¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades (seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería).
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.  
    
  Te esperamos!

title: Marketing Technology Engineer
description:
#### **Who We Are**

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

**Working in MarTech with WPP Enterprise Solutions**

WPP Enterprise Solutions is a full-service digital agency helping ambitious brands deliver connected, personalised experiences across digital channels. Our expertise spans Marketing, Commerce, CRM, PXM and CX, enabling us to deliver end-to-end solutions with measurable impact.

Our clients include Bayer, MSD, Dyson, Johnson & Johnson, RTL, Nestlé, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein and other global brands. Our teams are based in Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Poland and India, with access to the wider WPP network worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

You'll help design and build MarTech solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and the wider Salesforce platform, working collaboratively across the wider team. Depending on the client, you may work across platforms such as Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach and Adobe, together with data and cloud technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Tealium, Segment, AWS, Azure and GCP.

**What You'll Do**

* **Design** **MarTech** **solutions:** Shape data models, integrations and technical designs that connect marketing platforms with CRM, CDP, data and cloud services.
* **Build and integrate:** Develop reliable production solutions using APIs, SQL, platform languages and general-purpose code, including queries and automation logic that support segmentation and journeys at scale.
* **Work with customer data:** Build segmentation, identity, ingestion and activation solutions, including automated, multi-step customer journeys connected to live data sources, across marketing platforms, CDPs and data warehouses.
* **Deliver maintainable solutions:** Build, test, deploy and support production code, applying appropriate version control, peer review, monitoring and recovery practices, and taking ownership of diagnosing production issues.
* **Improve existing implementations:** Review, troubleshoot, migrate and enhance solutions already running in client environments.
* **Turn requirements into solutions:** Work directly with clients and cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, make technical trade-offs and communicate solutions clearly.

**What You'll Need**

You combine software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience delivering marketing technology solutions. You do not need to know every platform we use, but you should be comfortable learning new technologies and working across systems.

*The basics:*

* **Experience:** +5 years in a similar role is required.
* **Eligibility**: You must be currently residing in Barcelona, and eligible to work without a need for a visa or work permit.
* **Software engineering:** Production experience with at least one general-purpose language such as Python, Node.js, Java, PHP or .NET. You write maintainable, tested, idempotent and bulk-safe code, with appropriate logging and error handling.
* **Data and SQL:** Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational datasets, customer profiles, segmentation and automation at scale.
* **Customer identity:** Understanding of identity resolution across fragmented sources, including deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship and profile consolidation.
* **APIs and integration:** Experience building production integrations using REST, SOAP, webhooks, batch processing or event-driven patterns. You understand retries, rate limits, failure recovery and duplicate prevention.
* **Marketing technology:** Hands-on delivery experience with an enterprise marketing, CRM or customer engagement platform such as Salesforce, Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe.
* **Web technologies:** Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with the ability to build and troubleshoot rendered customer experiences.
* **Team delivery:** Experience using version control, pull requests and peer review as part of a collaborative development process.
* **Client collaboration:** Comfortable working directly with marketing and technical stakeholders to turn business requirements into practical solutions, rather than working only through a ticket queue.

*Bonus points:*

Any of the below will definitely make you stand out!

* **Salesforce technologies:** Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Personalization, Account Engagement, Marketing Cloud Next, or Salesforce Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce and Industry Clouds
* **Other** **MarTech** **platforms:** Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe Campaign, Journey Optimizer or Marketo Engage

title: Digital Operations Team Lead - Music Rights & Royalties
description:
What you will be doing

As an Operations Team Lead, you will play a central role in guiding and empowering the Digital Operations team to deliver on its objectives. Reporting to the Head of Digital Operations and acting as their deputy, you will lead the team’s day-to-day work and oversee execution across core DSP processing and reporting pipelines, ensuring high-quality data exchange, timely royalty allocations, and strict compliance with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Your contributions will directly shape how the team runs and how we deliver DSP Processing and Reporting for our clients , making you an integral part of our team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Execute the workflows and priorities set with the Head of Digital Operations, collaborating with Business Line, Engineering, and the wider Operations team, including operational support and communication with all of our DSP Processing and Reporting clients.
* Act as deputy to the Head of Digital Operations, covering for them when needed and making operational decisions on behalf of the team. Serve as the primary escalation point for the Operations Specialist team, triaging complex queries related to catalog ingest, matching exceptions, and output generation.
* Manage agreed business priorities, task allocations, and daily operational workflows for the Digital Operations Specialist team.
* Coordinate end-to-end DSP processing cycles across major platforms (including YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, and SoundCloud).
* Oversee the organization and maintenance of strict delivery schedules.
* Mentor and train team members, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and continuous learning environment.
* Manage pre-distribution calculations, conflict resolution lifecycles, and claiming output generation

### **Collaboration and Team Dynamics**

You will work closely with the Head of Digital Operations to plan priorities, track team performance, and continuously improve how we operate. You will also collaborate with Business Line, Engineering, Product, and Partnership teams to optimize system reliability and operational scale. These collaborations are pivotal for achieving our organizational goals and ensuring effective communication and alignment across different areas of the company.

 **Requirements**

All about you

* Preferably 5+ years of experience in Music Industry Operations.
* Experience in managing a team or related roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Demonstrate understanding of music copyrights principles, practices, and relevant regulations.
* Deep familiarity with music metadata standards, Common Works Registration (CWR), DDEX Digital Sales Reports (DSRs), etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational requirements clearly across diverse global teams.
* Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze large volumes of usage data, diagnose root causes of operational discrepancies, and design efficient process solutions.
* Proficiency working with complex data platforms (YouTube CMS/Content ID), Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets, SQL querying, and SFTP data exchange protocol.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Demonstrate adaptability and openness to feedback and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and high-stakes client deadlines.
* Fluency in English. Proficiency in Spanish and Catalan is highly appreciated, but not mandatory.
* The role is located in Barcelona. Local candidates are preferred, but remote work arrangements may be considered.

### **Expectations of the role**

Within 30 Days:

During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarizing yourself with essential aspects of the role and supporting foundational tasks.

* Familiarize yourself thoroughly with BMAT’s core operating platforms and DSP processing lifecycle standards.
* Align with the Head of Digital Operations on team priorities, ways of working, and responsibilities.
* Establish working relationships with direct reports and key cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships.
* Assume day-to-day oversight of operational queues and SLA tracking for core processing clients

Within 60 Days:

By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team and strategic initiatives.

* Autonomously manage daily task distribution, priority queues, and technical escalations for the Digital Operations team.
* Lead high-priority client distribution cycles, ensuring 100% on-time delivery of claim files, pre-distribution reports, and DIF files.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement automated matching QA rules and streamline conflict resolution tracking.
* Facilitate the transition of routine client invoicing workflows from Partnerships to Operations in collaboration with Finance.

Within 90 Days:

At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to autonomously manage tasks, contribute to strategic planning, and take on leadership roles as appropriate.

* Autonomously manage team operations, performance evaluations, continuous training, and skill development.
* Drive measurable improvements in operational throughput, team capacity, and SLA compliance across all Tier 1 and Tier 2 DSP accounts.
* Represent Digital Operations in cross-departmental readiness reviews and platform feature validations.

  
**Benefits**  

### **You Can Enjoy**

* Flexible working hours and location
* Flat hierarchy
* You can make the role your own and run your own development
* Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
* Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
* We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
* Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/  

  

### **Who the FAQ are BMAT**

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

*Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.*

description:

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. * **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.
* **Protect acquisition quality.** Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.
* **Keep the subscription running smoothly.** Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.
* **Stay aligned with Customer Service.** Turn recurring ticket themes into fixes, and close the loop with CS when they ship.

**Skills & experience**
-----------------------

**Must have**

* 1+ years in consumer product development, merchandising or brand management, ideally with craft kits, hobby products or subscription boxes.
* A track record of products you chose or developed, and how customers responded: ratings, sell-through, repeat purchases, returns.
* A hands-on maker. You craft yourself, and you can make a kit and judge its difficulty, instructions and quality.
* Supplier experience: sourcing samples, negotiating, and working to cost targets and lead times.
* Taste grounded in customers. You use reviews and feedback to decide, not only your own preferences.
* Ownership across teams. You push work through with marketing, CS, design, inventory and operations without being chased.
* Comfort with numbers. You can read a retention table and question a figure that looks too good, connect reason with outcome based on numbers
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running a subscription box.
* Experience writing craft instructions.
* An active presence in craft communities or social media.
* Experience with Shopify.
* Spreadsheet analysis skills.

* Test Task

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

title: Content Marketer (SEO & AI Search)
description:
**Join Reach as our Content Marketer (focused on SEO & AI Search)!**
You'll define what content engineering at the highest level looks like, then execute it for some of the best companies in the world. You'll shape how our proprietary platform automates content workflows, deciding what scales with humans and what scales with software. And as we grow, you'll build a team to scale production without sacrificing quality.
  
  
This is not a traditional content manager role. You'll combine deep SEO knowledge, advanced AI-powered production workflows, visual design skills, and LinkedIn content expertise to produce and scale high-quality content across our entire customer portfolio and for Reach itself.
  
  
**About Reach**
At Reach we're building the operating system to help companies monitor and control their visibility in AI search. We built a proprietary platform that combines our software, custom AI agents, and forward-deployed experts from the top 1% in organic growth (SEO & AEO), to help companies show up when buyers are researching and comparing solutions on Google and inside AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and turn that visibility into pipeline and revenue.
  
  
We reached $1.4M ARR in 14 months, basically bootstrapped, and we're scaling to $10M ARR by the end of 2027. We've been doing this for companies like ColdIQ ($7M ARR, #1 Clay worldwide sales agency), Indie Campers ($140M+ ARR), Carro, Fidelidade, Fraudio, Noxus and others.
  
  
A few recent results:
  
  

* Grew Indie Campers' revenue attributed to AI search by +1,318.62% YoY (14x) and organic search revenue by +7.85% YoY across 2025, delivered during a full website migration. Read the case study.
* Helped ColdIQ influence $506K in signed contract value from organic and AI search in ~4 months, making SEO and AI search their #1 traffic source with organic traffic up 7.3x. Read the case study.
* Took Carro from a 0% to 34.58% AI citation rate (4.5x the nearest competitor) and the #3 most-cited domain in their category, now consistently closing 7-figure deals sourced from AI search. Read the case study.

You can see more of the results we drive for our customers here.
  
  
We're turning services into software to disrupt the $100B+ SEO/AI Search market, which will get drastically bigger as search behavior shifts to AI and ad budgets follow.
  
  
"The global SEO and AEO services market will grow to $171 billion by 2030 from $81.4 billion last year", Wall Street Journal
  
  
**The team**
We're a team of founders, AI engineers, and SEO & AEO specialists passionate about creating a category defining company that moves fast and has fun doing it.
  
  
Here's a look at what life on the team is like. This is our latest company retreat:
  
  
Our founders have a proven track record of building and scaling fast growing tech companies. Jose Velez (CEO) was the solo founder & CEO of Rely.io, an internal developer portal used by top engineering orgs like ESPN Bet and Feedzai, and launched AI products that reached #1 Product of the Day and #1 AI Product of the month on Product Hunt. He raised $3.6M from top-tier firms like J12 Ventures, Shilling Capital Partners, Techstars NYC, and TheVentureCity, as well as from notable angels.
  
  
Bernardo Ferreira (founding AI search strategist) led the strategy behind more than
**250M organic visits**
and
**€100M in revenue attributed to SEO**
at Worten (think Iberian Amazon) in 2024.
  
  
**Location**
For this role, we're open to it being remote, mainly because we're growing fast and we can't afford to limit ourselves. That said, we care deeply about working in person.
  
  
If you can work alongside us from our Lisbon hub, that's our preference:
  
  
→ Lisbon: with the founding team day-to-day, plus regular travel to the US.
  
  
If you can move to Lisbon, we'll support relocation including visa sponsorship where possible.
  
  
Either way, expect to travel a lot.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a builder-leader: someone who sets a new standard for what SEO content production looks like in the AI era, and then builds the systems and team to scale it.
  
  
You will own three things:
  
  

* Define What Content Engineering at the Highest Level Looks Like, and Execute It

This is not about pasting a keyword into ChatGPT and editing the output. You'll build the workflows, set the bar, and ship content for some of the best companies in the world.
  
  

* Build and use advanced AI content pipelines. Use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, and whatever tools give you leverage to produce content at 5-10x the pace of a traditional content team, with higher quality. Show us your setup. If you can't walk us through your AI workflow and impress us with how you use it for research, drafting, editing, analysis, and optimization, you won't pass the interview.
* Ship content that drives revenue, not just rankings. Blog posts, comparison pages, use case pages, landing pages, how-to guides, community responses for Reddit, Quora, and G2. Every piece of content is optimized for both search engines and AI models, on-brand, accurate, and genuinely useful for the target buyer.
* Create visual content that gets saved and shared. LinkedIn infographics, data visualizations, carousels, comparison graphics, process diagrams. You don't just write. You design. You need a strong eye and the ability to produce polished visual content quickly using tools like Figma, Canva, or equivalent.
* Write LinkedIn content that generates pipeline. Posts for Jose's personal brand, Reach's company page, and customer accounts. You understand hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and what drives B2B engagement on LinkedIn.
* Set the quality bar. Excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries. Deep on-page SEO knowledge: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, content structure. Every piece you ship is the reference standard for what "great" looks like.
* Improve our platform and the content system

Your expertise doesn't just serve customers. It becomes the product.
  
  

* Be the power user who shapes the AI content tools. You'll use our AI agents daily for content production. Your feedback on what works, what's slow, and what's missing directly influences the product roadmap.
* Identify what scales with humans vs. what scales with software. Some content requires editorial judgment, deep brand knowledge, and creative thinking. Some content can be templated, automated, or generated programmatically. You'll help us draw that line correctly, and push it further every month.
* Build workflows that scale. Create templates, processes, and automations that let you produce 15-20 pieces of optimized content per month across multiple customer accounts without dropping quality. Document everything so it's transferable.
* Close the loop with Strategy and Engineering. Work with our Growth Strategists to translate content briefs and action plans into finished, published content. Feed patterns back to Engineering: what should the agents handle, what needs human attention, and where the gaps are.
* Push the boundaries of programmatic content. If there's a way to generate structured, high-quality pages at scale using data and templates, find it. If a content type can be partially automated, build the workflow. Always with quality as the non-negotiable.
* Build and Lead a Team of World-Class Content Engineers

As we scale, you'll grow from individual contributor to team leader.
  
  

* Recruit and develop content talent. Hire people who combine writing ability, SEO depth, AI tooling mastery, and speed. Build a team that's genuinely better than any agency's content team.
* Hands-on leadership. Jump into content production, quality reviews, and customer accounts. Model excellence through action, not just direction.
* Build scalable systems. Create onboarding, training, and quality assurance processes that let new team members ramp fast and produce at your standard. Maintain customer knowledge bases that power personalized content generation.
* Manage multi-customer production. Coordinate content production across a portfolio of customers with different brands, voices, industries, and priorities. Ensure nothing slips.
* Define the craft. "Content engineer" is a new role. You'll define what it means, what the career path looks like, and how the best content engineers in the world work.

**Signs you’re a great fit…**

* You have 3+ years of experience producing SEO content for B2B/SaaS companies, with proven ranking and traffic results.
* You're an excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries.
* You have an advanced AI workflow that goes far beyond "use ChatGPT to draft." You use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, or similar tools, and you can show us a setup that's genuinely impressive.
* You understand on-page SEO deeply: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, and content structure.
* You can work with data and analytics: GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and use them to prioritize what content to create or optimize.
* You have a strong design eye and can create infographics, LinkedIn visuals, and web pages that look polished and professional.
* You understand what works on LinkedIn: hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and engagement patterns.
* You're fast, organized, and can manage content production across multiple customers simultaneously without dropping quality.
* You use AI tools extensively and are obsessive about improving your setup.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience with programmatic SEO or templated content at scale
* Proficiency in Figma, Framer, Webflow, or similar design/web tools
* Experience writing content that targets AI search visibility (structured for LLM consumption)
* Technical comfort with Markdown, HTML, CSS, or light scripting
* A portfolio of LinkedIn infographics or visual content you've created
* Experience at a content-led agency or a startup where you owned the full content pipeline
* You've built content processes or playbooks that scaled a team's output
* Our job titles may encompass various career levels, and the actual base pay for this position will be determined based on multiple factors including training, transferable skills, work experience, business requirements, and market conditions. Additionally, this role is eligible for equity and comprehensive benefits.

============

We are a robotics and AI company building intelligent, adaptable systems that solve problems traditional automation never could. From Barcelona, our mission is to create a generation-defining company leading the robotics revolution.

We recently closed the largest robotics Series A in Europe's history, and we're looking for the top 0.01% of talent to take on that mission with us, and build the biggest company in the world.

**Your role**
=============

We are looking for a Head of Content to run THEKER's content operation from request to delivery. You will receive what the company needs from marketing, decide what comes first and make sure it ships on time and on brand. This is an operations and management role with a strong eye for brand. You won't be designing or editing yourself, but you will know good work when you see it.

You will be the single point of contact for marketing requests across THEKER, from videos and photos to presentations and events. You will turn each request into a clear brief, assign it to the right person in the content team and follow it through to delivery. You will also own the materials our sales team uses with clients and keep them current and consistent.

Day to day, you will manage the team's timeline and keep several projects moving at once. You will work with the founders and with every team from engineering to sales. You will also track what each channel delivers and propose new actions, from trade fairs to formats we haven't tried yet. Success means every request has an owner and a date, and sales trusts every material it sends.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We are looking for a hybrid profile: part creative director, part motion designer, part AI-native creator and part team leader.

You should have:
