* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

**Job Details**

* People & Talent
* Barcelona, Spain
* Full-Time / Hybrid

**What you will do**

As a **Senior HR Business Partner** at Lighthouse, you'll partner with directors, vice presidents and leadership teams across Revenue and Marketing to shape people strategy and turn business priorities into practical action. This is a hands-on advisory role, combining workforce redesign and talent development with performance management and complex employee relations. Within an AI-native People & Talent function, you'll use people analytics and tools such as Claude to connect signals across clusters and bring leaders clear recommendations. You'll challenge assumptions, help leaders own their decisions and measure success by whether the business makes better decisions about its people because of your involvement.

**Where you will have impact**

* Partner with senior Revenue and Marketing leadership teams to shape people strategy and translate business priorities into quarterly people plans and targeted projects.
* Lead workforce redesign conversations as artificial intelligence changes roles, structures and capability needs, helping leaders decide what should change and put those decisions into practice.
* Partner closely with business leaders on change management and communication, shaping clear messages, preparing managers for team conversations and supporting employees through organisational transitions.
* Guide managers at all levels through feedback, performance improvement plans and performance calibration, in collaboration with People Operations.
* Advise on compensation, promotions, development and retention, addressing underperformance while helping strong performers succeed.
* Coach managers, strengthen leader onboarding and provide a confidential space for complex concerns, exercising judgment about when to escalate or involve others.
* Lead complex, sensitive employee relations cases as the senior escalation point for the portfolio, partnering with People Operations and involving Legal when needed.
* Challenge hiring profiles, levels, budgets and timelines constructively in partnership with Talent Acquisition.
* Synthesise engagement, attrition, performance, compensation and employee relations signals across clusters into business recommendations, using AI for analysis and pattern recognition and building simple dashboards where needed.
* Contribute to the design of performance, development, engagement and workforce planning programmes, bringing cluster insight into approaches that work in the business.
* Identify cross-cluster patterns that signal organisation-wide risk or opportunity and bring a clear recommendation to the Director of Talent Enablement.

**About our team**

You'll work closely with fellow HR Business Partners, People Operations and Talent Acquisition to support Revenue and Marketing leaders across Europe, the United States and Asia-Pacific. The work combines direct communication, practical manager support and a broader view of the business, with flexibility to organise your week around stakeholders in different time zones.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices.
* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.
* Payflow App: Access your earned salary in advance at no cost to you.
* Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery.
* Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription.
* Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
* Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* Experience partnering with Revenue teams in an international organisation, with an understanding of commercial pressures.
* Credibility advising directors and vice presidents on people strategy, organisation design and workforce change, alongside hands-on performance management experience.
* Clear, concise communication and senior stakeholder influence, including the ability to present recommendations, challenge assumptions and maintain a constructive position under pressure.
* Data storytelling skills that connect signals across clusters, distinguish local issues from organisation-wide patterns and build a business case for action.
* Understanding of how artificial intelligence reshapes roles, team structures and capability needs, and the ability to guide leaders through workforce redesign decisions.
* Generative AI fluency for synthesis, pattern recognition and insight generation, including basic analysis and HTML dashboards, with sound judgment about the limitations of AI outputs.
* Experience independently managing complex employee relations cases with significant business, legal or reputational dimensions, including knowing when to escalate or involve Legal.
* Ability to hold a multi-cluster portfolio in view while remaining hands-on, adapting to changing priorities and organising work across time zones.

**We welcome**

* International Revenue partnering experience from outside SaaS; SaaS experience is helpful, not required.
* Experience contributing to or designing HR frameworks, programmes or operating models.
* Familiarity with organisation design methods, including responsibility mapping, spans of control and role design principles.
* First-hand experience supporting a function through significant AI-driven transformation.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. title: Digital Workplace Operations Director, Madrid (M, ES)
description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

As Digital Workplace Operations Director, you will be accountable for the global delivery, performance and evolution of Swiss Re's employee workplace technology operations. Your scope spans Workplace Service Management, remote second-level support, onsite Field Services across Swiss Re locations, workplace hardware lifecycle services, and meeting room and multimedia technology support. You will lead a geographically distributed organization and govern the outcomes delivered by internal teams and external service partners.

This is a senior enterprise leadership role with end-to-end accountability for service reliability, employee experience, operational risk, service economics and transformation. You will set a consistent global operating model, connect workplace products and engineering with day-to-day delivery, and ensure employees experience one integrated service regardless of location, channel or provider.

You will drive the shift from reactive support to proactive, data-led operations through automation, self-service, knowledge management and AI-enabled support. Success requires a leader who has already managed comparable global operations, developed strong leadership teams and taken executive decisions during business-critical incidents and complex change.

**Key Responsibilities:**

You will have global leadership accountability for Workplace Operations, its people, service outcomes, delivery partners and continual improvement.

**Digital Employee Experience, Operational Intelligence and Product Improvement**

* You will establish a customer-centric, data-driven approach to Digital Workplace Operations, ensuring that operational insights and employee experience continuously inform product and engineering priorities.
* You will bring together service performance data, incident and problem trends, digital employee experience telemetry and direct employee feedback to identify systemic issues, recurring friction and opportunities for improvement.
* Working closely with Product and Engineering leaders, you will establish a structured feedback loop that translates these insights into actionable engineering priorities, addressing underlying product, platform and integration weaknesses rather than relying on operational workarounds or repeated support interventions.
* You will ensure that improvements are measured against tangible outcomes, including reduced incident recurrence, lower support demand, improved employee productivity and experience, and sustainable reductions in operational cost.

**Global workplace operations and service ownership**

* Set and execute the global Workplace Operations strategy, service portfolio and operating model across service management, remote support, regional onsite support and multimedia services, with clear responsibilities and consistent standards.
* Own end-to-end service delivery outcomes and the interfaces across the enterprise Service Desk (first level), remote second-level support, onsite teams, engineering specialists and managed-service providers.
* Translate business priorities into measurable service objectives, service catalogues, location coverage and capacity plans, balancing global consistency with justified local requirements.

**Regional Field Services and employee technology lifecycle**

* Lead onsite technology support across the Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific, including executive and business-critical support, ensuring effective regional leadership, service continuity and a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee operational delivery of end-user hardware throughout provisioning, onboarding, deployment, replacement, recovery, reuse and secure retirement, including inventory availability and demand planning in partnership with Engineering, Procurement and suppliers.
* Ensure technology readiness and support for meeting rooms, multimedia services, office openings, moves and closures, and major employee events, in coordination with relevant workplace and infrastructure teams.

**Service management, quality and operational resilience**

* Lead Workplace service-management governance and operational performance across incident, major incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service-level and service-transition practices, aligned with enterprise processes.
* Ensure effective escalation, restoration and communication during major disruptions; drive rigorous root-cause analysis, permanent remediation and a reduction in recurring incidents and avoidable service demand.
* Establish meaningful service levels and experience measures (SLAs, XLAs and operational KPIs), and maintain a transparent view of quality, reliability, employee impact, risk, demand and improvement priorities.

**Security, controls and governance**

* Ensure workplace services operate within applicable security, privacy, regulatory and internal-control requirements, with clear operational ownership for risk, vulnerabilities, privileged support access and third-party obligations.
* Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, management actions, service-continuity arrangements and supplier resilience, ensuring risks are raised early, remediation is effective and accountability is clear.

**Managed services, commercial and financial leadership**

* Own Workplace Operations financial planning and performance, including operational budgets, forecasts, service cost drivers, workforce and supplier spend, investment cases and sustainable cost optimization.
* Lead strategic partner governance, sourcing and service transitions; manage vendors against contracted outcomes, quality, experience, innovation and value rather than resource counts alone.
* Maintain effective oversight of workplace technology assets, service contracts and relevant licence consumption, partnering with Finance, Procurement and product owners on lifecycle cost and value.

**Transformation and employee experience**

* Build an evidence-led improvement roadmap that uses employee feedback, digital experience telemetry, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted operations to reduce friction, prevent incidents and improve productivity.
* Own operational assurance and readiness for workplace transformations, large-scale technology deployments and provider changes, ensuring credible delivery capacity, support acceptance, communication, hypercare and business continuity.
* Strengthen the experience of critical employee journeys, including joining, moving, changing devices, seeking support and leaving, with measurable gains in quality, speed, cost and satisfaction.

**Organizational and executive leadership**

* Lead and develop a multi-region organization of 150+ employees through its service-management, regional Field Services and multimedia leaders; shape structure, talent, succession, workforce planning, performance and a culture of accountability.
* Serve as a member of the Digital Workplace leadership team and partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, HR, Facilities, Finance and business leaders to resolve cross-functional issues and translate strategy into reliable operations.
* Act as the senior escalation and decision point for critical service matters, communicating clearly with executives and making balanced decisions across employee experience, cost, risk, speed and resilience.

**About the team**

In GSTP Digital Workplace, we make it easy for Swiss Re employees to use their digital workplace to connect seamlessly with people, ideas and expertise across the company and beyond. We focus on translating internal client needs into workplace products and services that improve productivity, enable flexibility and support secure ways of working.

Digital Workplace provides the products, services and support that enable Swiss Re's workforce to work from anywhere, anytime, in a stable and secure environment. This includes collaboration, productivity, endpoints, workplace foundations, governance and emerging workplace capabilities such as AI.

Workplace Operations is the global delivery and service-management capability behind that experience. It brings together remote and onsite user support, global Field Services, multimedia technology services and operational governance, in close partnership with the engineering and product organizations accountable for the technology platforms.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you are already an established senior leader of large-scale, global IT operations or Digital Workplace / End User Services. You bring direct accountability for a comparable operation, not only individual service-management processes, engineering platforms or transformation programmes.

You have led leaders across regions and time zones, managed significant internal and outsourced service capacity, and improved service quality while controlling cost and operational risk. You are credible with engineers and service providers, but you measure success through employee productivity, reliable services and business outcomes.

You combine executive presence, sound judgement and calm incident leadership with the ability to build a strong organization. You know when to challenge, when to empower and how to turn operational evidence into clear priorities and decisions.

**You have:**

* 15+ years in enterprise IT operations or Digital Workplace, including several years as a Director or Head of a significant global service organization.
* Prior end-to-end accountability for global remote support, onsite Field Services, service governance and strategic outsourced service providers.

* Proven experience establishing data-driven operational improvement capabilities, using service analytics, digital employee experience telemetry and customer feedback to influence product roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Operations, Product and Engineering to eliminate recurring issues at their root cause, reduce support demand and improve the end-to-end employee experience.
* A proven record of leading managers across regions, building effective teams and developing talent, succession and delivery accountability.
* Deep practical knowledge of IT service management (ITIL / ITSM), major incidents, problem and change management, service transition, ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and measurable service and experience outcomes.
* Strong commercial and financial leadership, including substantial operating budgets, outcome-based managed-service contracts, supplier negotiation, service cost optimization and sourcing decisions.
* Demonstrated delivery of operational modernization with measurable improvements through automation, self-service, AI-enabled support, digital employee experience insights and continuous improvement.
* A strong understanding of workplace endpoint and collaboration technology, device and asset lifecycles, field support and multimedia services, sufficient to challenge technical and commercial decisions.
* Experience managing security, regulatory controls, audits, operational resilience and risk in a complex enterprise; experience in financial services or another regulated industry is advantageous.
* Credibility with senior executives and the ability to coordinate decisions across Technology, Security, Finance, Procurement and business stakeholders while protecting service continuity during change.

For Spain the **base salary range** for this position is between EUR 98,000 and EUR 163,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
* the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Senior sales team, product, engineering, operations (customer delivery) teams

### **Profile and Skills**

* **Experience:** 4-7 years of proven success in a **high-growth enterprise SaaS sales hunter or new-business acquisition role**—specifically targeting large retail, grocery, or complex operational environments in EMEA.
* **Sourcing Prowess:** A demonstrated history of **self-sourcing pipeline** and consistently meeting or exceeding net-new revenue targets.

  + *Ownership & Drive:* Relentless drive for results, owning the new business outcome from the first touch to the signed contract.
  + *Problem Solving:* Ability to navigate long sales cycles and pivot strategy when facing roadblocks.
  + *Collaboration:* Brings cross-functional internal resources together effectively to orchestrate a winning deal.

**About****Everseen**

Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world - including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths - we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell.

We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact.

title: Senior Graphic Designer and Brand Steward
GESTOR/A ESPECIALISTA COMUNICACIÓN AUDIOVISUAL ÁREA DE MEDIOS (BARCELONA)
Head of Retention & Customer Experience
description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

title: Global Head of Data Intelligence, Analytics and IA (EMEA)
description:
### **El Rol**

Esta posición lidera la unidad global de Inteligencia (Medición, Datos, Martech y Reportería) y dirige equipos de Data Science, Data Engineering, Social Media Analysts y Analistas de Datos distribuidos globalmente. Su misión es convertir datos estructurados y no estructurados en insights accionables, definir metodologías y marcos de gobernanza, y actuar como enlace entre la sede central y los mercados regionales para asegurar la ejecución impecable de programas estratégicos de transformación impulsados por IA.

Además, garantiza que los proyectos de clientes —relacionados con la extracción de datos de todos los canales del ecosistema digital, análisis, visualización y mejoramiento con IA— se lleven a cabo con el mejor equipo, las mejores herramientas y prácticas de clase mundial.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* Supervisar ingeniería de datos: diseño de modelos y pipelines (batch/streaming), integración de fuentes (social, CRM, web/app, e-commerce, ventas), confiabilidad y costos en la nube.
* Construir y evolucionar modelos de datos y análisis (descriptivo, predictivo y prescriptivo) aplicados a personalización, optimización de campañas y forecasting.
* Impulsar analítica de marketing multicanal (paid/owned/earned, CRM), social listening avanzado y dashboards ejecutivos automatizados.

* Garantizar IA responsable: ética, transparencia y cumplimiento normativo en todos los desarrollos y activaciones.
* Desarrollar aceleradores (dashboards, pipelines, agentes de IA) que automaticen procesos y faciliten la extracción, análisis y activación de datos a escala.

  
**Requirements**  

* +7 años liderando equipos de análisis de datos/IA en contextos globales o multicountry, con historial de programas de transformación a escala.
* Experiencia definiendo metodologías, gobernanza y estándares de servicio (KPIs/SLAs).
* Capacidad probada para dirigir equipos multidisciplinarios (data science, data engineering, BI, research, martech) y alinear múltiples stakeholders.

### **Aportarás conocimiento/experiencia en:**

* Social Listening (Sprinklr, Youscan, Brandwatch , Sprout Social,) y analítica de RRSS.
* Métricas de campañas (digital & rrss), performance marketing.
* Entendimiento de Salesforce Marketing Cloud y ecosistema CRM (journeys, audiences, activación).
* Administración de bases de datos SQL y NoSQL; diseño de modelos de datos y data quality.
* Social Web APIs y conectores de publicidad/analytics.
* Herramientas End-to-end como DOMO, u otras
* Soluciones de AI, Gemini, GPT 5, Perplexity, Claude

### **Deseable conocimiento en:**

* Programación en Python y/o R (ideal ambos); construcción de pipelines (APIs/ETL/ELT), orquestación (Airflow/Prefect) y versionado (Git).
* Social Web APIs y conectores de publicidad/analytics.
* Cloud solutions: AWS, GCP, MS Azure (Data Lake/Warehouse, Functions, Orchestration).
* Visualización: Tableau, Power BI y/o D3.js; diseño de dashboards ejecutivos.
* Modelado causal, diseño de experimentos y evaluación de impacto.

### **Habilidades y comportamientos**

* Capacidad para cruzar y enriquecer información de diversas fuentes (social, CRM, web/app, e-commerce, ventas, brand tracking, call center).
* Pensamiento estructurado y síntesis de alta complejidad; orientación a impacto y valor de negocio.
* Storytelling ejecutivo y comunicación clara con audiencias técnicas y no técnicas.
* Liderazgo , proactividad y foco en mejora continua/eficiencia.
* Inglés avanzado (presentaciones y workshops con audiencias globales).

  
**Benefits**  

* Un contrato indefinido con Findasense España, con un período de prueba de 6 meses.
* ¡23 días hábiles de vacaciones! Sumando el día libre de tu cumpleaños, para que lo puedas disfrutar como te parezca
* Seguro médico y dental privado de calidad, en Findasense nos preocupamos por tu bienestar.

* ¡Retribución flexible en tarjetas restaurante, transporte y guardería de Cobee!
* Podrás trabajar desde casa, desde el espacio de coworking, desde otra oficina de Findasense o cualquier parte del mundo, en línea con nuestra política Hybrid Way of Work.
* También, puedes traer a tu mascota a la oficina.

title: Senior Transformative & Sustainable Sourcing Manager
description:
**Your Role**

We are looking for a Senior **Transformative & Sustainable Sourcing Manager** to lead the implementation of our sustainable sourcing strategy across the business. Reporting to the Procurement Director, with close colaboration with the Global Head of Sustainability and Group's CoE, you will the translate sustainability strategic roadmap ambitions into practical sourcing solutions, working closely with suppliers, category teams and key internal stakeholders to deliver measurable environmental, social and commercial value.

**What you will do**

Sustainable Sourcing Strategy & Delivery

* Own and deliver the sustainable sourcing roadmap for the business unit, aligning Group sustainability targets with sourcing strategies and business priorities.
* Define KPIs, monitor progress and drive continuous improvement to ensure sustainability commitments are achieved.

Supplier Partnerships & Risk Management

* Build strategic partnerships with key suppliers to accelerate sustainability initiatives and improve ESG performance.
* Assess and mitigate environmental, social, regulatory and supply chain risks across the ingredient portfolio.
* Support the integration of sustainability criteria into sourcing decisions, negotiations and supplier management.

Innovation & Alternative Sourcing Models

* Identify and develop innovative sourcing approaches that improve sustainability, resilience and long-term value creation.
* Lead pilot projects, evaluate business cases and scale successful initiatives.

Funding, Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Explore external funding opportunities that support sustainable sourcing investments.
* Ensure robust sustainability data, reporting and regulatory compliance.
* Partner with Marketing, R&D, Finance and other functions to translate sourcing achievements into credible sustainability claims and business outcomes.

**What we are looking for**

* 8+ years of experience in sustainable sourcing, procurement, supply chain sustainability or related fields.
* Experience within FMCG, food & beverage, petcare, agriculture or ingredient sourcing environments.
* Proven success leading complex, cross-functional sustainability or procurement initiatives.
* Strong understanding of sustainability regulations and frameworks, including Scope 3 emissions, SBTi and supply chain due diligence requirements.
* Experience in supplier engagement, risk assessment and sustainability programme implementation.
* Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to connect sustainability initiatives to business value.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Fluent English.
* Willingness to travel up to 30%.

**What we offer**

* Hybrid working model
* Flexible working hours
* Ticket Restaurants
* Pension plan
* Fully equipped Gym

title: Retail Marketing Manager
description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. Nuestra misión nos invita a conectar con nuestro consumidor de una manera significativa, a través de la creación de contenido, de historias inspiradoras y de productos icónicos de alta calidad, responsables con el medioambiente.

No solo somos una marca, ¡SOMOS UN ESTILO DE VIDA! y queremos influir positivamente en el mundo.

¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

**El puesto**

Buscamos un perfil de Retail Marketing Manager con experiencia en moda o retail que haga de la tienda física el corazón de cada campaña. Reportarás directamente al Head of Marketing y serás quien conecte marca, tienda y negocio en España y Portugal.

Si te gusta pisar tienda, entender al cliente y ver cómo una campaña se convierte en entradas y ventas, este puesto es para ti.

Tu contribución en blue banana brand será excepcional si desarrollas estas funciones:

**La tienda física como eje**

* Convertir los objetivos de marketing en planes de trade marketing para España y Portugal, con prioridades, calendario, presupuesto y KPIs: captar nuevas audiencias, aumentar los clientes activos, generar awareness, vender la nueva colección por género, atraer tráfico a tienda y mejorar el lifetime value y el rendimiento del canal retail.
* Llevar esos planes del retail calendar a campañas omnicanal con la tienda como eje, con un mensaje claro para el cliente y conectadas de forma coherente con digital, CRM y PR.
* Liderar de principio a fin las acciones en El Corte Inglés, centros comerciales, outlets y pop-up stores, coordinándote con Brand, Visual y Retail, y con los equipos de marketing de cada canal, para crear planes a medida y medibles.
* Asegurar la coherencia entre marca y acción comercial en todos los puntos de venta, en el resto de canales y en ambos mercados.

**Cada canal, con su estrategia**

* Conocer a fondo cómo funciona cada canal y quién compra en él: tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales.
* Adaptar cada campaña a la realidad y al presupuesto de cada canal: espacios y formatos disponibles, normativas de implantación, calendarios comerciales y acciones conjuntas con centros comerciales y grandes almacenes.
* Seguir los resultados de cada canal y campaña (tráfico, conversión, ticket medio, unidades por ticket, ventas por tienda y captación de clientes), detectar desviaciones y proponer ajustes para la siguiente activación.

**Mano a mano con Visual**

* Trabajar con Visual para que marca y negocio vayan de la mano en tienda: escaparates, PLV, señalética, ratio de atracción, categorización por familias y conversión.
* Definir qué necesita cada canal y cada tienda, para producir materiales eficaces y con el coste justo.
* Medir el impacto de escaparates y materiales en el comportamiento del cliente y en las ventas, y aplicar lo aprendido en las siguientes campañas.
* Preparar kits de campaña y guías de implantación claras para los equipos de tienda, junto a Retail y Operaciones.

**El cliente en el centro**

* Entender qué busca el cliente en cada tienda: por qué compra, cómo se mueve y qué le hace volver. Para ello combinarás datos, el feedback de los equipos de tienda y el análisis del mercado, la competencia y las tendencias.
* Trabajar con el equipo de CRM en la estrategia de cliente (nuevos y fieles) con foco en tienda: captación en el punto de venta, recurrencia y nuestro club Adventure Pass.

**Datos, reporting y presupuesto**

* Medir la rentabilidad de cada inversión por canal y por campaña, y priorizar con datos lo que más impacto tiene.
* Preparar el reporting para dirección y comité: cuadro de mando semanal, informe mensual y recaps de las campañas clave del retail calendar.
* Ser owner del presupuesto y de los objetivos de retail marketing.
* Usar la IA para analizar, decidir y convertir ideas en campañas.
* Impulsar una cultura de medición y mejora continua, y hacer visible el impacto de marketing en el negocio.

**¿Qué te hará triunfar con nosotros?**

* Más de 6 años en marketing en empresas de moda o retail. Valoramos la experiencia en entornos internacionales.
* Al menos 4 años como Retail Marketing Manager, Trade Marketing Manager o Marketing Manager con responsabilidad sobre el punto de venta, con experiencia en:

  + Campañas 360 con foco en tienda física.
  + Tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales, coordinándote con sus equipos de marketing.
  + Visual merchandising: escaparates, PLV y materiales de punto de venta.
  + Análisis de ventas y KPIs de tienda por canal.
  + Cliente, hábitos de compra, CRM y loyalty.
  + Gestión de presupuesto y cumplimiento de objetivos.
* Dominio de Shopify, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint (imprescindible).
* Uso de herramientas de IA para análisis, gestión y reporting.
* Valorable: Smile y Klaviyo.
* Español e inglés, hablado y escrito. El portugués será un plus.

**Lo que te define**

* Te gusta pisar tienda y entiendes cómo se vive una campaña en cada canal.
* Piensas con datos y con estrategia.
* Tienes creatividad, sobre todo a la hora de ejecutar.
* Tienes visión de negocio y vas a por resultados.
* Planificas, priorizas y sigues tus KPIs de cerca.
* Sabes influir y trabajar con muchos equipos: Visual, Retail, tiendas y los equipos de marketing de cada canal.
* Tienes iniciativa, autonomía y mentalidad ganadora.

**¿Te preguntas qué ganas al unirte a nosotrxs? ¡Aquí van nuestros beneficios!**

**️ Estilo X:** Accede a todos nuestros productos con un **50% de descuento** desde el primer día y disfruta de **bonos de regalo por temporada**. ¿Lo mejor? También puedes **compartir un 30%** de descuento con tus personas más cercanas.

**️ Flexibilidad y conciliación:** En blue banana, entendemos que los tiempos cambian. Con un **modelo híbrido del 40% de teletrabajo** semanal y en épocas estivales, **flexibilidad en entrada y salida.** Además, el **día de tu cumpleaños** es para disfrutarlo, ¡aquí lo tendrás libre!

**️ Evoluciona con nosotros:** En blue banana, las personas son el centro. Cada persona vive su propio viaje profesional, con feedback constante, a través de nuestro **Adventure Career Plan** personalizado y formación continua.

**️ Cuidamos de ti:** Priorizamos la salud con nuestro programa de bienestar. **Wellhub** ofrece experiencias únicas para cuidar cuerpo y mente.

**️ Teambuildings épicos**: Inspiramos a nuevas generaciones y a nuestros trabajadores a hacer de su vida una aventura con **eventos únicos** y nuestras **blue banana expert talks**, donde podrás escuchar y sacar inspiración de grandes profesionales alineados con nuestra marca.

**️ Espíritu Z:** Únete a un proyecto con un equipo inconformista y lleno de experiencia donde te sentirás rodeado de compañeros que se apoyan mutuamente. Sé parte de un **proyecto internacional** donde cada día impactas y sumas rompiendo las reglas del juego.

**️ Comunicación y transparencia 360º:** Nos encanta escuchar y debatir, trabajando con pasión y humildad para superarnos cada día. Te sentirás parte integral del proyecto con detalles de nuestro crecimiento compartidos en nuestras **Quarterlies** y resúmenes mensuales.

**️ Oficinas que molan:** Además de **café y fruta siempre disponible**, nuestras oficinas tienen espacios abiertos y zonas de desconexión. En blue banana, te sentirás como en casa.

**️ Sé parte del cambio:** En Blue Banana somos una empresa certificada B Corp. Eso significa que no solo trabajamos por crecer, sino por hacerlo generando un impacto positivo real en las personas y en el planeta.

**¿Quieres conocernos mejor?**

* Pásate por nuestra web o por cualquiera de nuestras tiendas.
* Sigue nuestros viajes desde nuestro canal de Youtube y conoce el lado B de la aventura. No todo es tan bonito como lo pintamos en nuestras fotos.
* Si tienes cualquier duda, escríbenos. Estamos para ayudar.

Gracias por haber leído hasta aquí y bienvenidx, aventurerx.

*Blue Banana manifiesta su compromiso con la igualdad de género y de oportunidades a todos los niveles y para todas las personas trabajadoras, y garantiza la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión en todos sus procesos.*

*Blue Banana promueve un futuro más sostenible, diseñando y produciendo colecciones de una forma más responsable. Trabajamos a todos los niveles para garantizar el mínimo impacto ambiental y social de nuestros productos, cumpliendo los beneficios e incentivos que ofrecemos de sostenibilidad y responsabilidad social.*

title: Head of Partnerships, EMEA
description:
**Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.**

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* You'll lead the development and execution of our EMEA partnership expansion strategy across key European markets including Germany, Italy, Spain, France, the Netherlands and the UK.

title: Event Production Manager
description:
**Event Production Manager**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

We are looking for an **Event Production Manager** who wants to make an impact in a high-growth company. You will work directly with the Head of Events on the production of Fun Business Days and the Fourvenues international events calendar, making sure every event lands on date and on budget, and ends in meetings the sales team can follow up on.

**Location:** Valencia or Madrid, Spain (hybrid model)

**Reporting to:** Head of Events

**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Produce every event in the calendar end to end: brief, timeline, suppliers, build, on-site delivery and teardown, across Spain, the US, Italy and the Netherlands.
* Coordinate the production of Fun Business Days, the industry congress we run in Valencia: 3,000 attendees, 4 stages, 40 stands and 50 speakers, with a production agency by your side.
* Run several productions in parallel, in different cities, and hold every one of them to the same standard.
* Negotiate and manage suppliers, venues, agencies and freelancers, and hold them to the brief.
* Keep every event on date and on budget, and flag variance before it happens.
* Own the detail that decides whether an attendee has a good time: signage, flow, timings, hospitality and contingency. From a 3,000-person congress to a dinner for 8.
* Measure every event: log every contact and every meeting in HubSpot, and report cost per attendee and cost per qualified meeting.
* Brief Design and Audiovisual early, book the team’s travel and accommodation ahead of time, and keep the supplier map, the production playbook and the project board up to date.
* After every event, propose what to repeat, what to change and what to drop, with the numbers in front of you.
* Use AI tools to speed up the repeatable parts of every production (supplier comparisons, run of show, attendee communications, post-event reports), with sound judgment on what needs human review.

**What we need from you...**

* 5+ years producing events, including at least 2 on multi-supplier productions.
* Experience on the production side of industry conferences, live events or festivals.
* You have run several productions at once, at least one outside your home city.
* Budget, agency and production supplier management.
* On site through build and show, including long days and the occasional weekend.
* Professional Spanish and C1 English.
* Hands-on use of a project management tool and a CRM at contact and meeting level (HubSpot or similar).
* Organisation, calm when something breaks during build, and direct communication with suppliers and internal teams.
* You answer for the date and for the budget, and you raise what is going to go wrong before it does.
* Degree in Events Management, Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**We Value...**

* B2B marketing experience and an understanding of how an event turns into pipeline.
* Production and floorplan tools.
* A supplier network in Valencia, Madrid or Miami.
* Italian.
* Having produced outside Spain.
* Using AI tools to automate production tasks.

**What We Offer...**

* Salary based on candidate's skills and experience.
* Annual bonuses for those who significantly contribute to Fourvenues' success.
* A vision and team that will inspire you to excel and reach the next level in your career development.
* Continuous training we want you to stay at the forefront of technology and grow your skills through regular internal training.
* MacBook laptop and high-resolution monitors to maximize your potential.
* Hybrid work model (3+2): three days in the office and two from home if that’s where you feel most productive although we're confident that the environment and the team will make you enjoy being at the office more than you’d expect.
* Flexible working hours. Organize your workday between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, as long as you meet scheduled commitments.
* Private health insurance to promote your peace of mind and well-being.
* Optional flexible benefits plan, such as dining, childcare, transportation, and discounts with major brands.
* Extra vacation days for special occasions like birthdays, holidays, or unique events.

**About Fourvenues**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

Our vision is clear: to become the operating system of the industry, with a strong financial component and a vertical SaaS (vSaaS) model that empowers our clients to achieve their goals. Their success is ours.

In just three years, we’ve multiplied our revenue by 20x, and we’re only getting started. Our goal is to grow by at least 100% annually, fostering an environment where commitment, high standards, and constant curiosity are non-negotiable. Here, excellence isn’t optional; it’s the standard.

In the last two years, Fourvenues has secured €11 million in funding from top-tier U.S. investors, including Base10 Partners (Notion, Figma, Instacart) and FJ Labs (Stripe, Airbnb, Rappi). This investment fuels our ambitious growth strategy and strengthens our commitment to expanding in the U.S. with a cutting-edge, high-performance product.

At Fourvenues, we scale aggressively while maintaining disciplined unit economics and a long-term vision. We are not just building fast, we are building sustainably, ensuring that every step forward is backed by solid fundamentals. Our goal is to become the leading platform in the nightlife industry while creating a company that lasts.

We have the privilege of collaborating with renowned brands such as Pacha, BRESH, Cova Santa, BCM, Magic Room HK, Blackworks, Sonorama Medellin, Opium, and Gossip Doha. And we’re continuously signing new partnerships every month, presenting challenges that push us to deliver outstanding service.

If you’re at a point in your career where you’re ready to make an impact, unlock your full potential, and join a rapidly expanding company, this is the place for you!

title: Head of Talent Acquisition (Remote)
description:
**Unstoppable starts with people.** The future of payments is being built today, and at **Paymentology**, we are looking for people who want to help shape it. We power card issuing for leading banks, fintechs and digital brands across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we are looking for curious, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex challenges, embrace innovation and want to make a tangible impact at global scale.

**Head of Talent Acquisition**
==============================

We’re looking for a **Head of Talent Acquisition** to lead and shape our global Talent Acquisition function, ensuring Paymentology attracts, assesses and secures the exceptional talent needed to deliver our business strategy.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll define our global Talent Acquisition strategy, establish high hiring standards and lead a team of three TA Partners and a TA Operations role to deliver an effective, consistent and high-performing recruitment function.

This is a strategic leadership role for someone who combines commercial judgement, deep recruitment expertise and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders. You’ll play a critical role in translating business and workforce priorities into effective hiring strategies, strengthening hiring decisions and continuously evolving an effective, scalable and data-driven TA function that supports our global growth.

**Location:** This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Poland, Italy, Slovenia, Serbia, Czech Republic, Portugal, Croatia or Spain.

**Application deadline:** 18 November 2026.

**What you get to do:**
-----------------------

### **Talent Acquisition Strategy & Hiring Priorities**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning recruitment priorities with business objectives, approved workforce plans and future capability needs.
* Partner with the Executive Team, functional leaders and Finance to understand workforce requirements, challenge assumptions and recommend hiring priorities based on business impact, affordability, market conditions and recruitment capacity.
* Anticipate talent-market challenges and hiring risks, providing strategic insights and recommendations that support informed workforce and hiring decisions.
* Continuously evolve the TA operating model to support changing business needs, ensuring the function remains scalable, efficient and commercially focused.

### **Hiring Excellence & Talent Standards**

* Define and maintain high hiring standards, ensuring recruitment decisions are structured, evidence-based and aligned with Paymentology’s talent philosophy.
* Set clear expectations for role definition, assessment quality and hiring decisions, ensuring TA Partners effectively challenge requirements and uphold consistent hiring standards.
* Drive a culture of hiring excellence through effective interview practices, strong hiring-manager capability, timely decision-making and a positive candidate experience.

### **Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a global Talent Acquisition team comprising three TA Partners and a TA Operations role, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Empower TA Partners to own recruitment within their functions, strengthening their ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex hiring challenges and make decisions independently.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight to TA Operations, ensuring systems, processes, governance and reporting enable effective recruitment delivery.

### **Stakeholder Partnership & Strategic Influence**

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the Chief People Officer and Executive Team, providing insights on hiring priorities, talent-market dynamics and critical capability needs.
* Influence and challenge senior stakeholders, resolve competing hiring priorities across functions and provide leadership on selected executive and business-critical appointments.

### **Recruitment Operations, Technology & Analytics**

* Oversee the effectiveness of recruitment processes, systems and governance, ensuring consistent, compliant and scalable hiring practices across the organisation.
* Champion the adoption of modern recruitment technology, AI and automation to improve hiring quality, operational efficiency and candidate experience.
* Define and monitor recruitment performance metrics, leveraging data and market intelligence to identify improvement opportunities and inform strategic decisions.

### **Talent Attraction**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global talent attraction strategy, strengthening our ability to engage and attract high-calibre talent in priority markets.
* Partner with People and Marketing to strengthen Paymentology’s positioning in priority talent markets and support proactive talent attraction initiatives and partnerships.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* Extensive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 5 years in leadership roles with responsibility for TA strategy, team performance and recruitment effectiveness.
* Experience operating in a globally distributed organisation, ideally within SaaS, technology infrastructure or a similarly complex environment.
* Proven ability to define and execute a global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning hiring priorities and recruitment capabilities with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Strong commercial acumen and strategic judgement, with the ability to balance business priorities, hiring demand, recruitment capacity, budget considerations and talent-market realities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise and constructively challenge C-suite executives and senior business leaders.
* Deep recruitment expertise, with a proven ability to establish and uphold high hiring standards, drive structured and evidence-based assessment, and improve the quality of hiring decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing Talent Acquisition teams, building accountability, empowering others and developing their capability to operate as strategic business partners.
* Strong analytical capabilities, using recruitment data, performance metrics and talent-market intelligence to inform decisions, identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience designing and evolving scalable recruitment operating models, processes and governance, with the ability to lead change and drive adoption across the organisation.
* Strong understanding of modern recruitment technology, ATS platforms, automation and AI, with the ability to leverage these to improve hiring quality, efficiency and candidate experience. Experience with Ashby is a strong advantage.

We’re a team that cares deeply about the quality of our work, supports each other and is always looking for ways to improve. You’ll be joining a group of people who enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas and making things better, with plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

At **Paymentology**, we believe that making a difference starts with the people behind the work. You will be part of a diverse, global team of Paymentologists who are united by a shared mission to advance the world through payments.  
This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful work, collaborate across markets and functions, and help shape the future of a business with global reach and real impact.

Founded in 1912, Illinois Tool Works Inc. (ITW) is a diversified manufacturer of specialized industrial equipment, consumables, and related services. Its businesses serve customers worldwide, combining application expertise with customer focused innovation.

**Division Description**

ITW EU Global Accounts serves European automotive OEMs, including Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Ford, and Tesla, and their Tier suppliers with plastic fastening solutions. The division includes operations in Creglingen and Enkenbach in Germany and Les Franqueses in Spain.

**Job Overview**

The Junior Application Segment Manager supports the identification and evaluation of new technical application opportunities within the automotive industry, with a particular focus on plastic fastening solutions.

Working closely with Engineering, Innovation, Sales, and Strategic Marketing, the role requires understanding automotive components, vehicle architectures, materials, assembly processes, and customer technical requirements to identify potential product and application development opportunities.

This is a technical-commercial development role for a recent engineering graduate or early-career professional with strong analytical skills, technical curiosity, and an interest in translating engineering challenges into innovative customer solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research automotive applications, technology trends, customer needs, and competitor solutions.

* Support opportunity assessments using market data, customer evidence, and basic commercial analysis.

* Help prepare customer discovery activities, value propositions, and application roadmaps.

* Coordinate assigned actions across functions and maintain accurate project and opportunity records.

* Apply the ITW 80/20 approach to focus effort on the most relevant evidence and agreed priorities.

**Market Intelligence and Opportunity Mapping**

* Gather and organize information on vehicle architectures, electrification, lightweighting, sustainability, materials, and assembly trends relevant to fastening applications.

* Maintain market and competitor information, recording sources, assumptions, and gaps.

* Support market segmentation, application mapping, and initial market sizing using agreed methods.

* Summarize findings and flag potential opportunities for review with senior colleagues.

**Customer and Competitive Insights**

* Draft value propositions that connect proposed solutions to customer benefits, with technical validation from Engineering.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

* 0–2 years of relevant experience in application engineering, product development, technical product management, automotive engineering, or related technical-industrial functions. Relevant internships, placements, and university projects are welcome.

* Languages: Professional proficiency in English is required. Spanish and German language skills are highly valued.

* Curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to turn research into clear summaries.

* Basic commercial awareness and confidence working with data, spreadsheets, and presentations.

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
description:
**About Actian**

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

**This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.**

  

### **What You Will Own:**

1. **Platform Engineering & Architecture**

* Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
* Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. **Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
* Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
* Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
* Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. **AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations**

* Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
* Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
* Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
* Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
* Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. **Security, Compliance & Reliability**

* Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
* Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
* Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
* Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. **Team Building & Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
* Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
* Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
* Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

### **What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:**

* Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
* Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
* Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
* Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
* Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
* Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

### **What You Bring:**

**Leadership & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
* At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
* Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
* A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
* The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
* Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
* Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
* Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

**AI-First Mindset**

* Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
* Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
* Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
* A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

**Leadership Approach**

* Strong ownership and execution skills.
* Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
* Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
* Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
* Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
* Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
* Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
* Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
* OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
* Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

### **How You Will Work:**

You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Company: Impact Clients
