title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.
* Build and maintain automations, Make scenarios and AI agents (for example Claude skills and MCP connections, ClickUp agents and AI assistants) that handle repetitive coordination: assignment checks, delivery QA, content safety and duration checks, reporting, onboarding messages and sample tracking.
* Test new AI and agentic tools for operations and creative production, and recommend what to adopt, with clear costs, risks and expected time saved.
* Keep a registry of every running automation and agent, with its purpose, owner and schedule. Make sure each one is monitored, documented and that failures surface quickly.
* Train the team to run and trust these workflows, so they keep working without depending on the person who built them.

ClickUp workspace

* Own the marketing ClickUp workspace: structure, lists, statuses, templates, dashboards, permissions, forms and native automations. Serve as the escalation point for ClickUp issues.
* Keep the workspace practical, accurate and usable as team needs change, with consistent processes across internal teams and external partners.
* Make sure tasks hold the information needed for execution, reporting and accountability.

Notion and operational documentation

* Own the architecture and maintenance of the marketing Notion workspace, including operational databases such as the ads delivery and creator sample trackers.
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.
* Update documentation whenever workflows change, so essential knowledge is easy to find and does not depend on any one person.

Reporting and operational performance

* Own marketing operations reporting and the accuracy of the trackers behind it.
* Keep visibility into assignments, production, delivery, backlog, capacity, onboarding and operational risks. Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.
* Define and maintain operational KPIs and their calculations with the relevant stakeholders, such as creative lead time and on-time delivery. Flag missing or inconsistent data before using it to assess performance.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement improvements that speed up execution, reduce avoidable revisions and improve resource use.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own the operational administration of the marketing tool stack (including Higgsfield, HeyGen, Claude, Make, Tagbox and other creative and AI tools): access, onboarding, offboarding, usage tracking and vendor coordination.
* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.
* Review software needs with team leads, coordinate renewals and resolve access or usage issues. Cut unnecessary costs and identify tools that make production faster.
* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Long Term Planning (LTP) is the kitchen of Amazon's European network: it's where we decide what gets built, where and why, years before it opens. As a Senior PM in LTP, you'll own multi-year strategic questions end to end, see the whole supply chain rather than one slice of it, and take your recommendations straight to director and VP reviews. The questions are ambiguous and the network keeps moving, which is what makes LTP a school. You'll thrive here if you want breadth and influence early, and you like problems that don't have a playbook yet.  
  
This is a role for someone who wants to shape — not just plan — the physical backbone of Amazon’s EU Non-Sort (NS) operations. You’ll own the strategic questions that determine how millions of units flow across the continent, from how volume enters the network to how it reaches the customer.  
  
The Role:  
You’ll lead end-to-end network and topology planning across mid-term (1-year) and long-term (3-year+) horizons for Amazon’s EU Non-Sort (NS) network. You won’t optimize one slice of the chain — you’ll own the whole picture. The role centers on two high-impact mandates:  
  

* Own the CEU+UK non-sort build plan end to end — from demand through fulfillment — meeting future demand at optimal cost across the full network.

  

* Drive EU-wide strategic initiatives that redefine non-sort network design, capacity planning, and operational processes.

  
Stakeholders & Planning Cycles:  
You’ll operate at the center of the organization, leading complex cross-functional programs with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Operations, Inbound Supply Chain, External Fulfillment (3P), Real Estate, and Transportation. Your recommendations will shape Amazon’s plan of record through every major planning cycle (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG) and land in front of directors and VPs.  
  
What You’ll Own:  
As the owner of the end-to-end planning process, you’ll take strategic questions from ambiguity to execution: judging demand forecast inputs and building the capacity requirements, identifying solve options, and driving them through Supply Chain and Engineering teams. This means deep analysis across vendor and seller behavior, network-wide program trends, and seasonal demand patterns to build risk-aware plans that hold up against real-world uncertainty.  
  
Working hand in hand with Finance, you’ll define optimal investment levels through rigorous evaluation of options — new permanent and temporary sites, retrofits, and the timing and sequencing of network launches. You’ll own the trade-offs that matter:  

* Cost and risk optimization vs. operational flexibility
* Fixed vs. variable capacity investments
* Short-term operational needs vs. long-term network sustainability

  
You’ll lead the hardest analytical questions in the network: non-sort node optimization (TNS sites, IXD non-sort flows, 3P solutions, specialty handling), the Non-Sort Dual Network Architecture (DNA) framework that defines optimal network configurations. You’ll turn that analysis into clear recommendations on economics and operational viability — and you’ll defend them in the room with leadership.  
  
Beyond the Cycle — Strategy & Innovation:  
Beyond the planning cycles, you’ll constantly redefine the end-to-end non-sort strategy as the network evolves — and the sharpest edge of that work is the trade-off between speed and cost. Your job is to spin that flywheel, embedding what you learn into making step changes to improve EU-wide planning processes. That means:  
  

* Creating frameworks to crack complex business problems
* Building innovative, data-driven solutions
* Forging consensus across diverse and senior stakeholder groups
* Driving execution through multiple organizations

  
Key job responsibilities  
The role covers the following responsibility areas:  
1. Strategic Network Planning & Architecture  
2. Partnership with demand forecasting & capacity solve  
3. Annual Planning Cycle Leadership (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG)  
4. Cross-Functional Influence & Stakeholder Management  
5. Peak Inbound Strategy & Resilience  
6. Leadership Communication & Decision Enablement

------------------------

* Experience in program or project management
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in stakeholder management and communication management

* Partner with engineering teams to understand their needs and communicate roadmap, trade-offs and progress transparently.

* Own the observability stack (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, alerting, PagerDuty), tackling scalability problems such as high-cardinality metrics, and define SLIs/SLOs and a service maturity model with engineering teams.
* Drive cost efficiency (FinOps): capacity planning, node and instance right-sizing, quota management and cost anomaly detection.
* Reduce toil and enable self-service: replace tickets with tools, golden paths and reusable CI/CD workflows, and keep documentation and runbooks fresh.
* Apply AI to platform operations: build and operate agents and automations (e.g. cost anomaly detection, PR review, incident triage), define MCP integrations, and contribute to AI governance with Security.

**Outcome over Output**  
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

**We Are All Scouts**  
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

**We Are Data-Driven**  
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

* **Languages & Automation:** Python, Go
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, Terraform Cloud
* **CI/CD & GitOps:** GitHub Actions, ArgoCD
* **Observability:** VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, PagerDuty
* **Streaming & Data:** Redpanda, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis
* **Security & Networking:** IAM, VPC, Cloudflare, secrets management
* **AI & Automation:** LLM-based agents, MCP integrations

* **Technical Experience:** Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform/Cloud Engineering roles, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic product companies, with proven technical proficiency and the ability to engage in deep technical conversations with the team.
* **Collaboration and Prioritization:** Service-oriented mindset: understands stakeholders' problems, communicates clearly and prioritizes across several concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Kanban or Scrum.
* **Automation and Programming:** Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go or similar) to automate operations and build internal tooling (operators, agents, CI/CD workflows).
* **Cloud Services:** Deep hands-on knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent hyperscaler (VPC and peering/PSC, IAM, GKE, CloudSQL, GCS), including networking and migrations between projects or organizations.
* **Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities:** Proven on-call and incident management experience, with strong problem-solving skills under pressure and a track record of root-cause analysis and blameless postmortems.
* **Kubernetes:** Solid production experience with Kubernetes, ideally GKE: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, autoscaling and node pool tuning, and workload identity.
* **Infrastructure as Code and GitOps:** Strong Terraform experience (Terraform Cloud a plus), GitOps (ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners).
* **Observability:** Experience with Prometheus-compatible stacks (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana), alerting design and SLI/SLO practices. Understanding of cardinality and scaling issues is a plus.
* **Security:** Working knowledge of cloud security practices: secrets management, vulnerability and CVE remediation, hardening and least privilege.
* **Other tools and engines:** Streaming platforms (Kafka/Redpanda), or other stateful systems (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Aerospike); Cloudflare (CDN, load balancing); compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001); FinOps and capacity planning; hands-on experience building or operating LLM-based agents or automations (e.g. ADK, MCP) and using AI tools in daily engineering work; service maturity / internal developer platform approach.
* **People-Centric Approach:** Focus on understanding stakeholders problems and providing the best way to solve team.
* **Agile Methodologies:** Experience working with agile development methodologies like Kanban or Scrum, promoting transparency and collaboration within the team.
* **Planning and Execution:** Strong skills in roadmap planning, execution, and measuring engineering excellence through key metrics and KPIs.
* **Priority Management:** Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and concurrent projects effectively.
* **Cloud Services:** Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other cloud services, including technologies like Terraform and Ansible, for designing and managing scalable infrastructures.
* **Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities:** Previous experience in incident management and on-call responsibilities is needed. The candidate must demonstrate strong problem-solving skills under pressure and quick responsiveness to critical situations.

#### **Why Join Seedtag?**

title: Applied AI Course Author
description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners (people with no prior tech background) through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We’re looking for an experienced **Course Author in Applied AI** to help design and develop a graduate-level online program in Applied Artificial Intelligence, delivered in partnership with a US university. The program is built for working professionals in fields such as marketing, operations, finance and HR. They learn to evaluate, build, integrate, deploy and govern AI solutions using modern no-code and low-code tools. You’ll turn approved course syllabi into engaging, rigorous learning materials and help shape how a new generation of AI practitioners learns to make sound, defensible decisions.

This is a part-time, project-based opportunity for subject matter experts who are passionate about teaching, curriculum design and helping learners succeed.

*Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.*

*After applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call.*

*Project details are shared after signing an NDA.*

  
Requirements:
  

* 5+ years of recent professional experience in applied AI/ML, data, AI automation, or a related field, including hands-on experience with LLMs.
* A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field, or 5+ years of senior professional experience in AI or a related industry.
* Practical knowledge of AI tools and workflows, including prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, automation, APIs, and LLM evaluation.
* Experience applying AI to real business problems, considering business value, cost, risk, and reliability.
* Experience teaching, mentoring, or creating educational content, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Strong English communication skills (C1+), including clear professional and educational writing.
* Strong organizational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work proactively, incorporate feedback, and meet agreed deadlines.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience designing courses or learning materials for higher education or online programs.
* Familiarity with AI strategy, business cases, or responsible AI practices or governance.
* Experience with EdTech or learning platforms, or contributions to the AI community through publications, talks, or open-source projects.

  
Brand:
  
TripleTen  
  
What you will do:
  

* Develop graduate-level course content in Applied AI based on approved syllabi: guided lessons, hands-on labs, case studies, weekly assignments and final projects, mostly in text and video format.
* Write clear assignment briefs and analytic rubrics for all graded work, including explicit rules on when and how students may use AI tools.
* Design practical labs on current AI platforms (LLM assistants, RAG applications, workflow automation, AI agents, APIs and monitoring tools), and make sure every graded task can be completed with free or open-source tools.
* Curate reading lists of research papers, standards and vendor documentation, and explain why each source matters.
* Create supporting materials: preparatory (non-credit) modules for learners without a technical background, a program glossary, templates and worked examples.
* Collaborate with the LX designer and the student experience team on learning objectives, course structure and assessment design (if you don’t have experience with this, that’s ok).
* Consult on Applied AI-related questions, and keep content up to date as tools and regulations change.
* Revise content based on academic review by the partner university’s faculty, and make sure it meets graduate-level academic standards.

  
What we can offer you:
  

* Fully remote, part-time collaboration (at least 25h/week).
* Compensation: fixed fee per course package, paid in milestones.
* A diverse team across Europe, the US, Latin America and more.
* Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.

title: Technical Architect
description:
**Company Description**

**Talan – Positive Innovation**

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

**Talan at a Glance**

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

**Our Core Areas of Expertise**

* **Data & Technologies:** We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
* **Cloud & Application Services:** We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
* **Management & Innovation Consulting:** We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

**We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.**

 **Job Description**

The Technical Architect will serve as the technical point of reference, with the objective of transforming business goals into robust, evolvable, secure, and operable architectures. They will lead end-to-end technical architecture design, establish technical and non-functional criteria, support the team during implementation, and ensure that deliverables meet the quality, performance, resilience, and security levels required by a critical enterprise platform.

Responsibilities

* Define the end-to-end technical architecture of the project, including components, integrations, data flows, dependencies, and boundaries of responsibility.
* Make and document architectural decisions using ADRs, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, evolution costs, risks, and operational consequences.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into implementable designs, technical acceptance criteria, and an evolution roadmap.
* Design scalable and resilient distributed solutions, considering consistency, concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
* Participate in the development of critical components and conduct code reviews focused on design, maintainability, security, and operational behavior.
* Define the testing and quality strategy: unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, resilience, and security testing.
* Design and review APIs, integration contracts, persistence schemas, and compatibility and evolution mechanisms.
* Evaluate performance and capacity through analysis, profiling, load testing, and the definition of measurable latency and throughput targets.
* Ensure the automation of builds, validations, static analysis, deployments, and quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Integrate secure-by-design principles, threat modeling, secrets management, access control, and traceability into the architecture.
* Identify technical risks, structural debt, and bottlenecks; prioritize their remediation and communicate their impact on timeline, cost, and scope.
* Participate in planning complex deliveries, technical estimations, milestone definition, and tracking architectural commitments.

 **Qualifications**  

* More than 4 years of experience as a Technical Architect, with demonstrable experience leading the design and delivery of platforms or projects of high technical complexity.
* At least 5 years of experience in software development and in Java, Spring Boot, APIs, persistence, distributed systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Experience in regulated or financial environments with high availability, performance, security, and traceability requirements.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining standards, managing technical debt, and evolving existing systems.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and collaborating cross-functionally with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Business teams.
* Advanced experience with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, and designing mission-critical enterprise applications.
* Mastery of microservices architecture, distributed systems, synchronous and asynchronous integration, and communication patterns.
* In-depth knowledge of REST API design, contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration governance.
* Experience with Spring Data JPA, data modeling, transactions, PostgreSQL, and query and persistence optimization.
* Experience with Gradle or Maven, multi-module projects or composite builds, dependency management, and build automation.
* Mastery of SOLID principles, DDD, Clean Architecture, design patterns, and refactoring and safe evolution techniques.
* Experience defining testing strategies using JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, as well as contract, integration, and performance testing.
* Solid knowledge of concurrency, caching, messaging, idempotency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance.
* Experience with Git, code reviews, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated quality, static analysis, artifact management, and controlled deployments.
* Knowledge of observability: structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, alerting, and production diagnostics.

Languages

* **Minimum B2 English level, mandatory.** A professional level is required to lead decisions and collaborate with international teams.
* **Spanish – professional level, minimum B2, mandatory.**

Nice to Have

* Experience in the architecture of financial platforms, corporate banking, trading, or high-criticality transactional systems.
* Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, or other messaging and distributed processing platforms.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud, and deployment patterns such as blue-green, canary, and rolling releases.
* Experience applying OAuth2, OpenID Connect, threat modeling, secrets management, and application security controls.
* Knowledge of SRE, SLO/SLI, capacity, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Experience in application modernization, progressive migrations, the strangler pattern, and technical debt reduction.
* Experience defining architecture standards, technical reviews, and governance models in large organizations.
* Domain knowledge of Trade Finance or Documentary Trade.

 **Additional Information**

**What do we offer you?**

* Full-time or B2B contract
* **Remote within CET Time zone.**
* Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

**If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !**

title: Senior ML & AI Engineer
description:
At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.

We are looking for a **Senior ML & AI Engineer** to join us as part of our team.

### **About the role**

PitchBook’s Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for using machine learning, statistical modeling, and natural language processing (NLP) to collect a high-volume of data for the PitchBook Platform and surface insights for the capital markets. This role will also serve as a resource and mentor for junior members of the team. A strong motivation to succeed is critical and everyone has the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of our team.

**About the project**

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others. Features of PitchBook: Advanced search / Discovery & insights / Company profiles / Workflow & efficiency / Financials and many more.

**Team**

1 EM, 6 ML Engineers

**Work Environment**

The role offers a flexible work schedule, allowing you to adapt your working hours with the requirement to attend all team meetings. The team follows a Scrum-based Agile methodology.

### **As a qualified expert, You will**

* **Work with GenAI & LLMs:** Design, develop, and fine-tune generative AI models using transformer architectures. Implement advanced techniques to create practical solutions for real-world challenges.
* **Use Modern Toolkits:** Leverage frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith to build automated pipelines and intelligent agents. Integrate these tools with vector databases for efficient similarity search and real-time analysis.
* **Extract Data Insights:** Process and analyze large volumes of unstructured data using embeddings and statistical modeling to identify meaningful insights.
* **Build Scalable Systems:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create production-grade ML systems that handle real-time, high-volume data processing.
* **Mentor & Lead:** Act as a mentor for junior team members and stay updated on trends in Agentic AI, transformer models, and generative systems.
* **Collaborate &** Communicate**:** Work with Product and Engineering teams to improve data management and support innovation. Present complex analyses clearly and effectively.
* **Tech Stack & Focus Areas:** Work with generative AI and transformer models, integrating frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith to automate workflows and build intelligent systems. Use PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Spacy to build NLP pipelines. Implement vector databases for high-dimensional data embeddings and develop hybrid models to extract insights from diverse data sources.

### **We’re looking for you if you have**

* **Educational Background:**You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.
* **Experience:** You bring 5+ years of production experience in the ML field, with a track record in developing transformer-based models and deploying them in scalable systems.
* **Technical Expertise:**
* + Proficient in Python and machine and deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, Spacy or other.
  + Experienced in natural language processing and modern LLM based techniques.
  + Experience with full ML lifecycle, data preprocessing, training, evaluation stages and monitoring techniques
  + Skilled with SQL and data extraction methods.

* **Innovative Thinker:** You thrive on solving complex problems and are always exploring new trends in Generative AI.
* **Collaborator & Communicator:** You’re an excellent communicator able to collaborate and express your thoughts in a professional manner to team members, other engineering teams and stakeholders.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to financial services, investment banking, venture capital, or private equity is nice to have.
* **Languages: English** —Upper-Intermediate or higher; **Ukrainian** —fluent/native**.**

### **What’s in it for You**

**Reveal great tech solutions**

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

**Experience an agile and flexible working environment**

Enjoy the freedom of fully remote work with a flexible working schedule. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, supported by provided laptops and licensed software. We focus on lasting cooperation and unite result-oriented individuals who stand on a high-performance approach to work.

**Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth**

Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

**Be among like-minded people**

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Feel supported by your HR, and take advantage of our referral bonus program.

### **Interview steps**

* Interview with the recruiter
* Technical interview (up to 90 min)
* System Design interview (up to 45 min)
* Behavioral Round with Product Manager (45 min)
* Final interview with Engineering Manager (30 min)

title: AI Security Governance Architect
description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions? At **Plain Concepts**, our **AI Security Studios** team helps organizations adopt AI securely and responsibly by defining how risks, controls and responsibilities should be managed throughout the AI lifecycle.

As an **AI Security Governance Architect**, you will help design and operationalize cybersecurity governance frameworks for **AI, Generative AI and agentic AI**, working closely with security, architecture and business teams. You will act as a **cybersecurity subject matter expert for AI governance**, translating emerging AI risks into practical **security controls, requirements, processes and architecture patterns** that organizations can actually implement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Define and evolve AI security governance frameworks**, covering AI use case registration, risk classification, security controls, approvals, exceptions, monitoring and periodic reassessment.
* **Align AI security governance with recognized standards and regulations**, including NIST AI RMF, NIST Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the EU AI Act.
* **Assess AI, GenAI and agentic AI use cases from a cybersecurity perspective**, considering risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, identity and access management, excessive agent permissions, model exposure, third-party AI services, data residency and AI supply chain risks.
* **Translate AI risks into practical security controls**, including security policies, technical requirements, architecture patterns, guardrails, evidence requirements, ownership and acceptance criteria.
* **Define security requirements and architecture patterns for different AI scenarios**, including internal copilots, Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG systems, AI agents, ML models, vendor AI solutions and low-code/no-code AI automations.
* **Integrate AI security governance with existing security tooling and processes**, including solutions such as HiddenLayer, Sentra and Zenity, as well as GRC, IAM, DLP, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, CMDB and data governance environments.
* **Define and improve AI security governance deliverables**, including AI security control frameworks, use case classification models, security requirements, architecture patterns, risk acceptance processes, security review templates, KPI/KRI dashboards and maturity roadmaps.

  
**Requirements**  

* **8+ years of experience in cybersecurity**, with a strong background in security governance, security architecture, risk management, AppSec or Cloud Security.

* **Strong understanding of AI and GenAI security risks**, including LLM application security, prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, RAG security, AI agent permissions, model/API exposure, model supply chain and third-party AI services.
* **Experience designing and operationalizing security governance and control frameworks**, with the ability to turn policies and risk requirements into practical controls, processes and security requirements.
* **Knowledge of AI security and governance frameworks**, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and related AI risk and security standards.
* **Ability to work across security, architecture and business teams**, translating complex cybersecurity risks into clear requirements and recommendations for both technical and executive stakeholders.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, with the ability to create executive-ready materials as well as detailed security and control documentation.
* **Fluent in English and Spanish.**

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with AI governance programs, GenAI security assessments or AI Security Posture Management (AISPM).
* Experience securing enterprise AI environments such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG solutions or AI agents.
* Knowledge of cloud security architecture, Secure SDLC/DevSecOps, DSPM, GRC or AI-related SOC monitoring.
* Familiarity with tools such as HiddenLayer, Sentra, Zenity, Wiz, Microsoft Purview, Defender, CSPM/CWPP, DLP or SIEM/SOAR platforms.
* Knowledge of third-party AI risk management and security control evidence automation.
* Understanding of privacy and AI regulatory requirements, including GDPR, DPIAs, data classification and the EU AI Act.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary determined by the market and your experience

* Flexible schedule 35 Hours / Week
* Fully remote work (optional)
* Flexible compensation (restaurant, transport, and childcare) ✌
* Fully free health insurance, with a co-payment for dental services
* Individual budget for training or equipment and free Microsoft certifications
* English lessons
* Birthday day off
* Monthly bonus for electricity and Internet expenses at home
* Discount on gym plan and sports activities
* Plain Camp (annual team-building event)
* Extra perks: events attendance and speakers, welcome pack, baby basket, Christmas basket, discount portal for employees ➕ The pleasure of always working with the latest technological tools!

**Will you let us know you better?**

The selection process: Simple, just 3 steps.

* Phone screen
* 2 interviews with the team

**What is Plain Concepts?**

Plain Concepts is a global company of over 500 people passionate about technology and innovation. Since our founding, we have grown through technical proficiency and confidence in ideas that others might consider risky, creating custom solutions for our clients. With offices in more than 6 countries, our mission is to continue to drive cuttingedge projects around the world.

We are highly committed to technical excellence. We are known for developing highly customized projects, offering specialized technical consultancy and training.

Thanks to the great work of our technicians, we have been recognized for our ability to lead innovative projects that generate value, from artificial intelligence to blockchain, driving solutions that help companies optimize their performance.

**What we do at Plain Concepts?**

We pride ourselves on being a 100% technical team, dedicated to crafting custom projects from scratch, offering expert technical consultancy, and providing top-tier training.

* Our approach goes beyond traditional outsourcing; we focus on creating value together with our clients.
* Our teams are diverse and multidisciplinary, operating in a flat, collaborative structure.
* We live and breathe AGILE principles, ensuring flexibility and efficiency in everything we do.
* Knowledge-sharing is at our core: from supporting each other internally to contributing to the broader tech community through conferences, events, and talks.
* Innovation drives us — even the boldest ideas are welcome here.
* Transparency underpins all our relationships, fostering trust and long-term partnerships.

**Want to learn more?**

Check out our website! ➡ https://www.plainconcepts.com/

At Plain Concepts, we certainly seek to provide equal opportunities. We want diverse applicants regardless of race, colour, gender, religion, national origin, citizenship, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior UX/UI & Product Designer (GenAI & Enterprise Solutions)
UX/UI Designer / Senior Product Designer – AI & GenA
AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**This isn’t another growth job**

Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.

We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.

**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE GROWTH MEANS AT PARADOX**
------------------------------------------

Our growth machine has to be able to:

**1. Generate hypotheses.** Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.

**2. Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.

**3. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.

**4. Ship its hypotheses.** Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.

We do that by merging :

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

### **5. Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**You’ll own these KPIs:** LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.

**Desired outcomes:** conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.

**Tools you’ll master:** GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.

If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.

If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.

If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…

If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…

If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.

Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s Growth team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the growth vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.

If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Web Experience Manager (Technical Implementation & CRO) - Contractor
Senior Product Manager
description:
### **Get to know us**

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

Ideals Board: Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making.

### **The role**

As a **Senior Product Manager** for our Virtual Data Room (VDR), you'll lead the development of secure access, identity, and authentication capabilities that protect high-stakes M&A transactions.

**Your mission?** To give investment bankers, advisors, corporate development teams, and other professionals involved in M&A deals fast, simple, and secure access to their data rooms.

Your work will enable deal teams to onboard participants quickly, connect the VDR to their corporate identity systems, and trust that only the right people get access to sensitive content, allowing them to run more secure, efficient, and successful business transactions.

This role is open to candidates based in Ukraine, Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Serbia or Spain.

### **What you will do**

* Define and execute the product area strategy for Identity, Access, and Security inside the VDR, ensuring alignment with the overall product strategy and company vision
* Own core platform services such as authentication and email, including their long-term roadmap and technical debt reduction together with engineering
* Proactively uncover new product opportunities through structured discovery, leveraging user interviews, surveys, behavioral analytics, support and feedback analysis, market and competitor research, data deep-dives, experimentation, and close collaboration with stakeholders
* Prioritize opportunities and solutions based on user reach, impact, ROI, technical feasibility, and business risk, while maintaining a balanced roadmap that spans innovation, optimization, technical excellence, and cross-functional initiatives
* Define and communicate product requirements through interactive prototypes, well-structured PRDs, and user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
* Collaborate with engineers, designers, UX writers, and data analysts within cross-functional product teams to co-create and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
* Coordinate with other product teams on shared identity, access, and security initiatives across Ideals products
* Contribute to GTM strategy and work with the marketing team to develop launch plans, positioning, and messaging that drive product adoption and market success
* Measure success post-launch and iterate based on data and feedback

### **What you bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise environments
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive outcomes
* Proven experience across the full product lifecycle – from discovery to go-to-market and post-release activities
* Skilled in using both customer insights and data to inform product decisions
* Ability to turn industry and market trends into clear product strategies

title: Director of Product (Features) - Star Trek Fleet Command
Staff AI Engineer - Agents & Harness
description:
**We Are Sparta**  
  
Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.  
  
Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.  
  
We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.  
  
At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.  
  
Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

### **The role**

You are the senior technical authority for how Sparta builds agents. You design and build the harness that runs Leonidas AI's agents, set the patterns the rest of the team and the wider engineering group follow, and stay in the code on the hardest problems. You work as a peer of the Agents Team Lead: they own the team and the delivery, you own the technical direction of the agent platform.

When a trader asks why an arbitrage is shut, Leonidas has to pick the right curves, call the right tools, reason across them and show where every number came from, in seconds. Models, frameworks and best practice for agents change every few months. Your job is to build a harness that absorbs that change without rewrites, and to make sure we can prove each change made the product better.

### **What you will do**

* **Set the technical direction.** Author the target architecture for the agent platform: execution graph, LLM interfaces, tool contracts, memory and context management, sub-agents, sandboxing and how skills plug in. Write the designs, run the reviews and own the trade-offs.
* **Hands on AI development -** Context engineering across branched conversations, handoffs between specialist agents, a decision-model layer so a model can change without touching agent code, and resumable, observable runs.
* **Make quality measurable.** Define how we evaluate agents: golden question sets, offline and online evals in CI, tracing and feedback loops, and release gates a model or prompt change must pass.
* **Open Leonidas up.** Design the agent-to-agent API, MCP server and headless modes, and the boundaries between what we expose, what customers connect and what stays internal.
* **Own reliability, cost and safety.** Latency and token budgets, failure handling, guardrails, provenance on every number, and the security model for agents that call tools and run code.
* **Raise the bar for everyone.** Mentor engineers, coach the team through design and code review, and spread good agent-building practice, including AI-assisted development, across all of engineering.
* **Manage and grow people.** Line-manage a group of engineers on the Agents team: run 1:1s, set goals, give feedback, support career growth and take part in hiring.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Work with the Team Lead, product and customers to decide what to build, what to buy and what to stop, and to size the risk in new ideas through quick prototypes.

### **What you bring**

* 8+ years building production software, including designing and shipping LLM-powered agents or agentic products used by real users.
* Technical leadership without the title: you have set architecture across a team, led designs through review and mentored others to a higher level.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of agent systems: tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, streaming, context and memory management, retrieval, and failure modes over long runs.
* Clear writing and influence: you explain trade-offs to engineers, product and executives, and you change minds with evidence.

### **Nice to have**

* Built an agent harness or framework, or contributed to an open-source one (OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, DSPy or similar); built MCP servers or clients.
* Knowledge graphs, ontologies or entity resolution (mapping trader language to the right data).
* Sandboxed code execution, guardrails or security work for agents.
* Fine-tuning or model selection experience, or a research background.
* Interest in commodities or financial markets.

### **Our stack for this team**

Python · OpenAI Agents SDK · Postgres · Redis · StarRocks · Kafka · AWS · Nx monorepo · GitHub

**Why Join Sparta?**
====================

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

* Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company
* $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment
* Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale
* Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence
* Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

**What's the Culture Like at Sparta?**
======================================

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

**The Sparta Code**
===================

**Understanding is non-negotiable**

***Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.***

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

**Ask for forgiveness, not for permission**

***Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.***

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

**Fall in love with the problem**

***The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.***

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

**It's your fault. Lucky you.**

***If it's on you, it's in your control.***

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

**Conflict is a gift**

***Honesty is an expression of care.***

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

*Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.*

title: Product Manager
description:
### **About our Crew**

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a **Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance** to join our Product team in Barcelona.

### **The role**

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our **monetization and compliance roadmap**. You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our **revenue and contribution margin**, while keeping the product compliant on **tax and invoicing**.

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with **finance, data, legal and operations**, with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

**The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers**, 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

### **What floats your boat**

* **Build a point of view:** you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).
* **Vision & Roadmap:** you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.
* **Compliance by design:** you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.
* **Data-driven decisions:** you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.
* **Decision making:** you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.
* **Fail fast, learn fast:** you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

### **What you bring aboard**

* Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.
* You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.
* A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.
* Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.
* You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
* Fluent or bilingual in English.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.
* Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.
* Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

### **The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.
* Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

### **️** **What awaits you on board**

* A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;
* Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;
* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;
* Team-building activities;
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract:** Permanent position

**Start date:** ASAP

### **Ready to join?**

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all.

**About Mormedi**

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

**Our Mission: To help businesses navigate change confidently.**
