* Systemic elegance: We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* Maker mentality: We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

Role overview

As a Senior in our Business Innovation practice, you will work at the intersection of human-centred design, business planning, financial modelling, and venture validation. You will autonomously lead project workstreams—from uncovering customer insights and framing new venture hypotheses to building robust business cases, operating models, and market launch roadmaps—guiding junior team members and collaborating directly with clients to deliver high-impact strategic deliverables on time and on budget.

This role is for you if

You want to take full ownership of business innovation streams that reshape how clients compete, from early exploration to commercially viable go-to-market solutions. You thrive in collaborative studio environments, enjoy building financial models from scratch, facilitating executive co-creation workshops, mentoring emerging consultants, and defending business viability directly with C-suite stakeholders.

What you will own

* Autonomous execution and content leadership over complete strategic workstreams, several smaller projects, or major work packages within large client programs, taking ownership of content excellence, business case viability, and project profitability.
* High-level strategic storytelling, translating abstract user insights, market dynamics, and unit economics into compelling presentation decks and executive arguments.
* Definition of business models, operating models, and financial feasibility frameworks in multidisciplinary projects led by Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI.
* Guiding, supporting, and mentoring Staff, Junior strategists, and Interns on business design methodologies, financial modelling, workshop preparation, and deliverable quality.
* Facilitation of co-creation workshops, client working sessions, and executive presentations.
* Support in commercial opportunities: helping define project scope, estimating effort, and drafting strategic POV materials for pitch proposals.
* Participation in creating thought leadership content (articles, case studies, whitepapers) and industry presentations to strengthen market positioning.
* Contribution to growing the Business Innovation practice, evolving proprietary business design toolkits, and scaling client accounts.
* Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration & Studio Community: Collaborate closely with Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI teams to ensure commercial viability and business models inform physical and digital design execution, actively fostering a cohesive Mormedi studio culture and cross-discipline teamwork.
* Quality & Environmental Leadership (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001): Responsible for upholding Quality and Environmental Management System standards within assigned streams, driving continuous process efficiency, and embedding sustainable business practices and circular economy principles into deliverables.

**How success is measured**

**Project Delivery (~80%):** Delivery quality, project timeline/budget compliance, client satisfaction (CSAT 4-5), financial rigor, and mentoring impact.

**Commercial & Marketing Support (~20%):** Support in proposal preparation, organic account opportunity identification, content creation, and methodology enhancements.

**What you bring**

**Senior Strategic & Business Expertise –** Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Business Innovation, Strategy Consulting, Venture Building, or Strategic Design, with a strong portfolio showcasing complex innovation and business model engagements delivered for diverse industries.

**Financial Modeling & Business Craft –** Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and interpret complex financial models from scratch to support unit economics, revenue forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

**Methodology Mastery –** Deep knowledge of human-centered innovation, business model canvas, operating model design, customer journey mapping, and qualitative research methods.

**Executive Storytelling & Facilitation –** Exceptional ability to structure complex arguments into clear, visually compelling presentations (PowerPoint/Miro) and facilitate board-level working sessions.

**Project Stream Leadership –** Proven ability to organize project streams, prioritize tasks across multiple projects, and keep project profitability and margin targets in mind.

**AI Literacy & Responsible AI –** Fluency in applying Generative AI tools (LLMs, research synthesis engines, automation platforms) to business modeling, market research, and scenario planning while ensuring compliance with the EU AI Act, client IP protection, and data privacy.

**Software & Tools**

**Executive & Financial Suite:** Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel for financial modeling, P&L projections, and planning; PowerPoint for executive storytelling; Word).

**Collaboration & Workshop Platforms:** High proficiency in collaboration platforms such as Miro.

**Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools applied to market scanning, trend analysis, and research synthesis under strict confidentiality rules.

**Visual Suite (Nice to have):** Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop overview).

**Languages:** High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; a third language is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

An appropriate Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field, with a proven interest in design thinking.

Willingness to travel for client meetings, field research, and workshops.

Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

A valid driving license (minimum 2 years of seniority) is appreciated.

title: Sr. Social Compliance Auditor
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

Would you like to develop professionally in our Compliance area by ensuring that our global operations and supply chain meet ethical standards, human rights requirements, and social responsibility commitments?

### **Job responsibilities**

  

**Your role will be:**

* Supplier onboarding
* Conducting on-site social compliance audits of suppliers and manufacturing partners
* Assessing supplier compliance with the LVMH Code of Conduct
* Identifying potential risks within the supply chain and documenting irregularities
* Analyzing risk patterns and trends across the supply chain
* Developing and implementing Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs in collaboration with other departments

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience as a Social Auditor in an international audit firm
* Certification: certified by recognized auditing bodies (e.g.: SA8000, SMETA, APSCA)
* Knowledge of labor legislation and human rights regulations
* Ethical judgment, risk assessment, data verification, and compliance evaluation across social, environmental, and governance areas
* C1 level of English and Spanish
* Willingness to travel

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

Somos un equipo dinámico, multicultural e innovador, que entiende cada día como un desafío y una nueva oportunidad para crecer junto con la empresa.

Si quieres conquistar el mundo con nosotros, ¡te estamos esperando!

Buscamos una persona para incorporarse a nuestro **equipo de Brand**, dentro del departamento de Marketing, como **Creative Copywriter & AI Content Specialist**, reportando directamente al Head of Brand. Tu misión será escribir los guiones y copies del contenido de Civitatis en redes sociales y campañas transversales, diseñar y analizar tests de contenido y escalar nuestra producción creativa con IA generativa de imagen y vídeo .

**¿Cómo será tu día a día?**

* Escribir guiones y copies para el contenido de Civitatis en redes sociales, con especial foco en formato vertical (Reels y TikTok) .
* Crear conceptos, guiones y copies para campañas transversales de marca, manteniendo el tono y la personalidad de Civitatis en cada pieza.
* Diseñar tests de contenido (hooks, formatos, mensajes, creatividades), analizar sus resultados y convertir los aprendizajes en mejores piezas .
* Escalar la producción de contenido utilizando herramientas de IA generativa de imagen y vídeo, integrándolas en el flujo de trabajo del equipo .
* Colaborar con el equipo de Brand y otros equipos de Marketing para dar vida a las ideas, desde el concepto hasta la pieza publicada.
* Participar en rodajes y producciones, con viajes puntuales cuando el proyecto lo requiera ️.
* Estar al día de tendencias, formatos y novedades en redes sociales y en IA generativa.

**¿Qué buscamos?**

* Entre 3 y 4 años de experiencia en un puesto creativo (copywriting, guion o creatividad de contenidos) en agencia o marca.
* Imprescindible experiencia creando contenido en formato vertical (Reels y TikTok).
* Imprescindible usar IA generativa (imagen y/o vídeo) de forma habitual en tu flujo de producción.
* Portfolio con piezas publicadas y sus resultados (obligatorio para el proceso de selección).
* Capacidad para diseñar tests de contenido y analizar resultados para tomar decisiones creativas basadas en datos.
* Español nativo e inglés B2.
* Disponibilidad para viajar puntualmente a rodajes o producciones.
* Se valorará positivamente tener conocimientos de portugués.

**¿Por qué Civitatis?**

* Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español.
* Espíritu joven, viajero y gran ambiente de trabajo. ¡+20 nacionalidades!
* Hay vida más allá del trabajo: Flexibilidad horaria (gestionas tu horario de entrada y salida), jornada intensiva en verano, modalidad de trabajo híbrida, así como otras medidas de conciliación.
* ¡24 días laborables de vacaciones! ¿Necesitas más descanso o tiempo para ti? Con Cividías, puedes comprar días extra de vacaciones cada año.
* Eventos de teambuilding (afterworks, torneos de pádel, fútbol, tours, fiestas, concursos, etc.)
* Planes voluntarios de retribución flexible para sacar el máximo partido a tu salario.
* ¡Equipo sano, equipo feliz! Tenemos fruta siempre a mano en la oficina y co-financiamos el gimnasio‍️.
* Nunca dejarás de aprender: planes de desarrollo, formación continua y clases de inglés con profesores nativos.
* Podrás disfrutar de nuestras más de 90.500 actividades con un super descuento.
* Trabajarás en el corazón de Madrid. Oficinas en plena Gran Vía.
* En Civitatis impulsamos la diversidad y la igualdad de oportunidades, valorando el talento y el potencial de cada persona. Esta oferta está abierta a todas las personas que cumplan con el perfil profesional requerido.

title: Pool Attendant - Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor (Season 2027)
description:
Job ID: REQ10398227

Four Seasons Mallorca at Formentor

Location: Illes Balears, Illes Balears, Spain

widget: Full time

  

**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.
  
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Welcome to Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor. Perched on the spectacular Formentor Peninsula, surrounded by the Mediterranean Sea and the breathtaking landscapes of Mallorca, Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor is a truly extraordinary place to work. Originally opened in 1929, this iconic retreat has been reimagined following an extensive restoration, reopening in August 2024 as Four Seasons’ first resort in Mallorca. Set within a vast private estate, the Resort combines its rich heritage and poetic charm with contemporary luxury and the warm, authentic spirit of Spanish hospitality. Here, nature, history and exceptional service come together to create an inspiring environment for both our guests and our people. Join our team and become part of the story of Formentor — a place where careers are shaped by meaningful experiences, genuine connections and the opportunity to deliver the exceptional, every day.

About the role

The primary role of the Pool Attendant is to provide exceptional service to our guests. They are responsible for the delivery and collection of food and beverages for guests in the PoolArea.

What you will do

* Keep the Pool area clean and tidy
* Organize the sun loungers and take them away at the end of the day
* Take orders, serve orders, prepare (if necessary) food and beverage orders, all according to Four Seasons standards and in an efficient, courteous and professional manner.
* Be familiar with the food and beverage offerings, and may make suggestions to guests.
* Anticipate the needs of guests.
* Take responsibility for guest requests and complaints, seeking their satisfaction at all times, offering exceptional service and management.
* Clean and keep tables and customer areas, as well as food and beverage preparation areas, organized.
* Provide guests with pleasant, efficient and professional service in accordance with Four Seasons standards.
* Assist the assigned sector head, if applicable, as well as the department manager.

What you bring

* Previous Experience in Hospitality: 2 years of relevant experience in a similar role, ideally within a luxury resort or hotel environment such as Four Seasons or comparable establishments.
* High-Energy Mindset: Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced beach setting, remaining efficient, friendly, and attentive even during peak service hours.
* Basic Food & Beverage Knowledge: Familiarity with food and beverage service protocols to ensure safe, accurate, and seamless delivery to guests on the beach or poolside.
* Clear Communication: Able to read, understand, and speak English fluently, ensuring smooth and professional interactions with both guests and team members.
* Guest-Focused Approach: A natural passion for hospitality with a desire to provide memorable service and anticipate guest needs before they arise.
* Adaptability and Flexibility: Willingness to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and adapt to shifting priorities, guest requests, or operational needs.
* Team Spirit: Works collaboratively with colleagues across departments, including F&B, Recreation, and Housekeeping, to deliver a seamless guest experience.
* Attention to Detail: Observant and proactive in maintaining cleanliness, comfort, and safety in all pool areas, enhancing guest satisfaction.
* Professional Presence: Maintains a polished and positive demeanor at all times, embodying the values and standards of a luxury hospitality brand.
* Physical Stamina: Comfortable with standing for extended periods, lifting equipment, and performing physical tasks required for setting up and maintaining beach areas.

Work Experience: 2 Years

Degree: Professional /Technician

Languages: Spanish / English

Language Ability: High

What we offer:

* Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package
* Excellent Training and Development opportunities
* Complimentary Accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts
* Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
* Complimentary Employee Meals
* Discounts at our hotel restaurants
* Discounts on local services
* Possibility of accommodation and transportation to work (at a reduced cost)
* Mental Health Support: 24/7 access to professional and confidential psychological assistance.

Schedule & Hours:

* Seasonal contract, full Time, 40 hours per week, with consecutive and rotating shifts (including early mornings, days, evenings and weekends)

title: Global Supply Chain Site Communications Lead (G7)
description:
**Job Purpose:**

The core of this role will be to manage communications for a global manufacturing site including site communication plans, activities, channels and messages that align with GSK and GSC’s (Global Supply Chain) business priorities. You will work closely with the global Communications and Government Affairs team (CGA) aligned to GSK’s Global Supply Chain as well as with the site head and site leadership team.

The successful candidate will be skilled at developing communications which are insight-driven, engaging and delivered in a timely, digestible way for maximum impact, that are inclusive and accessible to all employees and aligned to GSK brand and voice. You will have experience with internal communications and channel management. You will be comfortable coaching leaders on their communications skills and supporting external-, change- and issues communication.

In this role you will:

* Develop and execute the annual site communications plan to help drive employee engagement and align staff around site-, GSC- and GSK strategy and priorities.
* Manage the site’s communication channels in the day-2-day. This includes organising all-site town halls, managing newsletters and digital channels and maintaining the site’s intranet pages up to date.
* Support broader CGA priorities as needed and ensure relevant company news is shared and adapted for local use at the site. Highlight the site's contribution to company priorities by taking part in global engagement campaigns and sharing impactful stories about how the site makes a difference. Create high-impact content to support local site priorities and – operations.
* Use relevant metrics to measure impact and generate insights to drive improvements. This includes conducting feedback surveys, obtaining qualitative feedback through focus groups, measuring view- and engagement rates of digital channels and monitoring progress regularly.
* Embrace technologies and AI tools to increase creativity and impact of communication activities.
* Co-deliver communications trainings in partnership with the global CGA team and advise site head and -leaders on their communication skills.
* Develop change communication plans in collaboration with the global CGA team and execute them to support major site transformations, accelerate adoption to organisational changes and new ways of working.
* Build the site’s external reputation by pro-actively suggesting LinkedIn stories for site leaders as well as local community engagement activities. Collaborate with the LOC on media opportunities and connection with government officials. Develop site-specific communication material such as a narrative and related

assets like video, photography and fact sheets that can be used both for external and internal engagement purposes.

* Help protect the site's local reputation through effective crisis communications.
* Support the site's culture activation and employee engagement plans in collaboration with relevant site leaders, - functions and ERGs.

**Core Capabilities:**

* Strategic internal communication skills: able to design and deliver communication plans that effectively support business priorities and help drive employee engagement.
* Excellent writing and storytelling skills: able to create engaging, high-impact content.
* Effective channel management: capable of managing different types of communication channels (online/offline, virtual/in-person) autonomously.
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills: Well-connected into the broader communications network. Recognised as a reference for advice on effective communications by site leadership, CGA peers and LOC. Able to actively listen and translate global messages so that they resonate locally.
* Effective use of data and insights: familiar with how to measure impact of communication channels and activities to continuously improve.
* Able to apply brand standards: effectively translate the company’s tone of voice to fit site communications. Develop communication materials that comply with the company’s visual identity.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of experience working in a communications role
* Strong project management skills with ability to work under pressure and effectively prioritize work
* Excellent cultural awareness
* Ability to deal with sensitive issues confidentially
* Ability to get things done

**Preferred Qualifications**:

  

The following characteristics are a plus:

* Experience working in a manufacturing/industrial environment
* As part of a global company, ability to speak and write in English professionally
* Experience with external communication, change communication and crisis communications
* Experience with training and coaching leaders on their communication skills

**Skills**

Content Development, Corporate Copywriting, Data Analytics, Digital Fluency, Reputation Management, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Storytelling, Strategic Planning

title: Head Chef - Lucia Marbella Beach Club
description:
**Join the Nikki Beach Hospitality Group!**

**Position:** Head Chef – Lucia Marbella Beach Club  
**Location:** Marbella, Spain  
**Contract:** Full-time, permanent, year-round  
**Start Date:** Ideally January 2027, with earlier availability welcomed

 **Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, creative, and passionate Head Chef to lead the culinary operations at Lucia Marbella Beach Club.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key leadership role in shaping the culinary identity of Lucia, delivering exceptional dining experiences that reflect the concept's vibrant Mediterranean spirit and commitment to luxury hospitality.

Working closely with the Regional and Corporate Executive Chef, the Head Chef will oversee all aspects of kitchen operations, from menu development and culinary innovation to team leadership, financial performance, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional culinary expertise with strong leadership and business acumen, thriving in a dynamic, high-volume luxury hospitality environment.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute innovative menus aligned with the Lucia culinary concept, in collaboration with the Regional and Corporate Chef.
* Ensure exceptional standards of food quality, presentation, consistency, and guest satisfaction.
* Incorporate fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced ingredients while maintaining the concept's culinary identity.
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance the dining experience through creativity and innovation.
* Maintain consistency in culinary execution across all services, including peak operational periods and special events.

* Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring efficiency, organization, and seamless service delivery.
* Manage food costs, inventory, purchasing, stock control, and waste reduction to achieve financial targets.
* Monitor kitchen budgets and operational performance, implementing improvements where necessary.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure product quality, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, HACCP, hygiene, and health and safety regulations.

* Recruit, train, mentor, and develop a high-performing culinary team.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and professional working environment that encourages creativity, accountability, and excellence.
* Manage team scheduling, staffing levels, and productivity according to operational requirements.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and identify opportunities for professional development.
* Lead by example, maintaining high standards of professionalism, discipline, and teamwork.

* Work closely with the Regional and Corporate Chef to ensure alignment with the group's culinary standards and strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with the General Manager, F&B leadership, and service teams to deliver an exceptional guest experience.
* Support special events, private functions, and culinary activations.
* Respond proactively to guest feedback and continuously improve culinary offerings.

 **What we offer**  

* Full company benefits package, including service charge and other applicable benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development within an internationally renowned luxury hospitality group.

  
**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive culinary experience, including at least 2–3 years in a senior kitchen leadership position such as Head Chef or Executive Sous Chef.
* Proven experience in luxury hospitality, premium beach clubs, upscale restaurants, or internationally recognized dining concepts.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, seasonal ingredients, and contemporary culinary trends.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate multicultural culinary teams in high-volume environments.
* Excellent knowledge of food cost management, budgeting, inventory control, and kitchen profitability.
* Strong understanding of HACCP, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Creative, proactive, and hands-on leadership style with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to remain composed and deliver consistent results under pressure.
* Fluency in Spanish and professional working proficiency in English are highly desirable.
* Flexibility to work according to operational requirements, including weekends and holidays.

 **Why Join Nikki Beach?**

Established by Jack and Lucia Penrod, Nikki Beach Hospitality Group epitomizes barefoot luxury hospitality, curating transformative lifestyle experiences through its global collection of iconic beach clubs, hotels, resorts, residences, dining concepts, and pop-ups. Recognized among the world's best beach clubs and resorts, the brand continues to expand into new destinations and concepts, including Lucia, a restaurant and beach concept introduced in 2024.

For our team members, this means the chance to be part of a hospitality group with a celebrated 25-year legacy and an exciting future. Joining Nikki Beach Hospitality Group offers opportunities for growth and international exposure, with the ability to build a career across some of the world's most sought-after destinations. As part of the Nikki Beach family, you will help shape unforgettable moments and contribute to the future of luxury hospitality.

**Ready to bring your culinary vision to Lucia Marbella Beach Club? We would love to hear from you!**

Born from the combination of Dufry and Autogrill, Avolta is redefining the travel experience through the dedication and expertise of our diverse workforce. We operate across multiple channels - including airports, motorways, cruise ships, ports, railways, and more - offering endless opportunities for collaboration and growth. Our people are empowered to make an impact, supported by a culture that values teamwork, development, and innovation.

Sustainability and social responsibility are embedded in our strategy, ensuring we grow in a way that benefits both our employees and the communities we serve.

Are you looking for a dynamic, international career where your contributions truly matter? Join Avolta and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of travel - together.

=======================

Responsible for the overall management of the commercial operations of Dufry stores across the Andalusia region, ensuring compliance with retail standards within the assigned area of responsibility in order to maximize profitable sales, strengthen local relationships, and deliver an excellent customer experience. A senior leadership role with full responsibility for commercial performance, operations, people management, and profitability across a network of stores, ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding customer experience within the airport retail environment.

====================

**Operations**
--------------

* Manage all commercial activities across the stores and airports within the assigned area of responsibility, in line with the company's short and long-term strategic objectives.
* Ensure the highest level of customer service and operational excellence.
* Define revenue, cost, profit, and inventory targets together with the Area Regional Manager and the Head of Operations.
* Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify improvement opportunities and implement corrective actions when required.
* Lead daily business review meetings with the team and coordinate resulting action plans.
* Review sales results by store, category, and brand against previous week, month, and year performance, as well as against budget targets.
* Supervise the team and coordinate commercial activities, promotions, and key events.
* Monitor operating costs and implement corrective measures when necessary.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with airport authorities and other local stakeholders.
* Coordinate the implementation and execution of corporate initiatives and strategic plans.
* Coordinate all external brand promoters operating within the assigned area.
* Lead meetings and site visits with brand representatives within the assigned area of responsibility.

**People Management**
---------------------

* Foster a positive and high-performance working environment across all stores.
* Identify and drive the learning and development needs of the teams.
* Ensure appropriate promoter staffing levels based on customer traffic and operational requirements.
* Monitor team performance, conduct performance reviews, and oversee workforce planning (FTE management).
* Lead performance management processes and objective-setting reviews.

**Finance**
-----------

* Accountable for the operation’s Profit & Loss (P&L) in collaboration with the Area General Manager.
* Analyze financial KPIs, profit and loss statements, and balance sheets on a monthly basis, including monitoring foreign exchange fluctuations where applicable.
* Participate in the definition of business investment and development plans.

**Customer**
------------

* Ensure, together with the Head of Operations, the implementation of high standards of customer service and customer experience.

**Required Profile**
====================

**Experience and Qualifications**
---------------------------------

* Minimum of 6 years' experience in retail or travel retail, holding senior management positions.
* Strong knowledge of the retail and/or consumer goods sector.
* Demonstrated leadership and team management capabilities.
* Proven ability to develop high-performing teams and motivate people.
* Strong understanding of Travel Retail business concepts and dynamics.
* Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented mindset.

title: Head Concierge
description:
Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca is looking for a **Head Concierge** to lead our Concierge Team.

  

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

  
  

Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

  
  

Set against the stunning backdrop of Puerto Portals, Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra pulses with the vibrant spirit of Mallorca. Here, subtle and emotional luxury seamlessly blend with the island’s natural beauty and energy, offering a place where inspiration flows effortlessly. Celebrate the essence of Mallorca through bespoke experiences, dynamic culinary journeys, and rejuvenating wellness - each designed to immerse you in the island’s vibrant atmosphere and extraordinary offerings.

  
  

**About the job**

Based at Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca, as the Head Concierge, you will be responsible is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the concierge team, ensuring the highest standards of guest service and satisfaction. The Head Concierge will act as the key point of contact for all concierge-related matters, working closely with other hotel departments to ensure seamless service delivery.

**As Head Concierge, you will be responsible for the following duti**es:

* To ensure smooth operations and exceptional service within the Concierge Team.

description:
**Project Researcher ICIQ-Innovation and Valorisation Laboratory (KTT 2026-02)**

The Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia (ICIQ) is seeking a Project Researcher to work in the Innovation and Valorisation Laboratory of the Department of Knowledge and Technology Transfer and Industrial Projects (KTT).

ICIQ is one of the world’s internationally recognised leading institutions in the field of chemistry committed to solving major social and economic challenges by conducting top quality research in three main areas: **Sustainable** **Catalysis**, **Renewable Energy** and **Health**. The institute also aims at training the future generation of scientists by offering high-quality educational programs to master, PhD students and postdoctoral researchers (full details on http://www.iciq.org/).

ICIQ is looking for a Project Researcher with broad experience in Chemistry (Health/Sustainability/Energy) and skills in technology transfer, intellectual property and business development. The selected candidate will be incorporated in the Innovation and Valorisation Laboratory where he/she will be in charge of the scientific development of industrial projects, the valorisation of internal technologies and collaborations with other institutions, as well as developing strategic analyses, searching potential collaboration opportunities with industry and promoting ICIQ’s services and capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and execution of synthetic routes to novel target molecules/materials, including scale up
* Experimental support to technology valorisation activities in the three main ICIQ’s areas: Sustainable Catalysis, Renewable Energy and Health.
* Experimental support to strategic alliances
* Support to ICIQ’s KTT general activities: patent applications, agreements and contracts (NDAs, MTAs, service, research…), business plans, marketing/investment strategies, and related documents
* Elaboration of scientific reports
* Exploration of public and private funding sources, and writing of proposals to apply for competitive funding
* Delivering presentations in group meetings and to potential collaborators
* Attendance to national and international events, visits to customers and partners
* Maintenance of laboratory equipment

**Requirements**

* PhD. in STEM Careers (Chemistry, Engineering, Materials, Biochemistry, etc…)
* Significant experience in multistep organic synthesis and process chemistry, including scale-up
* Skilled in analytical techniques for chemical compounds characterisation and structural elucidation (GC, HPLC, GPC, NMR, MS, IR, DSC, TGA, X-Ray, etc.)
* Experience in technology transfer and valorisation
* Knowledge of the Industrial and Intellectual Property system
* Knowledge in Business Development, Marketing or Finances
* Excellent command of English (written and spoken)

**Valued qualities**

* Strong multidisciplinary interest in ICIQ’s research areas: Health (small molecules, peptides, sensors…), Sustainability (catalysis, CO2 capture, polymers…) and Renewable Energy (H2 production, solar cells, materials…)
* Experience of High-Throughput Experiment (HTE) platforms
* Hands-on crystallisation of small-molecules
* Trained in process softwares, program languages and computational tools.
* Understanding scientific entrepreneurship and deep tech ecosystems
* Good communication skills
* Strong commitment for scientific excellence
* Motivated, creative, and problem-solving individual capable of working independently as well as in a team

**We offer**

* Full-time employment permanent contract
* Remuneration aligned with the company’s salary policy, within the PTIP1– PTIP5 band (28.840€ – 39.140€) based on the candidate’s qualifications and experience
* Annual salary split in twelve monthly payments
* Flexible 37.5 hours working week
* Incorporation: January 2027
* International and dynamic environment within a multidisciplinary team
* Continuous training plan to support your professional development
* Facilities with spacious areas, abundant natural light, and a functional, well‑designed environment aimed at enhancing people’s wellbeing
* Good connection to public transportation networks
* Free parking available at our facilities

**OTM-R principles in the selection processes**

ICIQ follows the principles of Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers as established by the European Commission.

ICIQ follows in its selection process a gender equality opportunity policy and a non-discrimination policy on the basis of age, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, language and disability.

ICIQis committed to promoting a work-life balance for its employees and, as such, offers flexible working hours.

**Selection Process**

ICIQ’s selection process usually entails the following phases:

* **Pre-selection:** The pre-selection process will be based on qualifications and expertise as reflected on the candidates’ CVs. This phase is merit-based.
* **Interview:** Preselected candidates will be interviewed by the Hiring Manager of the position and the appointed Selection Committee.
* **Offer Letter:** Once the successful candidate is selected, the People Unit will extend a Job Offer, specifying the start day, salary and overall job conditions.

The evaluation and selection process carried out under this call will observe the principles of the San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA), signed in San Francisco, California, on December 16, 2012 (https://sfdora.org/read).

The Selection Committee for this process is composed of:

* **Dr. Imma Escofet**, ICIQ’s Managing Director
* **Dr. Fernando Bravo**, Head of Industrial Projects and Knowledge and Technology Transfer Department
* **Dr. Sébastien Lethu**, Innovation and Valorisation Laboratory Manager
* **Dr. M. Ángeles Sarmentero**, Project Researcher at KTT

A Human Resources Unit representative will participate in the interviews to ensure procedural correctness and compliance with OTM R principles, without forming part of the Selection Committee.

The evaluation committee will perform the assessment ensuring the absence of conflict of interest with any of the candidates, and will sign a Declaration of Absence of Conflict of Interest (DACI) to that end. In case a conflict of interest arises, the evaluator will be substituted by a different evaluator with similar expertise.

The interview will last approximately 45 minutes and will be conducted in English. During the first 20 minutes, you will be asked to provide a short presentation about your background as a researcher (5 min) and the main focus of your research (15 min).

For further information, you can visit our HR Excellence in Research page at: HR Excellence in Research (iciq.org)

description:
Job Description:

**Job Title:** Administrative Case Manager & Accessibility Liaison

**Start Date:** January 7 or as soon as possible

**Department:** Student Affairs, Diversity & Inclusion

**Reports to:** Valencia Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion

**Location:** Valencia, Spain (On-site)

**Contract type:** Full time position

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM CET

**Reports To:** Valencia Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion

**Position Overview**

Reporting to the Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion, the Administrative Case Manager works in consultation and collaboration with internal and external partners to assist students in accessing support for health and wellness related concerns and navigating barriers to success. This position provides 1:1 consultation with students, and supports essential functions related to interventions with students of concern.

The position includes coordination with various resources in Valencia (and Boston when applicable) as well as with external resources (e.g. contracted counseling service providers, health insurance, contracted health care providers).

The position operates strictly within an administrative, non-clinical scope, focusing on triage, documentation, compliance, and cross-departmental coordination to ensure student success and campus safety. While this is not a clinical position, sensitivity, judgment, and respect for confidentiality is required. The successful candidate will facilitate support for students/parents/family members during both urgent and non-urgent situations, many of which involve mental and physical challenges. The Administrative Case Manager helps ensure appropriate care and follow-up for students in need of additional resources, helping to coordinate a comprehensive plan of care with appropriate colleagues across multiple units of the College.

In addition to primary shift duties, **this position participates in the campus administrator on-call rotation**, serving as a key escalation point for after-hours student health, safety, and psychological emergencies.

Additionally, this position is the primary campus liaison to Boston’s Accessibility Resources for Students, who determines reasonable academic, housing, and dietary accommodations. The position is responsible for connecting students to the Boston team and ensuring reasonable accommodations are implemented for students studying at Berklee Valencia.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Administrative Case Manager:

* Review and provide outreach to student concerns submitted as Health and Wellness Early Alerts and other incident reports; engage appropriate parties in the response where necessary.
* Apply standardized non-clinical behavioral threat assessment frameworks and related tools to provide and advise on appropriate interventions.
* Support the Director as the operational coordinator for the CARES Team, managing workflows in student database, liaising directly with the Valencia Director for Student Affairs
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation case management records and ensure compliance with both US higher education standards (FERPA/Title IX principles) and applicable local Spanish/EU data protection laws (GDPR).

* Coordinate safety plans, behavioral risk assessments, emergency communications, and multi-departmental support (e.g., accessibility services, residence hall staff, medical assistance team, and/or other community resources) across varying levels of student concern.
* Communicate with parents/family members, academic colleagues, and other necessary partners to assist with coordinated plans and management of student concerns.
* Coordinate emergency coordination with local healthcare providers, emergency services, and medical assistance vendors, facilitate re-entry plans upon a hospital discharge. Coordinate with the director on applying voluntary and mandatory leave policies.
* **On-Call Duty Rotation:** Serve in the administrative on-call rotation (nights, weekends, and holidays as scheduled) to coordinate response to urgent student crises, hospitalizations, or high-risk incidents outside regular working hours.
* Establish and maintain relationships with local English- and Spanish-speaking therapists, psychiatrists, hospitals, and social service agencies across the local health network.
* Oversee physical stocking and organisation of food pantry, collecting and analyzing data on its use.
* Serve as acting lead for student support matters when the Director of SADI is off-site.

Accessibility Liaison (Boston Office Partnership):

* Serve as the designated Valencia campus liaison to the Accessibility Resources for Students office in Boston, ensuring approved reasonable accommodations are implemented on the Valencia campus in alignment with institutional accommodation policies.
* Meet with students requesting academic, housing, or dietary accommodations; assist in gathering documentation; and facilitating the accommodation determination process by the Boston ARS Office
* Partner with local academic and operational leadership and faculty to; ensure approved reasonable accommodations are implemented, resolve academic, housing and dietary barriers, and advocate for universal design principles on campus.

Other duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education:** Master’s degree in Social Work, Higher Education Administration, Student Affairs, Public Health, or a related field.
* **Professional Experience:** 5-7 years of progressive professional experience in higher education, student affairs, student risk management, or case management.
* Certified (or certified within a reasonable period of time upon hire) with National Association of Behavioral Intervention and Threat Assessment (NABITA) risk assessment tool. (Berklee would sponsor NABITA trainings if successful candidate is not certified prior to hire)
* **Language Proficiency:**
  + **English:** Native or full professional fluency (C1 level) — primary working language for student support, documentation and Boston coordination.
  + **Spanish:** Working professional/conversational proficiency (minimum B1/B2, preferred C1) to navigate local medical systems, emergency responders, and community providers during standard shifts or on-call incidents.
* **Schedule & On-Call Availability:** Ability to work standard shift hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM CET, and willingness to carry an emergency on-call phone (including evenings, weekends and holidays). Must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of campus/local emergency facilities during on-call shifts.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* Experience with coordinating response to complex student emergencies, ideally in an international setting.
* Excellent technology skills or proficiency in Maxient case management software or similar platforms.
* International / Cross-Cultural Background: Direct experience working within international higher education, study abroad programs, or multi-cultural student environments.
* Direct experience working as an Accessibility / Disability Services liaison or specialist in a US college or university setting.
* Familiarity with both US higher education legal/regulatory frameworks (FERPA, Title IX, ADA/Section 504 principles) and European contexts (GDPR, local Spanish healthcare navigation).
* Prior experience in a satellite campus or global education environment bridging communication across multiple time zones.

**KEY COMPETENCES:**

* **Crisis Management & Emotional Resilience:** Calm, authoritative presence under pressure with acute problem-solving capacity during complex emergency and on-call situations.
* **Exceptional Communication and Organizational Skills:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to communicate with colleagues and service providers in Spain and Boston. Ability to document work quickly and with precision.
* **Cross-Cultural Competency:** Nuanced understanding of the challenges faced by US and international students living abroad / attending a US-accredited institution in Europe.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**

description:
### **Mission**

Provide specialized support and operational coordination to the Senior Director Brand Activation and the Brand team, ensuring efficient and accurate execution aligned with business priorities.

Independently manage the Senior Director’s calendar, travel arrangements, and key administrative processes, anticipating needs, resolving issues, and ensuring appropriate follow-up on commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Proactively manage the Senior Director’s calendar, prioritizing meetings, identifying scheduling conflicts, and coordinating changes with internal and external stakeholders.

* Act as the main point of contact and liaison with vendors, advertising agencies, event agencies, and other external partners, coordinating deliverables, documentation, and operational follow-up.
* Support the planning and execution of events, team meetings, international visits, and activations, coordinating schedules, logistics, materials, and vendors.
* Manage OTs, POs, and departmental invoices in SAP, following up on approvals and payments, identifying deviations, and escalating issues in a timely manner.
* Maintain up-to-date oversight of the department’s operational expenditure and prepare regular reports on invoicing, purchase orders, travel expenditure, and budget commitments to support decision-making.
* Coordinate and follow up on transportation invoices, shipments, deliveries, and material orders, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Create, structure, and maintain the department’s SharePoint, establishing filing, version control, and access criteria to ensure documentation remains up to date and easily accessible.

#### **Travel Organization and Management for the Brand Activation Department and Senior Director Brand Activation**

* Plan and coordinate individual and group travel, including bookings, itineraries, documentation, changes, and issue resolution, in accordance with corporate policies.
* Manage and review the Senior Director’s expense reports, ensuring accuracy, appropriate supporting documentation, approval, and timely submission.
* Support the Brand leadership team with travel arrangements, coordinating alternatives and resolving travel-related issues.
* Coordinate with Sales and other functions on the logistics of international visits, including agendas, transportation, accommodation, meeting rooms, and materials.
* Monitor travel expenditure, identify optimization opportunities, and prepare regular reporting on travel volume, costs, and policy compliance.

#### **Concur Iberia SPOC**

* Act as the functional point of contact for queries related to Concur and T&E policies across Iberia, providing guidance to employees and managers.
* Coordinate with Finance, Concur Global, and other teams to resolve issues, follow up on cases, and communicate relevant changes.

* Analyze recurring queries and issues, identify root causes, and recommend process improvements or preventive actions.

### **KPIs**

* Satisfaction and quality of service provided to internal and external stakeholders.

* Quality of follow-up on invoices, shipments, deliveries, and operational issues, including timely escalation when required.
* Optimization of travel expenditure and level of compliance with T&E and Concur policies.
* Quality, accuracy, accessibility, and maintenance of the department’s SharePoint and documentation.
* Implementation of improvements that simplify processes, reduce issues, and increase operational efficiency.

### **Key Stakeholders**

* **Internal:** Senior Director Brand Activation, Brand leadership team and wider Brand team, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Internal Communications, IT, and Concur Global.
* **External:** Vendors, advertising and event agencies, media partners, travel agencies, transportation providers, and other authorized external partners.

### **Skills Profile**

* Excellent communication, coordination, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* Strong negotiation skills and professional vendor management capabilities.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, judgment, and accountability.
* Proactive and autonomous approach, with the ability to anticipate needs and make decisions within the scope of responsibility.
* Excellent organizational, planning, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
* Strong attention to detail, service orientation, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to turn operational data into meaningful insights to support decision-making.
* Continuous improvement mindset and ability to design simple, clear, and scalable processes.

* Understanding of the communications, marketing, and brand activation environment.

* Demonstrated ability to lead across markets and influence senior stakeholders in a complex matrix organization.

* Experience in beauty, consumer packaged goods or another fast-moving consumer business is highly preferred.

**MINDSET**
===========

* A builder and growth hunter who sees white space, creates momentum and moves with urgency.
* Consumer-first and commercially sharp, operating as a full business owner rather than solely as a channel specialist.
* Collaborative and influential, able to align local, cluster and global stakeholders behind a common agenda.
* Comfortable balancing strategic direction with hands-on execution in a dynamic, evolving environment.

**SPECIALIZED SKILLS**
======================

* Strategic: business strategy, creativity, problem solving and decision making.
* Commercial: P&L management, revenue growth, investment prioritization and performance management.
* Digital and analytical: eCommerce platforms, digital shelf, CRM, retail media, attribution, forecasting and measurement.

* Continued learning and growth opportunities.

**EEO OPPORTUNITIES**
=====================

Wella Company provides reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact the Wella recruitment team.

Madrid, M, ES

**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Senior Analyst or Associate Director, Fis – Spanish Banks based out of our Madrid office.**

  

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

  

At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a “challenger mindset,” you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.

  

Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/

  

**About the Team**

  

The Fitch Ratings Financial Institutions Group has actively built the agency into the global leader in bank credit rating coverage. Our experienced analysts provide comprehensive, timely and transparent coverage of major institutions around the world, as well as unparalleled coverage of smaller companies. Our analysts offer a diversity of talent and backgrounds, with experience in regulatory oversight, counterparty analysis, auditing, investment banking, buy-side investing and more.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Monitoring a portfolio of issuer ratings, including the preparation of rating committee materials
* Analysis of financial institutions sector and individual banks data, update of financial excel-based tools and charts
* Writing and publishing of comprehensive rating reports on individual issuers
* Participation in credit rating committees for banks in the allocated region and other countries
* Regular interaction with contacts at issuers and with issuers’ senior management at rating meetings
* Participation in the publication of sector-specific research and commentary, including preparation of peer data, country snapshots and sector background information
* Assist as needed in the coverage of other banks in the portfolio; including working with other team members to prepare committee materials, peer tables or analytical tools, reviewing annual and interim accounts and completing ad-hoc data requests

  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* Proven analytical experience (ideally between 4 and 6 years), ideally in credit- or audit-related fields, gained from working at a commercial/investment bank, accountancy firm, buy-side firm, regulatory authority, rating agency, or similar.
* Background in either financial institutions or corporate credit analysis. Experience in bank analysis and banking regulation is desirable.
* Excellent demonstrable written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (native level) and English are essential.
* Ability to work independently as well as being a good team player.
* Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines.
* Strong writing and communication skills as well as strong command of financial statement analysis.
* Proficient in Excel
* A drive for innovation and appetite to find smart ways to implement AI into daily analytical tasks.

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Knowledge of another European language such as Portuguese is desired but not essential.
* University degree level, preferably with professional qualifications (such as CFA).

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment**: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

As Growth Associate, you will help Mormedi reach the companies and executives it should be working with. Reporting directly to the Director of Clients, New Business and Institutional Relations, you will design and run the campaigns, events and market intelligence that open new conversations across aviation, rail, banking, energy, retail and industry.

**This role is for you if**  
You are curious about how large companies work and why they change. You enjoy turning an idea into a campaign, a list into a conversation and an event into a relationship. You want ownership and like seeing the direct result of your work.

**What you will own**

* **Target accounts:** mapping and prioritising companies in Spain and internationally, and building account cards with challenges, decision makers and entry points.
* **Campaigns:** designing, launching and optimising outbound and account-based campaigns aimed at senior executives, from messaging to follow-up.
* **Events:** organising Mormedi's own executive events, such as breakfasts and round tables, and preparing our presence at international trade fairs, including target lists, agendas and post-event follow-up.
* **Market intelligence:** tracking news, investments, leadership changes and transformation programmes that signal an opportunity for Mormedi.
* **Campaign content:** working with Brand and Communications on the materials behind each campaign and event.
* **Pipeline reporting:** tracking results and sharing a clear weekly view of what is working.
* **Quality and Environmental standards (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001):** following Mormedi's Quality and Environmental Management System procedures, including sustainable practices in events.

**How success is measured**

* **Pipeline generation (~70%):** meetings and qualified opportunities generated through campaigns and events.
* **Market presence (~30%):** quality of events, attendance of target executives and quality of market intelligence.

**What you bring**

* **Business curiosity:** Genuine interest in strategy, innovation and how companies compete.
* **Research and synthesis:** Ability to turn scattered information into clear, actionable insights.
* **Execution:** Ability to run campaigns and events end to end, with care for detail.
* **Persuasive writing:** Clear, concise messages in English and Spanish that make senior people want to reply.
* **AI literacy:** Comfortable using Generative AI tools for research, personalisation and analysis.

**Software & Tools**

* **Office Suite:** Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* **Commercial Tools:** Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM (Copper or similar).
* **Nice to have:** Email marketing or event platforms, Canva or Adobe.

**Languages**  
High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; a third language, such as Italian, German or French, is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

* Final-year student or recent graduate in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, International Relations or a related field.
* Eligibility for an internship agreement (convenio de prácticas).
* Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

**What we offer**

* A six-month paid internship at our Madrid office, with a real possibility of joining the team afterwards.
* Direct work with the New Business leadership from the first week, without layers in between.
* Exposure to international clients and projects across aviation, rail, banking, energy and retail.
* A way of understanding business through design and innovation that very few places can teach.

Originally opened in 1929, this iconic retreat has been reimagined following an extensive restoration, reopening in August 2024 as Four Seasons’ first resort in Mallorca. Set within a vast private estate, the Resort combines its rich heritage and poetic charm with contemporary luxury and the warm, authentic spirit of Spanish hospitality. Here, nature, history and exceptional service come together to create an inspiring environment for both our guests and our people. Join our team and become part of the story of Formentor — a place where careers are shaped by meaningful experiences, genuine connections and the opportunity to deliver the exceptional, every day.

**About the Role** 
***Reports to: Director of PR & Marketing***

Supports The PR & Marketing Director in developing and executing public relations and marketing initiatives for the hotel.

In conjugation with Commercial Director, Director of PR & Marketing, the PR & Marketing Assistant Manager plays an integral role in the development and execution of the annual strategic commercial plan comprised of public relations, social media, and marketing communications strategies that support the business objectives. The role also require the involvement in the F&B and SPA marketing strategy, creating and executing marketing and promotional strategies to attract new clients and retain existing ones.

Executes all key PR & Marketing initiatives as defined below:

**Strategic planning & performance:**

* Apply market intelligence, consumer trends, guest insights, and competitive analysis to guide positioning and data-driven decision-making. Adjust strategies as market conditions evolve.
* Supports The PR & Marketing Director in developing the PR and Marketing strategy and support channel plans aligned with commercial goals and property priorities.

* Identify and analyze seasonal trends, key moments, priority feeder markets, and target audiences to inform annual marketing and campaign planning.
* Establish and monitor a local measurement framework (KPIs); track Property Scorecard metrics; conduct post-campaign analysis to inform future initiatives.
* Maximize adoption of global brand initiatives and campaigns in local and feeder markets to showcase the property’s distinctive guest experiences.
* Champion brand stewardship at the property level by ensuring consistent execution of brand guidelines with local relevance and adherence to governance processes.

**Digital Marketing**

* Liase with the Digital Marketing Manager on the resort digital strategy and ensure marketing funds are distributed accordingly.
* Lead integrated marketing campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels to drive reach, conversion, and aspiration, ensuring seamless orchestration and alignment with brand guidelines.

* Lead creation of Press Releases (brief to copywriters) for PR agencies.
* Activate the property’s unique positioning through compelling storytelling and creative expression.

* Excellent project management skills - able to conceive and implement projects from start to finish, manage processes and expectations, and build commitment to deadlines, both individually or in a matrix structure with multiple managers and indirect stakeholders
* Pro-active and inquisitive mind set to develop problem solving, decision making, conflict resolution and strategic thinking skills
* Understands F&B marketplace; well-informed of market trends and user behaviors, including leading marketing strategies unique to this category and evaluating the competition’s marketing communications activities and implements change as dictated by market requirements

Strategic mindset combined with strong tactical execution capability

* Photography skills and an eye for aesthetic

* Ability to interpret market intelligence and consumer insights to inform strategy and positioning.
* Expertise in integrated PR and marketing strategies across Paid, Owned, and Earned channels.

* A storyteller with commercial instincts.
* Equally comfortable presenting strategy to executives and hosting media guests.
* Passionate about luxury hospitality and guest experiences.
* Curious about emerging trends, technology, and consumer behavior

* Opportunities for career growth and advancement within a global hospitality brand.

title: IMBA Career Discovery Advisor, Senior Associate Director - Talent & Careers
description:

The International MBA (IMBA) at IE Business School is one of the institution's flagship programs, serving more than 800 highly international students each year.

The **Senior Associate Director – IMBA Career Services** is responsible for the end-to-end career development experience of a portfolio of IMBA students, supporting them throughout their career journey while contributing to the overall success of the program.

This is a role that combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The successful candidate will provide personalized career advising, design and deliver career education, manage student engagement initiatives, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the IMBA career offering.

Success in this role is measured by three key outcomes: **student placement, salary outcomes, and student satisfaction.**

**Why IE University?**

Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. We believe education is more than a path to professional success; it is a catalyst for personal transformation and meaningful impact.

At IE University, we place people and their potential at the center of everything we do, empowering individuals to become extraordinary. We encourage bold thinking and foster a culture where innovation, curiosity, and courage lead to real-world impact. **Our mission**

We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

**Our Purpose**

To foster positive change.

**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset

We are looking for a person to join a full-time position in **Madrid, María de Molina Campus.**

**Your role as a Senior Associate Director – IMBA Career Services will involve:**

**Career Advising & Coaching**

* Manage a portfolio of IMBA students, providing personalized career coaching throughout their career journey.

**Career Education**

* Design, prepare, and facilitate engaging career development workshops and classes in both in-person and online formats.
* Deliver content on topics including career strategy, personal branding, networking, recruitment processes, interviewing, and professional development.

* Monitor student engagement, career progress, and employment outcomes throughout the program.
* Coordinate career-related events, employer sessions, workshops, and student communications.
* Maintain accurate student records, reporting, and career outcome data.
* Track key performance indicators and contribute to reporting on placement, salary, and student engagement metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, student experience, and operational efficiency.

* Partner closely with Academic Programs, Employer Engagement, Admissions, Alumni Relations, and other internal stakeholders to deliver an integrated student experience.
* Build and maintain relationships with recruiters, alumni, and employer partners to stay informed on hiring trends and market needs.
* Stay current on global recruitment practices, industry developments, and labor market trends to provide relevant and impactful career guidance.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the Talent & Careers department to share best practices and ensure consistency in the student experience.

* Student placement outcomes
* Salary outcomes
* Student satisfaction and engagement
* Quality and consistency of career advising
* Effective delivery of career education and programming
* Operational excellence, reporting accuracy, and stakeholder collaboration

* Master's degree.

* Strong knowledge of global recruitment practices, talent markets, and the future of work.
* Experience designing and facilitating workshops, training sessions, or university-level courses.

* Outstanding coaching, facilitation, interpersonal, and cross-cultural communication skills.

* Experience working in an international and multicultural environment; experience in higher education and/or MBA Career Services is highly valued.
* A collaborative, student-centric professional with a proactive mindset, strong execution skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships across a diverse stakeholder community.

Unleash your full potential and make an impact. The next move is yours!
