description:
**Flying Bark Productions is a dynamic and innovative animation studio dedicated to pushing the boundaries of character animation and storytelling. We are working on exciting projects such as Avatar: The Last Airbender feature film, Netflix's Ghostbusters animated series and Stranger Things animated series as well as upcoming feature film, Zac Power.**

As a Senior Nuke Compositor you will work closely with Lighting TDs and creative Leads in order to achieve the creative brief set out by the VFX Supervisor. You will be able to confidently use the tools or software provided, and play a critical role in the execution and delivery of the high quality visual style of the production.

**About you:**

* Minimum requirement of 6+ years production experience in 3D animated films and/or animated episodic;
* Portfolios with mature, graphic stylization of reality preferred. Somewhat in the vein of Spiderverse, Entergalactic, Arcane and The Witness [Love, Death, Robots] ;
* Using Nuke Compositing software, meet the brief for the film that fulfils the creative standards of the project as advised by the Compositing Supervisor
* Ability to tackle shots creatively, whilst keeping an eye on continuity and taking responsibility for their final look
* Ability to think of creative solutions to enhance shots, without overshadowing the overall story point or animation, including but not limited to, the addition of adding atmos, vignettes, depth of field
* Able to seamlessly work with 2D, CG and/or 2.5D shots, understanding limitations in 2D and CG animation pipelines when required
* Able to manage their time allocated to their assigned work
* Able to be organized and methodical, dealing with large amounts of shots, tracking versions and render management
* Producing final shots with neat and well labelled node network, with reference to files in correct locations and easy to navigate filing systems
* Being proactive and communicative with the upstream teams and production, ensuring the efficient delivery of animation layers to compositing
* Communicate with the Pipeline team and aid in implementing improvements to the Comp pipeline
* Able to take direction from the Supervisor/s and Lead/s, and address notes appropriately
* An understanding of film colour space, grading, and a superior eye for composition, colour, mood and lighting

  

**What do we do?**  
Flying Bark Productions is a renowned independent producer of family-focused animation entertainment. For over 50 years, our 2D and 3D production facility has created award-winning feature films and TV series.

  

**Why work with us?**

* We work on some pretty cool projects - check out our website: https://www.flyingbark.com.au/
* We have cake days, movie nights, wrap parties & a culture club dedicated to coordinating our busy social calendar!
* We love dogs and you will often see some of our regular fluffy companions in the studio.
* Career development is important to us so we offer training and support opportunities whenever possible.
* Our employees say our culture is the best they've ever experienced - everyone is welcome and celebrated!
* You'll have access to mental health resources and free counselling via our Employee Assistance Provider, Support Act.

  

**Perks & Benefits:**

* We have a hybrid approach to work with flexible work from home days on offer.
* Breakfast is served daily - on us!

  

*Flying Bark Productions is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

title: Editorial Content Manager - French speaker
description:

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Ready to be part of the experience?

**Meet The Team**  
Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do, and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta, and More!  
  
**The Role**  
We are seeking an experienced Editorial Executive to lead the creation of compelling content for our media outlets for our expansion into new markets. Reporting directly to our VP of Media, you will play a pivotal role in managing a growing team of passionate editors, writers, video producers, and social media creatives.

**What You´ll Do**

* Scope of responsibility for the French and Belgian markets.
* 1-on-1 management, ensuring clear workflows, and providing individual feedback.
* Crafting, communicating, and executing a creative vision for the entire Secret Media Network.
* Collaborating with Editors, Staff Writers, and the video and social team to establish and maintain high editorial standards, adhering to the brand's identity and tone of voice.
* Leading and guiding the team to foster growth, inspire creativity, and reach new audiences.
* Working with experienced editors to elevate our content in established cities, with an eye toward expandable formats.
* Analyzing data for cities in your region based on SMN's internal KPIs, and leveraging findings to inform future strategy.
* Identifying editorial partnership opportunities to broaden SMN content to a diverse audience.
* Taking a hands-on approach to initiate key content-creation initiatives.
* You will also be responsible for coordinating, assigning, and prioritizing editorial work within the team, collaborating with other Fever departments, and developing and analyzing audience-growth strategies. Your role will involve celebrating 'wins' and sharing best practices network-wide.
* Having a deep understanding of how the business operates and translating that knowledge into content strategies that support revenue, audience growth, and overall company objectives.
* Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

**Who You Are**

* Proficiency in English and bilingual/native level in French.
* +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
* Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
* Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
* Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
* Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
* Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
* Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
* Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
* Team player attitude.
* Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

**Why You´ll Love It Here**

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
* Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
* Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
* Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

title: CP Transformation Lead GA South
description:
**Company Description**

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

 **Job Description**

**Location: any country within Geographical Area South**

**Country/Cluster Scope: GA South**

**Work Level: 5A**

The Transformation Lead serves as the transformation orchestration lead for implementing the Re-Imagine Europe programme within the Geographic Area (GA), with primary focus on Crop Protection. The role goes beyond project planning and reporting: it acts as the integrator that connects strategy, operating model design, change execution, capability building, new ways of working and business adoption across countries, functions and field-facing teams.

Working in close partnership with the GA Head, country leaders, HR, Finance, Communications, functional leads and the European programme team, the role translates the European master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap. It coordinates dependencies across workstreams, ensures that structural changes are implemented coherently, and drives adoption of future commercial ways of working, including new role interfaces, field force routines, customer segmentation, digital tools, AI-enabled productivity solutions and data-enabled performance management.

This is a high-visibility transformation leadership role requiring strong PMO discipline, change leadership, stakeholder influence, commercial understanding, digital curiosity and the ability to mobilise teams without direct authority. Success will be measured not only by delivery against milestones, but by business readiness, adoption of new behaviours, clarity of accountabilities, continuity of commercial execution and measurable progress toward the intended Re-Imagine business outcomes.

**Accountabilities**

* Integrated Transformation Roadmap: Translate the European programme master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap covering organisation design, people transition, capability building, change calendar, communications, commercial readiness, tools deployment and adoption milestones.
* Transformation Orchestration: Coordinate execution across countries, workstreams and functions, ensuring that HR, Finance, Legal, Communications, Commercial Excellence, IT/Digital, Sales, Marketing Activation and Technical teams move against one coherent plan and that dependencies are actively managed.
* Change Adoption & New Ways of Working: Design and facilitate the adoption approach for the new GA operating model, including role interfaces, governance routines, decision rights, RACI/DACI clarification, field force engagement, commercial calendar alignment and reinforcement of new behaviours after go-live.
* Field Force & Commercial Engagement: Engage sales, technical, marketing activation and customer-facing teams to ensure that the transformation lands pragmatically in the field, protects business continuity, supports customer impact and enables teams to adopt future commercial practices with confidence.
* Digital, Data & AI Enablement: Coordinate local readiness and adoption of enabling tools such as CRM/SFDC improvements, customer dashboards, AI-enabled sales support, data quality routines, automation and other Future of Commercial use cases, ensuring that technology deployment is linked to business value and user adoption.
* Business Readiness, Risk & Impact Tracking: Monitor transformation progress, readiness indicators, adoption metrics, risks, issues and business impact, including implications for P&L delivery, field productivity, customer coverage, capability gaps and timing risks against the commercial calendar.
* Stakeholder Mobilisation & Governance: Prepare and facilitate transformation governance forums, leadership checkpoints, country working sessions and cross-functional problem-solving meetings; ensure clear decisions, follow-up actions, ownership and escalation where needed.
* Transformation Documentation: Maintain the integrated roadmap, decision log, action tracker, risks and issues register, readiness dashboard, stakeholder map, change calendar and key handover materials required to secure continuity before, during and after go-live.

  
**Qualifications**

**Knowledge, experience & capabilities**

***Critical knowledge***

* University degree
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal; knowledge of the local language(s) of the GA an advantage.
* Experience in management programs, transformation PMO, change delivery or business transformation in a multi-country context.
* Solid understanding of PMO disciplines, transformation governance, change management principles, adoption planning, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Familiarity with agricultural or commercial business context, Future of Commercial concepts, CRM/data-enabled commercial execution and AI/digital productivity tools; Crop Protection experience an advantage.

***Critical experience***

* >5 years’ experience leading complex projects, transformation programs or PMO activities across multiple countries, functions or business units.
* Working in or with a multi-country, multi-functional team.
* Proven experience supporting organizational change, capability building, stakeholder mobilization, process redesign, digital adoption or commercial transformation.

***Critical technical, professional and personal capabilities***

* Strong transformation PMO discipline: able to structure complex programs, manage interdependencies, maintain momentum and convert ambiguity into clear execution plans.
* Ability to coordinate across multiple countries, functions and workstreams while maintaining one integrated view of priorities, risks, milestones and adoption status.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to connect people readiness, tool deployment, process change, customer impact and P&L implications.
* Excellent facilitation, communication and influencing skills; able to engage senior leaders, country teams and field-facing colleagues in a credible and pragmatic way.
* Comfortable with digital, data and AI-enabled ways of working; able to translate tools into practical use cases, adoption routines and measurable business value.

***Critical success factors & key challenges***

* Shifting the role from project tracking to true transformation orchestration, ensuring that structure, people, process, tools and behaviors move together.
* Creating strong engagement with country leaders and field force teams so the new operating model is understood, adopted and translated into day-to-day commercial routines.
* Ensuring that Future of Commercial, AI, CRM, customer segmentation and other digital enablers are not treated as parallel initiatives but embedded into the GA transformation plan and adoption agenda.
* Managing the tension between European consistency and local market realities while protecting commercial continuity, customer impact and readiness for go-live.

  
**Additional Information**

The job holder must be able to demonstrate a reasonable prioritisation of where job is physically performed and show flexibility to serve strong business need where required.

Employee may, as part of his/her role and maybe through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions. In this context, Employee may contribute to inventions, designs, other work product, including know-how, copyrights, software, innovations, solutions, and other intellectual assets.

description:
HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. **JOB DESCRIPTION:**
--------------------

HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the Travel Tech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. **Job Summary**

The role owns the fraud change roadmap and coordinates delivery across Product, Technology, Data & BI, Information Security, Finance, Operations and external providers. **8. Vendor and market engagement**

Support vendor selection, due diligence, commercial evaluation and implementation governance for fraud technology and data solutions; monitor relevant market capabilities and propose opportunities.

**Skillset**

Fraud/risk subject-matter knowledge;

Programme and project delivery;

Requirements definition;

Stakeholder influence;

Vendor management;

Structured communication;

Strong ownership and judgement.

**Experience required**

Relevant experience delivering cross-functional transformation, product, technology or automation initiatives.

Experience in fraud, payments, identity, onboarding, data, AI or risk controls is strongly preferred.

Internal organisational knowledge is an advantage.

**Nice to have**

Degree or equivalent professional experience in business, technology, data, risk, finance or a related field.

Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills;

Familiarity with Jira/Azure DevOps, process mapping, BI/Snowflake and agile delivery is desirable.

We're committed to creating**an**inclusive workplace where* *everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.*

title: Senior MEAL Manager
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Program Brief**

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solution driven, passionate changemaker, come join us positively impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future.

Since 2017, IRC has supported Rohingya Refugees and Bangladeshi nationalities communities in Cox's Bazar, Khulna, Barisal, and Chittagong with integrated services. The organization also addresses climate change impacts by building resilience and promoting economic recovery, education, and protection.

**Purpose of the role:**

The Senior MEAL Manager leads all MEAL work for the consortium. This is a full-time, hands-on role in the Program Management Unit (PMU), which manages day-to-day delivery of the project.

In this role, the post holder will:

* Set the MEAL framework and standards for the whole consortium.
* Collect, check and combine indicator data from IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners.
* Make sure DFAT-funded results are clearly attributed and that each client is counted only once.
* Build the MEAL skills of partner organizations.

Partners differ widely in capacity and resources, so the role works with a good degree of independence day to day. The aim is high-quality results, not just compliance. The post holder is supported by the Assessment and Learning (A&L) Manager, the Management Information System (MIS) Manager and IRC sector MEAL Managers and receives technical oversight from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality.

**Work Location:** IRC Bangladesh, Cox’s Bazar Office

**Contract Length:** 31st October 2027 (with possibility of extension subject to funding, program needs and performance of incumbent)

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Consortium MEAL framework and strategic ownership:**

* Design, maintain and regularly update the consortium-wide MEAL framework and MEAL Plan, including the Program Logic, log frame, MEL framework, Performance Indicator Reference Sheets (PIRS) and Indicator Tracking Table (ITT), in line with DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards (February 2026) and Development Evaluation Policy (2026), IRC MEAL policies and IRC’s global strategy, Strategy100. Ensure the framework, MEAL Plan, PIRS and standardized tools are approved and used by all partners.
* Own the consortium’s MEAL standard and practice. Contextualize existing IRC tools, standards and MEAL systems for the consortium rather than building parallel systems. Lead the standard MEAL methods, tools and reporting system, and strengthen partners’ capacity to use them.
* Agree with all partners how each indicator is defined and calculated, what data is collected, which tools are used, how often and with what sampling, and who is responsible. Ensure every partner applies the same definitions and protocols and understands the PIRS.
* Lead the annual Program Logic review and monitoring of key assumptions and risks with partners and contribute monitoring evidence to the consortium risk register.

**Data collection, consolidation, analysis and reporting:**

* Collect, clean, validate, analyze and compile project data for all indicators across IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners, for both monitoring and reporting.
* Ensure all partners collect data using CommCare-based tools and upload it daily to one central server and check the data routinely on dashboards.
* Maintain one common ITT for all partners (used for annual reporting) and analyze CommCare MIS data and the Program Indicator Dashboard (PID) monthly to assess progress and identify priority areas for targeted monitoring. Update the ITT and performance dashboards every month.
* Ensure data is consistently broken down by sex, age, gender, disability and location on every record (using the Washington Group Short Set on Functioning to identify persons with disabilities), and clear attribution of DFAT-funded results through project-specific codes in the MIS, addressing any attribution gaps through agreed data-sharing protocols and monthly data quality reviews.
* Apply DFAT’s unique client counting approach across all partners, using the program-specific client identifier in CommCare to count each individual once at service, sector and program level, and report unique reach against the target of 210,841 individuals by sector, sex, age, gender and disability. Ensure program data reported to DFAT is accurate, complete and donor compliant.
* Set and enforce common data management rules for all partners, covering file naming, storage, version control and data sharing.
* Ensure sensitive GBV and child protection case data remain within GBVIMS+ and CPIMS+ and agreed information-sharing protocols, with only aggregated, anonymized data used in consortium and DFAT reporting.
* Run routine consortium-wide analysis to identify programmatic, geographic, thematic and capacity gaps, including gaps in reaching the most at-risk groups (women and girls, children, adolescents and persons with disabilities) in line with JRP Priority 1 criteria, and flag them promptly to the PMU, outside the regular reporting cycle were urgent.
* Develop and monitor Value for Money (VfM) indicators aligned with DFAT’s 4Es framework (economy, efficiency, effectiveness and equity), including cost per client, cost per output and service utilization rates, working with Finance and sector leads and comparing results across delivery models and against sector benchmarks, and review the results with partners at program performance reviews.
* Prepare quarterly narrative and monitoring reports in consortium-agreed formats, and the MEAL inputs for DFAT annual performance reporting (led by the Program Coordinator, in the 8+3 format and aligned with DFAT’s whole-of-program indicators), with dashboards developed together with the MIS Manager. Submit reports on time and provide the DFAT inputs on schedule.

**Routine and process monitoring:**

* Lead a standardized process monitoring approach with tools and checklists for health and nutrition, protection, child protection and GBV, WASH, education, livelihoods, and emergency preparedness and response, covering quality, whether services are delivered as designed, inclusiveness, timeliness and the functioning of cross-sectoral referral pathways, with safeguarding, AAP and GEDSI built in.
* Monitor service quality, continuity, client access and satisfaction during the phased transition of services to Bangladeshi Partners, in line with the Partner Capacity building and Handover Plan, and report findings and corrective actions to the PMU and DFAT.
* Select activities for monthly spot checks based on MIS analysis (geographic coverage, program component, data quality performance and risk), and conduct spot checks with partner MEAL staff using digital tools.
* Plan and lead joint field visits with sector teams and partners, so that teams learn from one another (proposed monthly, and a longer 2–3 day visit each quarter covering all partners’ project areas).
* Review monitoring findings monthly with sector leads, and present consolidated findings at quarterly Program Performance Review and Reflection meetings, tracking agreed corrective actions to completion.

**Data quality assurance:**

* Check the quality of partner-reported data by verifying it, applying validation rules, cleaning it with a clear record of changes, and giving partners feedback.
* Lead annual Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) using IRC’s DQA methodology, adapted to DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards, and ensure at least 10% of reported data is verified against source documents each quarter during field visits.
* Lead on-site data verification and routine spot checks of CommCare records against registers, attendance sheets and case files (verifying sensitive GBV and child protection records only through agreed confidential protocols).
* Follow up DQA findings with agreed corrective actions and track them to completion and ensure compliance with IRC’s Data Quality Management Framework.

**Baseline, surveys, evaluations and research:**

* Use the baseline survey (completed in November 2026) as the benchmark for tracking change and refining targets, lead the internally managed outcome surveys (including the Year 2 midline) in line with the PIRS collection frequencies, coordinate the independent external endline survey in Year 3, and provide technical coordination of the Joint Program Review at around Month 18 (including the evaluation questions, validation workshop and joint action-planning workshop). Deliver all survey, review and evaluation activities on schedule.
* Develop Terms of Reference, methodologies, sampling plans (95% confidence level, 5% margin of error), tools and analysis plans, and oversee enumerators (IRC-enrolled incentive workers) and partner field supervisors, including daily data checks through dashboards, and ensure enumerators are trained in research ethics, safeguarding, PSEA, informed consent and sensitive-topic data collection.
* Prepare the Scope of Work in consultation with DFAT and share it before the evaluation team is recruited; procure and manage the independent final evaluation to DFAT’s quality and ethical standards and coordinate the management response and action plan and the learning workshop.
* Facilitate research as relevant to DFAT, such as KAP and SMART surveys, outcome harvesting, formative and multisector research, and coordinate with the protection and GEDSI teams so that the program-wide GEDSI analysis and protection analyses inform targeting and adaptation.
* Coordinate methodologies and reporting with DFAT’s external MEL provider.

**Accountability to affected populations:**

* Ensure there is one consortium-wide Client Feedback and Response Mechanism (CFRM) and coordinate it, building on existing partner systems, with safe, accessible and inclusive channels (adapted for persons with disabilities, women with restricted mobility, children and non-literate community members).
* Ensure feedback is recorded in the CommCare MIS and handled through IRC’s 4R approach (Receive, Refer, Respond, Reply), and that communities are told what action was taken.
* Ensure sensitive complaints, including safeguarding, PSEA and misconduct concerns, are referred immediately through safe, confidential pathways to IRC’s Ethics and Compliance Unit and are reported only in aggregate.
* Align CFRM complaint categories with the Common Feedback Platform (CFP) harmonized referral standards, coordinate with CFP focal points and inter-agency accountability mechanisms and refer out-of-scope concerns appropriately.
* Analyze feedback trends together with monitoring data, including signs of inclusion or exclusion errors in targeting, and work with the Community Mobilization, Community Engagement & AAP CoP so findings lead to changes in the program.
* Lead the annual multi-sectoral client satisfaction survey and ensure child-friendly and inclusive feedback methods capture the views of women, girls, boys, older persons and persons with disabilities.

**Learning and adaptive management:**

* Develop and maintain the consortium Learning Agenda (finalized with DFAT and partners) and learning logs and facilitate evidence-to-action processes so findings lead to program changes, including evidence-to-action briefs shared with DFAT, partners and JRP coordination platforms.
* Organize the quarterly reflection sessions, annual learning workshop and the Evidence-to-Action Plan following the Joint Program Review.
* Document and share learning briefs, case studies and good practices with partners, DFAT, other CoPs and IRC technical networks, working with the Communications team.
* Promote Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), Value for Money, localization and safeguarding in all MEAL analysis and learning, drawing on the technical leadership of CDD on disability inclusion and Nari Maitree on gender equality and social inclusion.

**Partner MEAL capacity strengthening and localization:**

* Assess partner MEAL capacity, jointly with partners and in step with the joint organizational capacity assessments and develop a tailored capacity strengthening and sharing plan covering data collection, analysis, reporting and use of data. Implement the plan and document progress.
* Provide training, mentoring, coaching and supportive supervision to partner MEAL staff, and give regular feedback on adherence to agreed tools and standards, while drawing on partners’ own expertise through peer-to-peer, bi-directional capacity sharing.
* Support the gradual handover of MEAL systems, tools and decision-making to Bangladeshi Partners, consistent with the localization-first approach and the Partner capacity building and handover plan.
* Track and report the program’s localization indicators, including the share of funding passed to Bangladeshi Partners and partner leadership of MEAL functions.

**MEAL Community of Practice:**

* Manage the MEAL CoP, which brings together MEAL focal points from IRC and all partners to harmonize tools, review data quality and share learning, guided by one Learning Agenda, and lead its work, with technical support from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality and in coordination with the NGO Forum MEAL Manager (co-lead).
* Prepare the Learning Agenda and meeting agendas, run peer learning sessions, technical clinics, joint problem-solving and peer reviews, and hold the monthly informal sharing meeting and quarterly formal meeting.
* Maintain the shared repository of MEAL tools and learning products and the common action tracker and escalate matters needing management decisions to the PMU.

**Coordination and representation:**

* Represent consortium MEAL directly to DFAT, and present key monitoring and feedback findings to the PMU and, where relevant, the CPF, using aggregate data only (never individual client information) and including community feedback and the changes made in response, which is a standing CPF agenda item.
* Work with the Head of MEAL & Program Quality, Program Coordinator, A&L Manager, MIS Manager, sector MEAL Managers and the NGO Forum MEAL Manager as set out above.
* Represent IRC in inter-agency MEAL, information management, accountability and assessment working groups as required.

**Others:**

* Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC [team/office]
* Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies.

**Key Working Relationships:**

**Position Reports To:** Head of MEAL & Program Quality

**Internal:** MIS Manager, IRC sector MEAL Managers, NGO Forum MEAL Manager, Related CoPs

**External:** Partner MEAL focal points (Nari Maitree, Breaking the Silence, CDD, FIVDB and CNRS), DFAT and its external MEL provider

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive MEAL experience in humanitarian and development settings, including at least 3 years in senior or lead roles managing MEAL systems for multi-partner programs.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competences:**

* Demonstrated experience in strengthening MEAL capacity of local and national partner organizations, and in localization approaches.
* Experience with DFAT (including its Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards and Value for Money framework) or comparable institutional donor requirements (for example US Government, ECHO or OCHA) for compliance, reporting and indicator measurement.
* Experience in at least three of the following sectors: protection, health, WASH, education, GBV, livelihoods and resilience, in humanitarian settings.
* Experience leading baselines, surveys, evaluations and research studies.
* Experience designing and managing multi-partner data systems, including unique client counting and de-duplication, and client feedback and response mechanisms in humanitarian settings.
* Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, SPSS, Kobo and CommCare; PowerApps and DHIS2 desirable.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analysis skills, and experience developing dashboards and automated reporting systems.
* Knowledge of data protection, safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA), GEDSI and accountability principles, including the ethical handling of sensitive GBV and child protection data.
* GIS/QGIS skills are highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions with partners at different capacity levels.
* Strong coaching, facilitation and collaboration skills, with a partner-led and respectful approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.
* Female Candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

**Specific Educational Qualification:**

* Master’s degree preferred in statistics, sociology, public health, development studies, economics, social sciences, demography, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field; or minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with additional relevant experience.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.

title: Head of Customer Service (all genders)
description:
Málaga, Spain

Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

**Your future team**

As Head of Customer Service, you'll lead Holidu's Customer Happiness front line from our Málaga office: 3 in-house Team Leads, almost 40 in-house advisors, and 150+ partner advisors. You may initially lead one market team directly while we complete the Team Lead bench.

You'll report to the Director of Customer Happiness and work alongside our enablement teams whose job is to equip the front line to succeed. We're at a turning point: we're moving to a new case management platform, rethinking how we measure performance, and redesigning how our teams work together. You'll be one of the people shaping it.

**What you will do**

**Own front-line performance**

* Own the results of our internal and external handling teams: resolution, customer satisfaction, response and resolution times, and productivity
* Set clear expectations, run a weekly performance rhythm with your Team Leads and partners, and act fast when results slip
* Make the tough calls when needed - on performance, staffing and priorities

**Lead the leaders**

* Manage, coach and develop our Team Leads in Málaga, building a leadership team that sets a high standard and holds each other accountable
* Potentially lead one market team directly at first, and stay close to the work by regularly handling cases yourself
* Build a culture of ownership, independent judgement, and pride in the work, with a clear development path for advisors from junior to senior

**Get the best out of our partners**

* Share accountability with our Workforce Management team for partner performance: help define performance targets, train and coach partner teams on their floors, and funnel partner feedback to our enablement teams so root causes get fixed
* Spend time on site with them, review quality together, and reduce escalations that bounce back to the in-house team
* Contribute to partner selection, onboarding and incentive design

**Fix how we work**

* Spot and remove friction on the front line: unnecessary escalations, duplicated work and outdated processes
* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

**Life at Holidu**

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram@lifeatholidu

title: Technical Writer
description:
TANlock, a dormakaba Group company, is a fast-growing technology business specializing in intelligent high-security access solutions for data centers and other critical infrastructure. What you will do

Technical Strategy & Consultation

What we require

* Pre-Sales Record: Minimum 4 years of experience in pre-sales or field engineering, troubleshooting hardware, software, and IP systems. OEM or vendor experience is highly beneficial.

* Self-motivated, inquisitive, and possesses a "Go-Get" attitude with excellent communication skills to influence technical managers and C-suite executives alike.
* Valid German driving license. Commitment to travel up to 40% of the working week in Germany HQ and globally including week-long regional sales trips gional sales trips.

  

What we offer

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
description:
**This Isn’t Another Growth Job**
Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.
  
  
We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.
  
  
**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**
Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.
  
  
**What Ai-native Growth Means At Paradox 🤖**
Our growth machine has to be able to:
  
  

* Generate hypotheses. Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.
* Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Ship its hypotheses. Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.
* Measure with real KPIs. Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.
* Learn and loop on its own. Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox,
  
  
We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.
  
  
We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.
  
  
They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.
  
  
We do that by merging :
  
  

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.
  
  
We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.
  
  
You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Build the agents that run growth
* ❌ The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.
* Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night
* ❌ The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.
* Build a creative machine with taste
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Build measurement that checks itself
* ❌ The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.
* Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul
* ❌ The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.
  
  
**You’ll own these KPIs:**
LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.
  
  
**Desired outcomes:**
conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.
  
  
**Tools you’ll master:**
GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.
  
  
**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍**
**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**
French: Native / Bilingual
  
  
English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.
  
  
Our chosen language for written communication is English.
  
  
**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
❌ If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.
  
  
❌ If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.
  
  
❌ If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.
  
  
❌ If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.
  
  
❌ If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.
  
  
✅ If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…
  
  
✅ If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…
  
  
✅ If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…
  
  
**WHY JOIN US ❤️**
Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.
  
  
Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.
  
  
Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.
  
  
You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.
  
  
**Growth & Ambition**

* > 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**
But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…
  
  
**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.
  
  
But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…
  
  
**Freedom & Well Being 🗽**

* > 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
* > 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
* > 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**How To Apply 📃**
⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️
  
  
If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀
  
  
**HIRING PROCESS 📃**
That job description resonated with you?
  
  
Here is your tailor made hiring process
  
  
📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)
  
  
💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions
  
  
💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s Growth team
  
  
💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset
  
  
💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the growth vision and the next milestones to build
  
  
💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding
  
  
🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!
  
  
**About Our Hiring Process**
Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.
  
  
We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.
  
  
If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.
  
  
If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.
  
  
Welcome to Paradox.
  
  
Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Associate Director of Digital Strategy
description:
### **Who We Are**

Teal Media is a full-service creative and design agency with a conscience. We believe purposeful design can transform organizations, inspire action, and enable progress. Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change—and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

We offer a variety of strategic, creative, and technical services, including brand strategy, web design and development, and creative support.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**
=================

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

Base salary of $120,000–$140,000. Where you land depends on your experience and skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage begin the first of the month after you join.

**Health coverage that puts you first**
---------------------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our high-deductible health plan, plus an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account. Your HSA is yours to keep and use for eligible health expenses now or later.
* A generous contribution toward family coverage, plus a choice of medical plans, including $1,000-deductible and $0-deductible options. We contribute toward premiums on every plan.
* Free counseling sessions, virtual therapy, and 24/7 virtual care.

**Dental and vision covered**
-----------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our base dental and vision plans, with buy-up options that include orthodontia and larger allowances for glasses and contacts.

**Additional support at no cost to you**
----------------------------------------

* Basic life and AD&D insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage, all 100% employer-paid.

**Time to recharge**
--------------------

* 10+ paid company holidays each year, starting on day one, plus a few bonus days off when we can.
* Flexible Time Off after three months. We encourage new teammates to take three weeks of vacation in their first year.

**Investing in your future**
----------------------------

* After three months, contribute 5% of your pay to your 401(k), and we’ll add 4%. The employer match is fully vested immediately.

**Support for growing families**
--------------------------------

* After three months, new parents receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave at full pay, up to $3,500 per week, to bond with their new addition.

**Location**
============

We are a fully remote team! So any US-based location works for us.

**Let’s make something happen**
===============================

Bring us your experience, your perspective, and your curiosity. We’d love to hear how you’ve helped an organization turn a digital strategy into results.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

If your experience doesn’t exactly match the qualifications listed, but you believe you’d thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply and tell us why you’re the right person for the job.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized communities to apply—including Black and Indigenous people, people of color, immigrants, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, neurodiverse individuals, and those who have been system-impacted.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer that values a diverse workforce and inclusive culture. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, disability, and veteran status. We are not offering US visa sponsorship at this time.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership
