title: Safety Director
description:
**Join Capstone Mechanical as a** **Safety Director**

**Location:** Remote (Must reside in our service territory: ME, NH, VT, MA, NY, CT, RI, NJ, PA, DE, MD, VA, WV, OH, TN, NC, SC)  
**Schedule:** Full-Time | Monday–Friday (Optional on-call rotation with additional stipend)

***Are you passionate about creating a culture where safety comes first, people feel empowered, and continuous improvement drives meaningful change******?***

At Capstone Mechanical, we believe that taking care of our people starts with keeping them safe. Safety isn't simply a requirement or a checklist; it's a commitment we make to one another, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We're looking for an experienced, people-focused Safety Director to lead and continuously strengthen our company-wide safety program. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, developing practical solutions, and creating a proactive safety culture across a growing, multi-state organization.

As our Safety Director, you'll partner with team members at every level of the organization to bring our Safety Always value to life, champion our Zero Harm philosophy, and ensure every team member has the knowledge, resources, and confidence to work safely.

**About Capstone Mechanical**

Since 2011, Capstone has delivered exceptional commercial HVAC/R service, maintenance, and installation to some of the nation’s top brands. Our mission is to build meaningful relationships - with our customers and with each other - by operating with care, transparency, and excellence.

**Why** **You’ll** **Love Working with Us**

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**

* Culture rooted in trust, transparency, and growth

* Remote flexibility with collaborative team support

* Direct contribution to business results and team performance

**What** **You’ll** **Accomplish**

As our Safety Director, you'll play a critical role in developing, leading, and continuously improving our safety practices across all locations and service teams. You'll work closely with technicians, General Managers, executive leadership, our Fleet Manager, customers, and insurance partners to create a safer workplace for everyone.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

**Safety Program Leadership & Compliance**

* Lead and continuously improve Capstone's company-wide safety program, ensuring compliance with OSHA and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

* Develop and maintain practical safety policies, procedures, and guidelines that support our field-based teams.

* Champion our Safety Always value and foster a proactive Zero Harm culture throughout the organization.

* Empower team members to exercise stop-work authority whenever they identify unsafe conditions, partnering with operational leaders to resolve concerns.

* Conduct safety audits, field observations, and risk assessments to identify opportunities for prevention and improvement.

* Partner with leadership to ensure safety remains a foundational part of our operations and decision-making.

**Safety Training & Development**

* Lead the development, coordination, delivery, and tracking of company-wide safety training programs.

* Ensure all technicians complete required OSHA 10 training and identify additional training needs based on job responsibilities.

* Oversee safety onboarding for new team members and ongoing refresher training throughout employment.

* Maintain accurate training and compliance records, monitor completion rates, and proactively address gaps.

* Develop engaging, practical training opportunities that encourage participation, understanding, and accountability.

**Incident Investigation & Prevention**

* Lead investigations involving workplace injuries, accidents, near misses, and vehicle incidents.

* Conduct root cause analyses to understand contributing factors and develop meaningful corrective actions.

* Maintain required OSHA reporting, recordkeeping, and incident documentation.

* Track corrective actions through completion and evaluate their effectiveness.

* Identify trends and share lessons learned to prevent future incidents and strengthen safety practices.

**Fleet & Driving Safety**

* Partner closely with our Fleet Manager to promote safe driving practices and strengthen fleet safety standards.

* Review telematics and motor vehicle record (MVR) information provided by the Fleet Manager to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Develop coaching, training, and prevention initiatives that support safe driving behaviors.

* Collaborate on vehicle accident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk reduction efforts.

**Customer Site Safety**

* Work collaboratively with customers and operational teams to address unsafe conditions identified at customer locations.

* Support technicians in raising safety concerns and ensure those concerns are taken seriously and addressed appropriately.

* Build positive, solutions-focused relationships with customers while reinforcing our commitment to safety and Customer Care.

* Escalate unresolved safety concerns when additional leadership support is needed.

**Reporting & Risk Management**

* Develop monthly safety reports for leadership, highlighting key performance indicators, incident trends, open concerns, and improvement opportunities.

* Prepare quarterly safety updates for the Board, including incident summaries, safety objectives, and progress toward improvement initiatives.

* Collaborate with insurance brokers and captive insurance partners to identify risk management opportunities and implement best practices.

* Participate in captive safety meetings and represent Capstone's safety initiatives as needed.

* Use data and measurable outcomes to guide decisions and continuously strengthen safety performance.

**Safety Culture, Communication & Coaching**

* Serve as a trusted safety resource and partner to technicians, General Managers, and team leaders.

* Create opportunities for open, honest conversations about safety, encouraging team members to speak up and share concerns.

* Coach leaders on reinforcing safe behaviors, accountability, and proactive risk prevention.

* Promote our Innovation by All principle by encouraging team members to share ideas that make our workplace safer.

* Recognize and celebrate safe behaviors, positive contributions, and improvements in safety performance.

* Partner across departments to ensure safety is integrated into everyday operations rather than treated as a separate initiative.

**What** **We’re** **Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* **People-Focused** – You genuinely care about the well-being of others and believe safety starts with trust, communication, and respect.

* **A Collaborative Leader** – You build strong relationships, work across teams, and influence positive change through partnership rather than authority alone.

* **Proactive & Solutions-Oriented** – You identify risks early, think critically, and focus on practical solutions that prevent incidents.

* **A Strong Communicator & Coach** – You can translate complex safety requirements into clear, meaningful guidance that resonates with team members at every level.

* **Analytical & Detail-Oriented** – You use data, trends, and observations to identify opportunities and make informed recommendations.

* **Accountable & Dependable** – You take ownership, follow through on commitments, and lead by example.

* **Committed to Continuous Improvement** – You believe there is always an opportunity to learn, grow, and make processes safer and more effective.

**Basic Requirements:**

* Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and managing safety programs for a multi-state, field-based workforce.

* Strong working knowledge of OSHA regulations, workplace safety requirements, and fleet and driving safety practices.

* Experience leading incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

* Experience developing and delivering safety training and educational programs.

* Strong communication, coaching, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

* Ability to analyze safety data, identify trends, and communicate actionable recommendations to leadership.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong partnerships across the organization.

* Willingness and ability to travel to customer locations, field operations, and insurance partner meetings as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Health and Safety, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

* OSHA 30-Hour certification or higher, such as OSHA 500.

* Previous experience supporting HVAC/R, mechanical, construction, or field service operations.

* Experience supporting safety programs across multiple states and geographically dispersed teams.

**Working Conditions & Travel:**

This is a remote position with travel to customer sites, field locations, and insurance partner meetings as needed. Travel requirements will vary based on business needs. Field visits may include mechanical rooms, rooftops, and other commercial service environments requiring appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).

**Our Benefits** **& Perks**

* **Competitive****Compensation**

* **Remote Work Flexibility**

* **PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave**

* **Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance**

* **Wellness Program** with premium discounts

* **100% Company-paid Short & Long-Term Disability + $25K Life Insurance**

* **Additional Life Insurance Options** for employee, spouse, and children

* **401(k) with 3% Employer** **Contribution**

* **Bi-Annual Bonus Program**

* **Free Financial Advising**

* **Employee Assistance Program** for mental, financial, and legal support

* **Personal and Professional Development Opportunities**

**Ready to build your career with a company that invests in you?**  
Apply today and be part of something meaningful.

Our decisions and criteria governing the employment relationship with all employees are non-discriminatory and are based on job requirements and an individual’s skills and experience without regard to race, creed, color, gender (including pregnancy), religion, age, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, veteran status, disability, gender identity or expression, or any other status protected by state or federal law. It is our intent that such factors shall not be a consideration for any of the following: employment, retention, promotion, recruitment or recruitment advertisement, rates of pay or other forms of compensation, administration of benefits,* *selection* *for job or management training, and demotion or separation. title: Director of Partnerships
description:
**About Advantage HQ**
----------------------

Advantage HQ is building the next generation of creator-led growth infrastructure for consumer brands.

We combine creative strategy, creator partnerships, performance content, whitelisting, affiliate distribution, paid media, and proprietary technology into one integrated growth system.

Our team manages more than $850 million in annual media spend and works with a network of more than 400,000 creators across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Through Meteoric AI, our proprietary intelligence platform, we use data and AI to improve decision-making across creative production, creator selection, customer acquisition, campaign performance, and brand growth.

We work with ambitious consumer brands across health, wellness, beauty, nutrition, personal care, and lifestyle.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for a commercially minded Director of Partnerships to build and scale one of our most important growth channels: strategic partnerships and referrals.

Our strongest client relationships often originate from trusted introductions. We now want to turn that advantage into a predictable, scalable revenue engine.

Your mission is to build a high-performing ecosystem of referral and strategic partners who consistently introduce Advantage HQ to qualified consumer brands.

These partners may include marketing agencies, fractional CMOs, consultants, technology providers, private equity firms, e-commerce operators, and other influential leaders within the DTC ecosystem.

This is not a traditional relationship management role. You will be responsible for building partnerships that generate measurable commercial outcomes, not simply expanding a contact list.

You will own the entire partnership lifecycle, from identifying and recruiting high-value partners to activating relationships, generating qualified introductions, and converting those opportunities into revenue alongside our Sales team.

Success means building a network of highly engaged partners who consistently think of Advantage HQ when their clients, portfolio companies, or industry peers need help scaling.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Strategic Partnership Development**

* Identify, recruit, and establish partnerships with agencies, consultancies, fractional CMOs, technology providers, private equity firms, and other businesses serving high-growth consumer brands.
* Build relationships with founders, CEOs, CMOs, investors, and senior executives who can introduce Advantage HQ to qualified prospective clients.
* Develop a targeted partner acquisition strategy focused on organizations with strong access to our ideal customer profile.
* Identify complementary service providers and develop mutually beneficial referral and co-selling relationships.
* Negotiate commercial agreements, referral arrangements, and strategic collaborations that create long-term value for both parties.

### **Partner Activation & Relationship Management**

* Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners, ensuring relationships remain active, productive, and commercially valuable.
* Develop structured partner onboarding, enablement, and engagement programs.
* Equip partners with the positioning, messaging, case studies, and resources needed to confidently introduce Advantage HQ.
* Establish recurring partner meetings, executive introductions, and relationship-building initiatives that consistently generate opportunities.
* Identify underperforming partnerships and implement strategies to improve engagement and referral activity.
* Become a trusted commercial partner to the people and organizations within our ecosystem.

### **Pipeline & Revenue Generation**

* Own partner-sourced pipeline and new revenue targets.
* Drive a consistent volume of high-quality introductions to qualified DTC and e-commerce brands.
* Work closely with our Sales team to ensure partner referrals are properly qualified, tracked, followed up, and converted.
* Identify opportunities to accelerate sales cycles through warm introductions, joint conversations, and executive relationships.
* Monitor referral-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-client conversion rates.
* Take accountability for the commercial performance of the partnerships channel.

### **Partnership Systems & Scalability**

* Build the processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms required to scale our partnerships program.
* Establish clear partner segmentation, prioritization, and activation frameworks.
* Develop referral tracking, attribution, reporting, and partner compensation processes.
* Create dashboards to measure partner activity, pipeline generation, revenue contribution, and overall channel performance.
* Leverage CRM systems, AI, and automation to improve partner discovery, engagement, relationship management, and reporting.
* Continuously refine our partnership model to make it more efficient, repeatable, and scalable.

### **Strategic Initiatives & Market Development**

* Identify new partnership opportunities across emerging channels, technologies, and industry ecosystems.
* Collaborate with Marketing on partner events, webinars, content collaborations, and joint go-to-market initiatives.
* Represent Advantage HQ at relevant industry conferences, networking events, and executive gatherings.
* Build relationships with influential operators and decision-makers across the broader e-commerce ecosystem.
* Bring market intelligence, competitive insights, and new business opportunities back to the leadership team.
* Work directly with executive leadership to shape the long-term direction of our partnerships strategy.

**Who You Are**
---------------

You are an experienced partnerships leader who understands how to turn relationships into predictable business growth.

You have a strong network within the digital marketing, e-commerce, or technology ecosystem, and you know how to develop relationships with senior executives who control or influence meaningful commercial opportunities.

You are equally comfortable opening new doors, building relationships over time, negotiating commercial arrangements, and working with Sales teams to convert introductions into clients.

You are commercially driven and understand that the ultimate measure of a successful partnership is the business it generates.

You think systematically. Rather than relying on occasional introductions, you know how to build repeatable processes that continuously generate new opportunities.

Most importantly, you are proactive, highly accountable, and comfortable building a function with significant autonomy.

**Experience We Value**
-----------------------

* 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, channel partnerships, business development, alliances, or related commercial roles.
* Proven track record of building and scaling referral or strategic partnership programs that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Experience within digital marketing agencies, professional services, consulting, marketing technology, or the broader e-commerce ecosystem.
* Established relationships with agency founders, fractional CMOs, consultants, e-commerce executives, investors, or other relevant industry leaders.
* Experience owning partner-sourced pipeline, revenue targets, and commercial KPIs.
* Strong understanding of referral agreements, revenue-sharing models, co-selling arrangements, and strategic partnerships.
* Excellent executive relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Experience developing repeatable partnership playbooks, systems, and reporting frameworks.
* Strong organizational discipline and the ability to manage multiple strategic relationships simultaneously.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward execution, ownership, and measurable results.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Your performance will be measured primarily by the commercial impact of the partnerships you develop.

Key metrics include:

* **Partner-Sourced Revenue:** New monthly recurring revenue generated through strategic and referral partnerships.
* **Partner-Sourced Pipeline:** Total value of qualified sales opportunities generated through partners.
* **Qualified Introductions:** Number of qualified prospective clients introduced to Advantage HQ.
* **Active Revenue-Generating Partners:** Number of partners consistently generating meaningful business opportunities.
* **Partnership Conversion:** Conversion rates from introductions to qualified opportunities and closed clients.

**Why Join Advantage HQ**
-------------------------

This is an opportunity to build and own one of the most important growth channels within a rapidly scaling business.

You will have the autonomy to develop our partnership strategy, establish high-value industry relationships, negotiate commercial structures, and build the systems required to turn partnerships into a sustainable revenue engine.

You will work directly with executive leadership and collaborate with experienced Sales, Growth, Marketing, and Client Services teams.

We are looking for someone who wants to build something meaningful, develop an influential network within the consumer brand ecosystem, and be rewarded for the business they generate.

**Compensation & Location**
---------------------------

* $270,000 to $810,000 USD total annual compensation, including base salary, performance bonus, and equity.
* Fully remote. We have built the infrastructure for high-performance distributed teams and trust our people to do their best work from wherever they work best.
* North America required, with a strong preference for candidates based in the United States.

If you are excited to join the leadership team, build a world-class partnerships organization, own a major company-level revenue number, develop an exceptional network of strategic and referral partners, and help transform Advantage HQ's partnerships channel into a predictable, scalable revenue engine, we would love to hear from you.

* Proven success in managing large-scale brands and scaling emerging brands

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
  
  
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
  
  
**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
We are hiring a
**Director of Brand Marketing**
to our
**Marketing**
team in
**New York.**
This role will own Wellhub’s brand in the United States, translating our global brand strategy into locally relevant, high-impact execution. You will lead brand strategy and activation in a market where Wellhub is still building recognition, working closely with global brand leadership, US Revenue Marketing, Advertising, Social Media, Demand Gen, User Growth and Product Marketing. This is a rare chance to join at a moment of significant US brand investment: a funded, greenfield build, with clear global platforms already in place (including premium sports partnerships) and real freedom to shape how they come to life in the US. You will be the face of the brand in the market, with direct visibility to senior leadership and C-level.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**

* Define and execute the US brand strategy, aligned with Wellhub’s global brand strategy and platforms.
* Translate global guidelines into locally relevant execution: campaign regionalization, tone of voice and cultural nuance, grounded in the US competitive, employer-benefits and wellness landscape.
* Build awareness and consideration among US HR and benefits decision-makers (B2B) and employees (B2C).
* Plan and deliver brand-led activations, experiential programs, sponsorships and events end-to-end, managing agencies, vendors and local partners.
* Own the brand budget and the relationships with agencies, sponsorship and media partners (OOH, TV/CTV, streaming), with clear accountability for ROI.
* Use brand tracking, research and competitive benchmarks to inform positioning and investment decisions.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

As Director of Product Design, you will lead the design organization responsible for how customers and administrators experience Menlo Security's Enterprise Secure Browser platform, from the first-run configuration dashboard experience to the policies that keep global enterprises safe. You will set the design philosophy, user and administrator dashboards quality bar, and research and accessibility standards for the entire product organization, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythms that make excellent work the default. Partnering closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market, you will make design a strategic driver of product direction and competitive differentiation in enterprise security, where clarity and trust matter as much as capability. You will also lead how the design team utilizes AI,how we leverage AI to continue to improve our user interfaces, and build shared workflows that speed up research synthesis, exploration, and quality review while keeping human judgment at the center.

**Outcomes & KPIs**
-------------------

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* A consistently high-quality, accessible, and cohesive product experience across all Menlo surfaces that measurably improves customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* A high-performing, well-led design organization with the systems, standards, and talent to scale with the business.

**Success Metrics / KPIs:** *(suggested; hiring manager to confirm)*

* Improvement in product usability and customer satisfaction measures (e.g., task success rates, SUS/CSAT, or NPS for key workflows) year over year.
* Accessibility conformance (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA) across core product surfaces, tracked through defined quality gates.
* Design system adoption and consistency across product teams, along with fewer design-related defects reaching production.
* Measurable time saved or quality improved through AI-enabled design workflows adopted across the team.
* Team health and growth indicators, including engagement scores, retention of top talent, and internal promotion readiness.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, grow, and coach a team of product designers and design managers, investing meaningful time in talent development, setting clear performance expectations, and making timely talent decisions.
* Define the craft philosophy, quality standards, and review processes that govern interaction design, visual design, and accessibility across the full product organization, and build the design systems and frameworks that sustain them at scale.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market leaders to shape multi-quarter and multi-year product vision, influence roadmap and investment decisions, and protect design intent through implementation.
* Establish the organization's research and accessibility practice, embedding evidence-based decision-making and company-wide accessibility standards into roadmap planning and product quality gates.
* Demonstrate design's business impact through outcome tracking and clear business cases, and represent design strategy and results at the VP and executive level.
* Design and scale AI-enabled workflows for the team, such as using AI to synthesize research and customer feedback, generate and explore early concepts, and support accessibility and consistency checks, and evaluate AI tools for fit, risk, and ROI.
* Build cross-functional forums and operating rhythms that bring the customer's perspective into how Menlo plans, prioritizes, and makes decisions.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 12+ years of product design experience, including 5+ years leading design teams with managers reporting to you, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
* A portfolio showing advanced craft in UX, interaction, and visual design for complex products, and how you have raised quality standards across multiple teams.
* Experience building or scaling a design system and establishing design review and quality processes across a product organization.
* Depth in user research methods and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG), with a track record of embedding both into product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence executive and C-suite stakeholders, connect design work to business outcomes, and shape product strategy and roadmaps.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools in design and research workflows, with experience guiding a team's adoption of them responsibly.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience designing for cybersecurity, networking, or IT/security administrator audiences.
* Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences.
* Experience leading content design or UX writing alongside product design.
* External presence in the design community, such as speaking, writing, or mentoring.
* Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Menlo Mindsets**
------------------

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

* **Proactive Leadership** — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.
* **Straight Talk** — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.
* **United Impact** — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You align with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders on shared priorities and build the forums that make design quality a company-wide responsibility, not just the design team's.
* **Elevated Talent** — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You spend real time developing designers and design managers, set a clear bar for craft and leadership, and know and actively grow the top talent across your organization.
* **Customer-Compelled** — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You bring research and customer insight into strategic planning, and work across teams to find and remove root-cause friction in the product before customers feel it.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability**.

Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.***

**Description**

The Associate Editorial Director with GSW is responsible for managing editorial workflow within assigned teams and serving as an editorial point of contact for client management, medical, creative, and other cross-functional partners. This person can manage editors and helps facilitate cross-office staffing as needs arise. In addition, the Associate Editorial Director maintains assigned brand responsibilities, editing, and fact-checking print and digital materials across clients' various disease areas of focus. The Associate Editorial Director is proficient in editorial processes and the pharmaceutical advertising communications industry and independently handles a wide range of client projects.

Reporting to the VP, Editorial Director, the Associate Editorial Director supports the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of editorial processes and standards that ensure high-quality output for our clients. This role can include direct people-management responsibilities but ensuring editors have the support, resources, and guidance needed to succeed.

The Associate Editorial Director understands the broader goals of the department and organization, supports leadership objectives, contributes to a positive department culture, and takes a solutions-oriented approach to challenges. In this leadership position, the Associate Editorial Director serves as a role model and mentor, helping team members achieve department goals while supporting their professional growth.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
  
Duties may include, but are not limited to, all or some of the following:

Leadership and People Management

* Support the day-to-day management of the Editorial department and serve as a primary editorial leadership contact for assigned teams or offices.
* Provide day-to-day leadership and management for assigned direct reports (if people managing), including resource management, conflict resolution, communication of processes and expectations, performance evaluations, professional development plans, and MBO plans.
* Work to ensure editorial systems, processes, and standards are followed and issues are escalated appropriately.
* Train and onboard new Editorial hires and familiarize them with department processes, standards, tools, and ways of working.
* Train and foster the development of newer editors while coaching experienced staff and providing ongoing feedback and guidance.
* Plan and lead editorial team meetings as appropriate.
* Foster a positive, collaborative department culture and serve as a role model for editorial standards and professional expectations.

Workflow, Resourcing, and Operations

* Proactively assess workload, capacity, deadlines, and potential bottlenecks among editors they support.
* Develop coverage solutions and coordinate cross-office support as needed, escalating broader staffing and resource needs to the Editorial Director.
* Help manage editorial workflow and priorities to support appropriate coverage and timely delivery of work.
* Resolve day-to-day editorial staffing, workflow, and process issues within assigned areas, identifying solutions and escalating issues requiring broader department direction or support.
* Provide regular updates to the Editorial Director regarding workload, staffing needs, project risks, process concerns, and other issues requiring broader departmental oversight.
* Maintain and enforce established editorial best practices and process standards within assigned teams and accounts, escalating broader process issues and opportunities to the Editorial Director.
* Identify opportunities to improve editorial workflows and processes and partner with Editorial leadership on solutions and implementation.

Editorial and Brand Responsibilities

* Maintain assigned brand-editor responsibilities while balancing people-management (if managing), operational, and department leadership responsibilities.
* Supervise the editorial process across assigned accounts and teams, ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* Perform various levels of editing, proofreading, and fact-checking on print and digital materials.
* Edit with a demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical and medical content, including recognition of drug trade and generic names and identification of potential reference or claims issues.
* Edit to enhance clarity, readability, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand and editorial standards without significantly altering intended meaning.
* Check the accuracy and consistency of information and supporting references.
* Produce accurate, high-quality work while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines.
* Stay current on relevant medical communications and editorial best practices.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Problem-Solving

* Work closely with account managers, medical, writers, designers, creative teams, project managers, and other partners to support cohesive and efficient development and review of client work.
* Serve as an editorial resource to cross-functional teams, helping clarify editorial processes, requirements, and expectations.
* Anticipate and identify roadblocks that may affect quality, timing, resources, or deadlines and develop practical solutions.
* Independently address routine brand- and team-level challenges while recognizing when issues require escalation or broader leadership involvement.

**Job Qualifications**

Skills

* High level of familiarity and comfort with AMA style and knowledge of FDA requirements relevant to pharmaceutical advertising and promotional communications.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong people-management and coaching skills, including the ability to guide editors with varying levels of experience.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and people simultaneously with a high degree of organization, initiative, and efficiency.
* Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize competing demands and identify when an issue should be resolved independently versus escalated.
* Ability to motivate and support people through change and evolving roles or processes.
* Solutions-oriented approach to challenges involving quality, timing, resources, workflow, and deadlines.
* Self-starter who can identify unmet needs, raise issues proactively, and recommend practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with minimal direction and adapt to shifting priorities, assignments, and business needs.
* Strong commitment to editorial quality, consistency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

* Candidates must be able to work PST hours
* Bachelor's degree in Journalism, English, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7 years of editorial experience, including experience in healthcare communications.
* Firm grasp of AMA style and FDA guidelines applicable to pharmaceutical communications, including fair balance and claims referencing.
* Proven track record of producing high-quality editorial work and managing editorial processes.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and staff-development skills.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and fact-checking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and project-management abilities.
* Proficiency with relevant editorial tools and content-management systems.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage tight or competing deadlines.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!

Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
